With your side to the cable, grab the handle with both hands and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable.
With your feet positioned hip-width apart and knees slightly bent, hold the cable to the middle of your chest. This will be your starting position.
Press the cable away from your chest, fully extending both arms. You core should be tight and engaged.
Hold the repetition for several seconds before returning to the starting position.
At the conclusion of the set, repeat facing the other direction.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Connect a Estándar handle to a tower, and—if possible—position the Polea to Hombro height. If not, a Bajo pulley will suffice. With your Lateral to the Polea, grab the handle with both hands and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the Polea. With your feet positioned Cadera-width apart and knees slightly bent, hold the Polea to the middle of your Pecho. This will be your starting position. Press the Polea away from your Pecho, fully extending both arms. You core should be tight and engaged. Hold the repetition for several seconds before returning to the starting position. At the conclusion of the set, repeat facing the other direction.

Abdominales.name: Prensa Pallof con Rotación
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Connect a standard handle to a tower, and position the cable to shoulder height.
With your side to the cable, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable. Align outstretched arm with cable.
With your feet positioned hip-width apart, pull the cable into your chest and grab the handle with your other hand. Both hands should be on the handle at this time.
Facing forward, press the cable away from your chest. You core should be tight and engaged.
Keeping your hips straight, twist your torso away from the pulley until you get a full quarter rotation.
Maintain your rigid stance and straight arms. Return to the neutral position in a slow and controlled manner. Your arms should be extended in front of you.
With the side tension still engaging your core, bring your hands to your chest and immediately press outward to a fully extended position. This constitutes one rep.
Repeat to failure.
Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite side.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Connect a Estándar handle to a tower, and position the Polea to Hombro height. With your Lateral to the Polea, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the Polea. Align outstretched arm with Polea. With your feet positioned Cadera-width apart, pull the Polea into your Pecho and grab the handle with your other hand. Both hands should be on the handle at this time. Facing forward, Press the Polea away from your Pecho. You core should be tight and engaged. Keeping your Caderas straight, twist your torso away from the pulley until you get a full quarter rotation. Maintain your rigid stance and straight arms. Return to the neutral position in a sBajo and controlled manner. Your arms should be extended in Frontal of you. With the Lateral tension still engaging your core, bring your hands to your Pecho and immediately Press outward to a fully extended position. This constitutes one rep. Repeat to failure. Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite Lateral.

Abdominales.name: Plancha
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Get into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your toes and your forearms. Your arms are bent and directly below the shoulder.
Keep your body straight at all times, and hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or leg can be raised.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Get into a Tumbado Prono position on the Suelo, supporting your weight on your toes and your foPosteriorms. Your arms are bent and directly beBajo the Hombro. Keep your body straight at all times, and hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or Pierna can be Elevaciónd.

Abdominales.name: Disco Twist
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your legs fully extended and your upper body upright. Grab the plate by its sides with both hands out in front of your abdominals with your arms slightly bent.
Slowly cross your legs near your ankles and lift them up off the ground. Your knees should also be bent slightly. Note: Move your upper body back slightly to help keep you balanced turning this exercise. This is the starting position.
Move the plate to the left side and touch the floor with it. Breathe out as you perform that movement.
Come back to the starting position as you breathe in and then repeat the movement but this time to the right side of the body. Tip: Use a slow controlled movement at all times. Jerking motions can injure the back.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Lie down on the Suelo or an exercise mat with your Piernas fully extended and your upper body Vertical. Grab the Disco by its Laterals with both hands out in Frontal of your Abdominals with your arms slightly bent. SBajoly cross your Piernas near your ankles and lift them up off the ground. Your knees should also be bent slightly. Note: Move your upper body Espalda slightly to help keep you balanced turning this exercise. This is the starting position. Move the Disco to the left Lateral and touch the Suelo with it. Breathe out as you perform that movement. Come Espalda to the starting position as you breathe in and then repeat the movement but this time to the right Lateral of the body. Tip: Use a sBajo controlled movement at all times. Envióning motions can injure the Espalda. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Pulse Sit-up
Abdominales.instructions_en:
To begin, lie down on a bench with a barbell resting on your chest. Position your legs so they are secure on the extension of the abdominal bench. This is the starting position.
While inhaling, tighten your abdominals and glutes. Simultaneously curl your torso as you do when performing a sit-up and press the barbell to an overhead position while exhaling. Tip: Use your arms to push the barbell out as you perform this exercise while still focusing on the abdominal muscles.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position while bringing the barbell back down to your torso. Remember to breathe in while lowering the body.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: To begin, lie down on a bench with a Barra resting on your Pecho. Position your Piernas so they are secure on the Extensión of the Abdominal bench. This is the starting position. While inhaling, tighten your Abdominals and Glúteos. Simultaneously Curl your torso as you do when performing a Abdominales and Press the Barra to an Sobre la Cabeza position while exhaling. Tip: Use your arms to push the Barra out as you perform this exercise while still focusing on the Abdominal Muslos. Bajoer your upper body Espalda down to the starting position while bringing the Barra Espalda down to your torso. Remember to breathe in while Bajoering the body. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Inverso Crunch
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Lie down on the floor with your legs fully extended and arms to the side of your torso with the palms on the floor. Your arms should be stationary for the entire exercise.
Move your legs up so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and feet are together and parallel to the floor. This is the starting position.
While inhaling, move your legs towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you raise your hips off the floor. At the end of this movement your knees will be touching your chest.
Hold the contraction for a second and move your legs back to the starting position while exhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Lie down on the Suelo with your Piernas fully extended and arms to the Lateral of your torso with the palms on the Suelo. Your arms should be stationary for the entire exercise. Move your Piernas up so that your tAltos are perpendicular to the Suelo and feet are together and parallel to the Suelo. This is the starting position. While inhaling, move your Piernas towards the torso as you roll your pelvis Espaldawards and you Elevación your Caderas off the Suelo. At the end of this movement your knees will be touching your Pecho. Hold the contraction for a second and move your Piernas Espalda to the starting position while exhaling. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Crujido de Cuerda
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Kneel 1-2 feet in front of a cable system with a rope attached.
After selecting an appropriate weight, grasp the rope with both hands reaching overhead. Your torso should be upright in the starting position.
To begin, flex at the spine, attempting to bring your rib cage to your legs as you pull the cable down.
Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then slowly return to the starting position.
These can be done with twists or to the side to hit the obliques.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Kneel 1-2 feet in Frontal of a Polea system with a rope attached. After selecting an appropriate weight, grasp the rope with both hands reaching Sobre la Cabeza. Your torso should be Vertical in the starting position. To begin, flex at the spine, attempting to bring your rib cage to your Piernas as you pull the Polea down. Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then sBajoly return to the starting position. These can be done with twists or to the Lateral to hit the obliques.

Abdominales.name: Giro Ruso
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you perpendicular to your torso and with the hands clasped. This is the starting position.
Twist your torso to the right side until your arms are parallel with the floor while breathing out.
Hold the contraction for a second and move back to the starting position while breathing out. Now move to the opposite side performing the same techniques you applied to the right side.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Lie down on the Suelo placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your Piernas should be bent at the knees. Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your tAltos. Your arms should be fully extended in Frontal of you perpendicular to your torso and with the hands clasped. This is the starting position. Twist your torso to the right Lateral until your arms are parallel with the Suelo while breathing out. Hold the contraction for a second and move Espalda to the starting position while breathing out. Now move to the opposite Lateral performing the same techniques you applied to the right Lateral. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Sentado Barra Twist
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Start out by sitting at the end of a flat bench with a barbell placed on top of your thighs. Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other.
Grip the bar with your palms facing down and make sure your hands are wider than shoulder width apart from each other. Begin to lift the barbell up over your head until your arms are fully extended.
Now lower the barbell behind your head until it is resting along the base of your neck. This is the starting position.
While keeping your feet and head stationary, move your waist from side to side so that your oblique muscles feel the contraction. Only move from side to side as far as your waist will allow you to go. Stretching or moving too far can cause an injury to occur. Tip: Use a slow and controlled motion.
Remember to breathe out while twisting your body to the side and in when moving back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Start out by sitting at the end of a flat bench with a Barra placed on top of your tAltos. Your feet should be Hombro width apart from each other. Grip the bar with your palms facing down and make sure your hands are wider than Hombro width apart from each other. Begin to lift the Barra up over your head until your arms are fully extended. Now Bajoer the Barra behind your head until it is resting along the base of your neck. This is the starting position. While keeping your feet and head stationary, move your waist from Lateral to Lateral so that your oblique Muslos feel the contraction. Only move from Lateral to Lateral as far as your waist will alBajo you to go. Stretching or moving too far can cause an injury to occur. Tip: Use a sBajo and controlled motion. Remember to breathe out while twisting your body to the Lateral and in when moving Espalda to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Sentado Flat Bench Pierna Pull-in
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Sit on a bench with the legs stretched out in front of you slightly below parallel and your arms holding on to the sides of the bench. Your torso should be leaning backwards around a 45-degree angle from the bench. This will be your starting position.
Bring the knees in toward you as you move your torso closer to them at the same time. Breathe out as you perform this movement.
After a second pause, go back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Sit on a bench with the Piernas stretched out in Frontal of you slightly beBajo parallel and your arms holding on to the Laterals of the bench. Your torso should be leaning Espaldawards around a 45-degree angle from the bench. This will be your starting position. Bring the knees in toward you as you move your torso closer to them at the same time. Breathe out as you perform this movement. After a second pause, go Espalda to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Dragon Flag Tuck
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Sit on a bench with the legs stretched out in front of you slightly below parallel and your arms holding on to the sides of the bench. Your torso should be leaning backwards around a 45-degree angle from the bench. This will be your starting position.
Bring the knees in toward you as you move your torso closer to them at the same time. Breathe out as you perform this movement.
After a second pause, go back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Sit on a bench with the Piernas stretched out in Frontal of you slightly beBajo parallel and your arms holding on to the Laterals of the bench. Your torso should be leaning Espaldawards around a 45-degree angle from the bench. This will be your starting position. Bring the knees in toward you as you move your torso closer to them at the same time. Breathe out as you perform this movement. After a second pause, go Espalda to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Abdominales
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind your head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the starting position.
Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Breathe out when performing this part of the exercise.
Once you feel the contraction for a second, lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Lie down on the Suelo placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your Piernas should be bent at the knees. Place your hands behind your head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the starting position. Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your tAltos. Breathe out when performing this part of the exercise. Once you feel the contraction for a second, Bajoer your upper body Espalda down to the starting position while inhaling. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Multipower Máquina Cadera Elevación
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Position a bench in the rack and load the bar to an appropriate weight. Lie down on the bench, placing the bottom of your feet against the bar. Unlock the bar and extend your legs. You may need to use your hands to assist you. For added stability grasp the sides of the Smith Machine. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by rotating your pelvis, flexing your spine to raise your hips off of the bench. Maintain a slight bend in the knees throughout the motion.
After a brief pause, return the hips to the bench.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Position a bench in the rack and load the bar to an appropriate weight. Lie down on the bench, placing the bottom of your feet against the bar. Unlock the bar and extend your Piernas. You may need to use your hands to assist you. For added stability grasp the Laterals of the MultiPower. This will be your starting position. Initiate the movement by rotating your pelvis, flexing your spine to Elevación your Caderas off of the bench. Maintain a slight bend in the knees throughout the motion. After a brief pause, return the Caderas to the bench. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Lanzador de Hechizos
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a pronated grip. Your feet should be wide with your hips and knees extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by pulling both of the dumbbells to one side next to your hip, rotating your torso.
Keeping your arms straight and the dumbbells parallel to the ground, rotate your torso to swing the weights to your opposite side.
Continue alternating, rotating from one side to the other until the set is complete.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Hold a Mancuerna in each hand with a pronated grip. Your feet should be wide with your Caderas and knees extended. This will be your starting position. Begin the movement by pulling both of the Mancuernas to one Lateral next to your Cadera, rotating your torso. Keeping your arms straight and the Mancuernas parallel to the ground, rotate your torso to swing the weights to your opposite Lateral. Continue Alternando, rotating from one Lateral to the other until the set is complete.

Abdominales.name: Araña Crawl
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Begin in a prone position on the floor. Support your weight on your hands and toes, with your feet together and your body straight. Your arms should be bent to 90 degrees. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by raising one foot off of the ground. Externally rotate the leg and bring the knee toward your elbow, as far forward as possible.
Return this leg to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Begin in a Tumbado Prono position on the Suelo. Support your weight on your hands and toes, with your feet together and your body straight. Your arms should be bent to 90 degrees. This will be your starting position. Initiate the movement by raising one foot off of the ground. Externally rotate the Pierna and bring the knee toward your elbow, as far forward as possible. Return this Pierna to the starting position and repeat on the opposite Lateral.

Abdominales.name: De Pie Polea Lift
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Connect a standard handle on a tower, and move the cable to the lowest pulley position.
With your side to the cable, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable. Your outstretched arm should be aligned with the cable.
With your feet positioned shoulder width apart, squat down and grab the handle with both hands. Your arms should still be fully extended.
In one motion, pull the handle up and across your body until your arms are in a fully-extended position above your head.
Keep your back straight and your arms close to your body as you pivot your back foot and straighten your legs to get a full range of motion.
Retract your arms and then your body. Return to the neutral position in a slow and controlled manner.
Repeat to failure.
Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite side.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Connect a Estándar handle on a tower, and move the Polea to the Bajoest pulley position. With your Lateral to the Polea, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the Polea. Your outstretched arm should be aligned with the Polea. With your feet positioned Hombro width apart, Sentadilla down and grab the handle with both hands. Your arms should still be fully extended. In one motion, pull the handle up and across your body until your arms are in a fully-extended position above your head. Keep your Espalda straight and your arms close to your body as you pivot your Espalda foot and straighten your Piernas to get a full range of motion. Retract your arms and then your body. Return to the neutral position in a sBajo and controlled manner. Repeat to failure. Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite Lateral.

Abdominales.name: De Pie Polea Wood Chop
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Connect a standard handle to a tower, and move the cable to the highest pulley position.
With your side to the cable, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable. Your outstretched arm should be aligned with the cable.
With your feet positioned shoulder width apart, reach upward with your other hand and grab the handle with both hands. Your arms should still be fully extended.
In one motion, pull the handle down and across your body to your front knee while rotating your torso.
Keep your back and arms straight and core tight while you pivot your back foot and bend your knees to get a full range of motion.
Maintain your stance and straight arms. Return to the neutral position in a slow and controlled manner.
Repeat to failure.
Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite side.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Connect a Estándar handle to a tower, and move the Polea to the Altoest pulley position. With your Lateral to the Polea, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the Polea. Your outstretched arm should be aligned with the Polea. With your feet positioned Hombro width apart, reach upward with your other hand and grab the handle with both hands. Your arms should still be fully extended. In one motion, pull the handle down and across your body to your Frontal knee while rotating your torso. Keep your Espalda and arms straight and core tight while you pivot your Espalda foot and bend your knees to get a full range of motion. Maintain your stance and straight arms. Return to the neutral position in a sBajo and controlled manner. Repeat to failure. Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite Lateral.

Abdominales.name: De Pie Rope Crunch
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Attach a rope to a high pulley and select an appropriate weight.
Stand with your back to the cable tower. Take the rope with both hands over your shoulders, holding it to your upper chest. This will be your starting position.
Perform the movement by flexing the spine, crunching the weight down as far as you can.
Hold the peak contraction for a moment before returning to the starting position.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Attach a rope to a Alto pulley and select an appropriate weight. Stand with your Espalda to the Polea tower. Take the rope with both hands over your Hombros, holding it to your upper Pecho. This will be your starting position. Perform the movement by flexing the spine, Crunching the weight down as far as you can. Hold the peak contraction for a moment before returning to the starting position.

Abdominales.name: Fallout Suspendido
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Adjust the straps so the handles are at an appropriate height, below waist level.
Begin standing and grasping the handles. Lean into the straps, moving to an incline push-up position. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your arms straight, lean further into the suspension straps, bringing your body closer to the ground, allowing your shoulders to extend, raising your arms up and over your head.
Maintain a neutral spine and keep the rest of your body straight, your shoulders being the only joints allowed to move.
Pause during the peak contraction, and then return to the starting position.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Adjust the straps so the handles are at an appropriate height, beBajo waist level. Begin De Pie and grasping the handles. Lean into the straps, moving to an Inclinado push-up position. This will be your starting position. Keeping your arms straight, lean further into the suspension straps, bringing your body closer to the ground, alBajoing your Hombros to extend, raising your arms up and over your head. Maintain a neutral spine and keep the rest of your body straight, your Hombros being the only joints alBajoed to move. Pause during the peak contraction, and then return to the starting position.

Abdominales.name: Suspended Inverso Crunch
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Secure a set of suspension straps with the handles hanging about a foot off of the ground. Move yourself into a pushup plank position facing away from the rack.
Place your feet into the handles. You should maintain a straight posture, not allowing the hips to sag. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing the knees and hips, drawing the knees to your torso. As you do so, anteriorly tilt your pelvis, allowing your spine to flex.
At the top of the controlled motion, return to the starting position.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Secure a set of suspension straps with the handles Colgadoing about a foot off of the ground. Move yourself into a pushup Plancha position facing away from the rack. Place your feet into the handles. You should maintain a straight posture, not alBajoing the Caderas to sag. This will be your starting position. Begin the movement by flexing the knees and Caderas, drawing the knees to your torso. As you do so, anteriorly tilt your pelvis, alBajoing your spine to flex. At the top of the controlled motion, return to the starting position.

Abdominales.name: Crunch con Flexión
Abdominales.instructions_en:
To begin, lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your back pressed against the floor. Your arms should be lying across your sides with the palms facing down.
Your legs should be crossed by wrapping one ankle around the other. Slowly elevate your legs up in the air until your thighs are perpendicular to the floor with a slight bend at the knees. Note: Your knees and toes should be parallel to the floor as opposed to the thighs.
Move your arms from the floor and cross them so they are resting on your chest. This is the starting position.
While keeping your lower back pressed against the floor, slowly lift your torso. Remember to exhale while perform this part of the exercise.
Slowly begin to lower your torso back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: To begin, lie down on the Suelo or an exercise mat with your Espalda Pressed against the Suelo. Your arms should be Recostado across your Laterals with the palms facing down. Your Piernas should be crossed by wrapping one ankle around the other. SBajoly elevate your Piernas up in the air until your tAltos are perpendicular to the Suelo with a slight bend at the knees. Note: Your knees and toes should be parallel to the Suelo as opposed to the tAltos. Move your arms from the Suelo and cross them so they are resting on your Pecho. This is the starting position. While keeping your Bajoer Espalda Pressed against the Suelo, sBajoly lift your torso. Remember to exhale while perform this part of the exercise. SBajoly begin to Bajoer your torso Espalda down to the starting position while inhaling. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Weighted Ball Lateral Bend
Abdominales.instructions_en:
To begin, lie down on an exercise ball with your left side of the torso (waist, hips and shoulder) pressed against the ball.
Your feet should be on the floor while your legs are crossed and hanging from the ball. Hold a weighted plate with your right hand directly to the right side of your head. Tip: Make sure the smooth side of the plate is resting against your head.
Place your left arm across your torso so that your palm is on your obliques. There should be a right angle between your left forearm and upper arm. This is the starting position.
Raise the side of your torso up by laterally flexing at the waist while exhaling.
Hold the contraction for a second and slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise.
Abdominales.instructions_es: To begin, lie down on an exercise ball with your left Lateral of the torso (waist, Caderas and Hombro) Pressed against the ball. Your feet should be on the Suelo while your Piernas are crossed and Colgadoing from the ball. Hold a weighted Disco with your right hand directly to the right Lateral of your head. Tip: Make sure the smooth Lateral of the Disco is resting against your head. Place your left arm across your torso so that your palm is on your obliques. There should be a right angle between your left foPosteriorm and upper arm. This is the starting position. Elevación the Lateral of your torso up by Laterally flexing at the waist while exhaling. Hold the contraction for a second and sBajoly Bajoer yourself Espalda down to the starting position while inhaling. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. Switch Laterals and repeat the exercise.

Abdominales.name: Crujidos Ponderados
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.
Hold a weight to your chest, or you may hold it extended above your torso. This will be your starting position.
Now, exhale and slowly begin to roll your shoulders off the floor. Your shoulders should come up off the floor about 4 inches while your lower back remains on the floor.
At the top of the movement, flex your abdominals and hold for a brief pause.
Then inhale and slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Lie flat on your Espalda with your feet flat on the ground or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle. Hold a weight to your Pecho, or you may hold it extended above your torso. This will be your starting position. Now, exhale and sBajoly begin to roll your Hombros off the Suelo. Your Hombros should come up off the Suelo about 4 inches while your Bajoer Espalda remains on the Suelo. At the top of the movement, flex your Abdominals and hold for a brief pause. Then inhale and sBajoly Bajoer yourself Espalda down to the starting position.

Abdominales.name: Weighted Abdominaless - With Bandas
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Start out by strapping the bands around the base of the decline bench. Place the handles towards the inside of the decline bench so that when lying down, you can reach for both of them.
Position your legs through the decline machine until they are secured. Now reach for the exercise bands with both hands. Use a pronated (palms forward) grip to grasp the handles. Position them near your collar bone and rotate your wrist to a neutral grip (palms facing the torso). Note: Your arms should remain stationary throughout the exercise. This is the starting position.
Move your torso upward until your upper body is perpendicular to the floor while exhaling. Hold the contraction for a second and lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Start out by strapping the Bandas around the base of the Declinado bench. Place the handles towards the inLateral of the Declinado bench so that when Recostado down, you can reach for both of them. Position your Piernas through the Declinado Máquina until they are secured. Now reach for the exercise Bandas with both hands. Use a pronated (palms forward) grip to grasp the handles. Position them near your collar bone and rotate your Muñeca to a Agarre Neutro (palms facing the torso). Note: Your arms should remain stationary throughout the exercise. This is the starting position. Move your torso upward until your upper body is perpendicular to the Suelo while exhaling. Hold the contraction for a second and Bajoer your upper body Espalda down to the starting position while inhaling. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Sprints de Viento
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Hang from a pull-up bar using a pronated grip. Your arms and legs should be extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by quickly raising one knee as high as you can. Do not swing your body or your legs. 3
Immediately reverse the motion, returning that leg to the starting position. Simultaneously raise the opposite knee as high as possible.
Continue alternating between legs until the set is complete.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Colgado from a pull-up bar using a pronated grip. Your arms and Piernas should be extended. This will be your starting position. Begin by quickly raising one knee as Alto as you can. Do not swing your body or your Piernas. 3 Immediately Inverso the motion, returning that Pierna to the starting position. Simultaneously Elevación the opposite knee as Alto as possible. Continue Alternando between Piernas until the set is complete.

Abdominales.name: Curl en la Parte Inferior de la Espalda
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Lie on your stomach with your arms out to your sides. This will be your starting position.
Using your lower back muscles, extend your spine lifting your chest off of the ground. Do not use your arms to push yourself up. Keep your head up during the movement. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Lie on your stomach with your arms out to your Laterals. This will be your starting position. Using your Bajoer Espalda Muslos, extend your spine lifting your Pecho off of the ground. Do not use your arms to push yourself up. Keep your head up during the movement. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Estiramiento por Encima de la Cabeza
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Standing straight up, lace your fingers together and open your palms to the ceiling. Keep your shoulders down as you extend your arms up.
To create a full torso stretch, pull your tailbone down and stabilize your torso as you do this. Stretch the muscles on both the front and the back of the torso.
Abdominales.instructions_es: De Pie straight up, lace your fingers together and open your palms to the ceiling. Keep your Hombros down as you extend your arms up. To create a full torso stretch, pull your tailbone down and stabilize your torso as you do this. Stretch the Muslos on both the Frontal and the Espalda of the torso.

Abdominales.name: Patada de Tijera
Abdominales.instructions_en:
To begin, lie down with your back pressed against the floor or on an exercise mat (optional). Your arms should be fully extended to the sides with your palms facing down. Note: The arms should be stationary the entire time.
With a slight bend at the knees, lift your legs up so that your heels are about 6 inches off the ground. This is the starting position.
Now lift your left leg up to about a 45 degree angle while your right leg is lowered until the heel is about 2-3 inches from the ground.
Switch movements by raising your right leg up and lowering your left leg. Remember to breathe while performing this exercise.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: To begin, lie down with your Espalda Pressed against the Suelo or on an exercise mat (optional). Your arms should be fully extended to the Laterals with your palms facing down. Note: The arms should be stationary the entire time. With a slight bend at the knees, lift your Piernas up so that your heels are about 6 inches off the ground. This is the starting position. Now lift your left Pierna up to about a 45 degree angle while your right Pierna is Bajoered until the heel is about 2-3 inches from the ground. Switch movements by raising your right Pierna up and Bajoering your left Pierna. Remember to breathe while performing this exercise. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Estiramiento por Encima de la Cabeza Sentado
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Sit up straight on an exercise mat.
Touch the soles of your feet together with your feet six to eight inches in front of your hips.
Place one hand on the floor beside you and your other hand behind your head.
Lift your elbow to the ceiling as you incline your torso to the other side. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch sides.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Sit up straight on an exercise mat. Touch the soles of your feet together with your feet six to eight inches in Frontal of your Caderas. Place one hand on the Suelo beLateral you and your other hand behind your head. Lift your elbow to the ceiling as you Inclinado your torso to the other Lateral. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch Laterals.

Abdominales.name: Estiramiento Lateral de Pie
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Take a slightly wider than hip distance stance with your knees slightly bent.
Place your right hand on your right hip to support the spine.
Raise your left arm in a vertical line and place your left hand behind your head. Keep it there as you incline your torso to the right.
Keep your weight evenly distributed between both legs (don't lean into your left hip). Switch sides.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Take a slightly wider than Cadera distance stance with your knees slightly bent. Place your right hand on your right Cadera to support the spine. Elevación your left arm in a vertical line and place your left hand behind your head. Keep it there as you Inclinado your torso to the right. Keep your weight evenly distributed between both Piernas (don't lean into your left Cadera). Switch Laterals.

Abdominales.name: Aspiradora Estomacal
Abdominales.instructions_en:
To begin, stand straight with your feet shoulder width apart from each other. Place your hands on your hips. This is the starting position.
Now slowly inhale as much air as possible and then start to exhale as much as possible while bringing your stomach in as much as possible and hold this position. Try to visualize your navel touching your backbone.
One isometric contraction is around 20 seconds. During the 20 second hold, try to breathe normally. Then inhale and bring your stomach back to the starting position.
Once you have practiced this exercise, try to perform this exercise for longer than 20 seconds. Tip: You can work your way up to 40-60 seconds.
Repeat for the recommended amount of sets.
Abdominales.instructions_es: To begin, stand straight with your feet Hombro width apart from each other. Place your hands on your Caderas. This is the starting position. Now sBajoly inhale as much air as possible and then start to exhale as much as possible while bringing your stomach in as much as possible and hold this position. Try to visualize your navel touching your Espaldabone. One isometric contraction is around 20 seconds. During the 20 second hold, try to breathe normally. Then inhale and bring your stomach Espalda to the starting position. Once you have practiced this exercise, try to perform this exercise for longer than 20 seconds. Tip: You can work your way up to 40-60 seconds. Repeat for the recommended amount of sets.

Abdominales.name: Rotación del Torso
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Stand upright holding an exercise ball with both hands. Extend your arms so the ball is straight out in front of you. This will be your starting position.
Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your eyes on the ball as you move. Now, rotate back to the opposite direction. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Stand Vertical holding an exercise ball with both hands. Extend your arms so the ball is straight out in Frontal of you. This will be your starting position. Rotate your torso to one Lateral, keeping your eyes on the ball as you move. Now, rotate Espalda to the opposite direction. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.

Abdominales.name: Balón Medicinal de Giro Completo
Abdominales.instructions_en:
For this exercise you will need a medicine ball and a partner. Stand back to back with your partner, spaced 2-3 feet apart. This will be your starting position.
Hold the ball in front of the trunk. Open the hips and turn the shoulders at the same time as your partner.
For full rotation, you and your partner should twist in the same direction, i.e. counter-clockwise.
Pass the ball to your partner, and both of you can now twist in the opposite direction to repeat the procedure.
Abdominales.instructions_es: For this exercise you will need a medicine ball and a partner. Stand Espalda to Espalda with your partner, spaced 2-3 feet apart. This will be your starting position. Hold the ball in Frontal of the trunk. Open the Caderas and turn the Hombros at the same time as your partner. For full rotation, you and your partner should twist in the same direction, i.e. counter-clockwise. Pass the ball to your partner, and both of you can now twist in the opposite direction to repeat the procedure.

Abdominales.name: Trineogemartillo Swings
Abdominales.instructions_en:
You will need a tire and a sledgehammer for this exercise. Stand in front of the tire about two feet away from it with a staggered stance. Grip the sledgehammer.
If you are right handed, your left hand should be at the bottom of the handle, and your right hand should be choking up closer to the head.
As you bring the sledge up, your right hand slides toward the head; as you swing down, your right hand will slide down to join your left hand. Slam it down as hard as you can against the tire. Control the bounce of the hammer off of the tire.
Repeat on the other side.
Abdominales.instructions_es: You will need a tire and a TrineogeMartillo for this exercise. Stand in Frontal of the tire about two feet away from it with a staggered stance. Grip the TrineogeMartillo. If you are right handed, your left hand should be at the bottom of the handle, and your right hand should be choking up closer to the head. As you bring the Trineoge up, your right hand slides toward the head; as you swing down, your right hand will slide down to join your left hand. Slam it down as hard as you can against the tire. Control the bounce of the Martillo off of the tire. Repeat on the other Lateral.

Abdominales.name: Supine One-arm Sobre la Cabeza Thremo
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Lay on the ground on your back with your knees bent. Hold the ball with one hand, extending the arm fully behind your head. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement at the shoulder, throwing the ball directly forward of you as you sit up, attempting to go for maximum distance.
The ball can be thrown to a partner or bounced off of a wall.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Lay on the ground on your Espalda with your knees bent. Hold the ball with one hand, extending the arm fully behind your head. This will be your starting position. Initiate the movement at the Hombro, thRemoing the ball directly forward of you as you sit up, attempting to go for maximum distance. The ball can be thRemon to a partner or bounced off of a wall.

Abdominales.name: Lanzamiento por Encima de la Cabeza
Abdominales.instructions_en:
Lay on the ground on your back with your knees bent.
Hold the ball with both hands, extending the arms fully behind your head. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement at the shoulder, throwing the ball directly forward of you as you sit up, attempting to go for maximum distance.
The ball can be thrown to a partner or bounced off of a wall.
Abdominales.instructions_es: Lay on the ground on your Espalda with your knees bent. Hold the ball with both hands, extending the arms fully behind your head. This will be your starting position. Initiate the movement at the Hombro, thRemoing the ball directly forward of you as you sit up, attempting to go for maximum distance. The ball can be thRemon to a partner or bounced off of a wall.

Gemelos.name: Prensa de Pantorrilla
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.
Straighten the legs by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible.
After a brief pause, reverse the motion and repeat.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Adjust the seat so that your Piernas are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform. Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position. Straighten the Piernas by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by Pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible. After a brief pause, Inverso the motion and repeat.

Gemelos.name: Prensa de Pantorrilla en la Máquina de Prensa de Piernas
Gemelos.name_en: Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance.
Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you without locking your knees. (Note: In some leg press units you can leave the safety bars on for increased safety. If your leg press unit allows for this, then this is the preferred method of performing the exercise.) Your torso and the legs should make perfect 90-degree angle. Now carefully place your toes and balls of your feet on the lower portion of the platform with the heels extending off. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.
Press on the platform by raising your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Using a Prensa de Piernas Máquina, sit down on the Máquina and place your Piernas on the platform directly in Frontal of you at a medium (Hombro width) foot stance. Bajoer the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and Press the platform all the way up until your Piernas are fully extended in Frontal of you without locking your knees. (Note: In some Prensa de Piernas units you can leave the safety bars on for increased safety. If your Prensa de Piernas unit alBajos for this, then this is the preferred method of performing the exercise.) Your torso and the Piernas should make perfect 90-degree angle. Now carefully place your toes and balls of your feet on the Bajoer portion of the platform with the heels extending off. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position. Press on the platform by raising your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as Alto as possible and flexing your Gemelo. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go Espalda down. Go Espalda sBajoly to the starting position as you breathe in by Bajoering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: Elevación de Gemelos con Mancuerna
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Hang on to a sturdy object for balance and stand on a dumbbell handle, preferably one with round plates so that it rolls as in this manner you have to work harder to stabilize yourself; thus increasing the effectiveness of the exercise.
Now roll your foot slightly forward so that you can get a nice stretch of the calf. This will be your starting position.
Lift the calf as you roll your foot over the top of the handle so that you get a full extension. Exhale during the execution of this movement. Contract the calf hard at the top and hold for a second. Tip: As you come up, roll the dumbbell slightly backward.
Now inhale as you roll the dumbbell slightly forward as you come down to get a better stretch.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Colgado on to a sturdy object for balance and stand on a Mancuerna handle, preferably one with round Discos so that it rolls as in this manner you have to work harder to stabilize yourself; thus increasing the effectiveness of the exercise. Now roll your foot slightly forward so that you can get a nice stretch of the Gemelo. This will be your starting position. Lift the Gemelo as you roll your foot over the top of the handle so that you get a full Extensión. Exhale during the execution of this movement. Contract the Gemelo hard at the top and hold for a second. Tip: As you come up, roll the Mancuerna slightly Espaldaward. Now inhale as you roll the Mancuerna slightly forward as you come down to get a better stretch. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: Gemelo Elevacións - With Bandas
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Grab an exercise band and stand on it with your toes making sure that the length of the band between the foot and the arms is the same for both sides.
While holding the handles of the band, raise the arms to the side of your head as if you were getting ready to perform a shoulder press. The palms should be facing forward with the elbows bent and to the sides. This movement will create tension on the band. This will be your starting position.
Keeping the hands by your shoulder, stand up on your toes as you exhale and contract the calves hard at the top of the movement.
After a one second contraction, slowly go back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Grab an exercise Banda and stand on it with your toes making sure that the length of the Banda between the foot and the arms is the same for both Laterals. While holding the handles of the Banda, Elevación the arms to the Lateral of your head as if you were getting ready to perform a Press de Hombros. The palms should be facing forward with the elbows bent and to the Laterals. This movement will create tension on the Banda. This will be your starting position. Keeping the hands by your Hombro, stand up on your toes as you exhale and contract the calves hard at the top of the movement. After a one second contraction, sBajoly go Espalda down to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: Elevaciones de Gemelo Tipo Burro
Gemelos.instructions_en:
For this exercise you will need access to a donkey calf raise machine. Start by positioning your lower back and hips under the padded lever provided. The tailbone area should be the one making contact with the pad.
Place both of your arms on the side handles and place the balls of your feet on the calf block with the heels extending off. Align the toes forward, inward or outward, depending on the area you wish to target, and straighten the knees without locking them. This will be your starting position.
Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: For this exercise you will need access to a Burro Gemelo Elevación Máquina. Start by positioning your Bajoer Espalda and Caderas under the padded lever provided. The tailbone area should be the one making contact with the pad. Place both of your arms on the Lateral handles and place the balls of your feet on the Gemelo Bloque with the heels extending off. Align the toes forward, inward or outward, depending on the area you wish to target, and straighten the knees without locking them. This will be your starting position. Elevación your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as Alto as possible and flexing your Gemelo. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go Espalda down. Go Espalda sBajoly to the starting position as you breathe in by Bajoering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: Mancuerna Sentado One-pierna Gemelo Elevación
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Place a block on the floor about 12 inches from a flat bench.
Sit on a flat bench and place a dumbbell on your upper left thigh about 3 inches above your knee.
Now place the ball of your left foot on the block. This will be your starting position.
Raise your toes up as high as possible as you exhale and you contract your calf muscle. Hold the contraction for a second.
Slowly return to the starting position, stretching as far down as possible.
Repeat for your prescribed number of repetitions and then repeat with the right leg.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Place a Bloque on the Suelo about 12 inches from a flat bench. Sit on a flat bench and place a Mancuerna on your upper left tAlto about 3 inches above your knee. Now place the ball of your left foot on the Bloque. This will be your starting position. Elevación your toes up as Alto as possible as you exhale and you contract your Gemelo Muslo. Hold the contraction for a second. SBajoly return to the starting position, stretching as far down as possible. Repeat for your prescribed number of repetitions and then repeat with the right Pierna.

Gemelos.name: Rocking de Pie Gemelo Elevación
Gemelos.instructions_en:
This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place it on the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck).
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.
Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance. Also maintain a straight back and keep the knees with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position.
Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending (other than the slight initial bend we created during positioning) at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Now lift your toes by contracting the tibia muscles in the front of the calves as you breathe out.
Hold for a second and bring them back down as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: This exercise is best performed inLateral a Sentadilla rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place it on the Espalda of your Hombros (slightly beBajo the neck). Hold on to the bar using both arms at each Lateral and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your Piernas and at the same time straightening your torso. Step away from the rack and position your Piernas using a Hombro width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance. Also maintain a straight Espalda and keep the knees with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Elevación your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as Alto as possible and flexing your Gemelo. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending (other than the slight initial bend we created during positioning) at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go Espalda down. Go Espalda sBajoly to the starting position as you breathe in by Bajoering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched. Now lift your toes by contracting the tibia Muslos in the Frontal of the calves as you breathe out. Hold for a second and bring them Espalda down as you breathe in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: Sentado Gemelo Elevación
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Sit on the machine and place your toes on the lower portion of the platform provided with the heels extending off. Choose the toe positioning of your choice (forward, in, or out) as per the beginning of this chapter.
Place your lower thighs under the lever pad, which will need to be adjusted according to the height of your thighs. Now place your hands on top of the lever pad in order to prevent it from slipping forward.
Lift the lever slightly by pushing your heels up and release the safety bar. This will be your starting position.
Slowly lower your heels by bending at the ankles until the calves are fully stretched. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Raise the heels by extending the ankles as high as possible as you contract the calves and breathe out. Hold the top contraction for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Sit on the Máquina and place your toes on the Bajoer portion of the platform provided with the heels extending off. Choose the toe positioning of your choice (forward, in, or out) as per the beginning of this chapter. Place your Bajoer tAltos under the lever pad, which will need to be adjusted according to the height of your tAltos. Now place your hands on top of the lever pad in order to prevent it from slipping forward. Lift the lever slightly by pushing your heels up and release the safety bar. This will be your starting position. SBajoly Bajoer your heels by bending at the ankles until the calves are fully stretched. Inhale as you perform this movement. Elevación the heels by extending the ankles as Alto as possible as you contract the calves and breathe out. Hold the top contraction for a second. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: Elevación de Gemelos en Step
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Place a block or weight plate below the bar on the Smith machine. Set the bar to a position that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step onto the plates with the balls of your feet and place the bar on the back of your shoulders.
Take the bar with both hands facing forward. Rotate the bar to unrack it. This will be your starting position.
Raise your heels as high as possible by pushing off of the balls of your feet, flexing your calf at the top of the contraction. Your knees should remain extended. Hold the contracted position for a second before you start to go back down.
Return slowly to the starting position as you breathe in while lowering your heels.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Place a Bloque or weight Disco beBajo the bar on the MultiPower. Set the bar to a position that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step onto the Discos with the balls of your feet and place the bar on the Espalda of your Hombros. Take the bar with both hands facing forward. Rotate the bar to unrack it. This will be your starting position. Elevación your heels as Alto as possible by pushing off of the balls of your feet, flexing your Gemelo at the top of the contraction. Your knees should remain extended. Hold the contracted position for a second before you start to go Espalda down. Return sBajoly to the starting position as you breathe in while Bajoering your heels. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: Multipower Inverso Gemelo Elevacións
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Adjust the barbell on the smith machine to fit your height and align a raised platform right under the bar.
Stand on the platform with the heels of your feet secured on top of it with the balls of your feet extending off it. Position your toes facing forward with a shoulder width stance.
Now, place your shoulders under the barbell while maintaining the foot positioning described and push the barbell up by extending your hips and knees until your torso is standing erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Tip: The barbell on your back is only for balance purposes.
Raise the balls of your feet as you breathe out by extending your toes as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position for a second before you start to go back down.
Slowly go back down to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering the balls of your feet and toes.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Adjust the Barra on the MultiPower to fit your height and align a Elevaciónd platform right under the bar. Stand on the platform with the heels of your feet secured on top of it with the balls of your feet extending off it. Position your toes facing forward with a Hombro width stance. Now, place your Hombros under the Barra while maintaining the foot positioning described and push the Barra up by extending your Caderas and knees until your torso is De Pie erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Tip: The Barra on your Espalda is only for balance purposes. Elevación the balls of your feet as you breathe out by extending your toes as Alto as possible and flexing your Gemelo. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position for a second before you start to go Espalda down. SBajoly go Espalda down to the starting position as you breathe in by Bajoering the balls of your feet and toes. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: Gemelos de Pié Guiado
Gemelos.instructions_en:
This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the bar on the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck).
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.
Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Tip: For better range of motion you may also place the ball of your feet on a wooden block but be careful as this option requires more balance and a sturdy block.
Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: This exercise is best performed inLateral a Sentadilla rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the bar on the Espalda of your Hombros (slightly beBajo the neck). Hold on to the bar using both arms at each Lateral and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your Piernas and at the same time straightening your torso. Step away from the rack and position your Piernas using a Hombro width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight Espalda. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Tip: For better range of motion you may also place the ball of your feet on a wooden Bloque but be careful as this option requires more balance and a sturdy Bloque. Elevación your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as Alto as possible and flexing your Gemelo. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go Espalda down. Go Espalda sBajoly to the starting position as you breathe in by Bajoering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: De Pie Gemelo Elevacións
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Adjust the padded lever of the calf raise machine to fit your height.
Place your shoulders under the pads provided and position your toes facing forward (or using any of the two other positions described at the beginning of the chapter). The balls of your feet should be secured on top of the calf block with the heels extending off it. Push the lever up by extending your hips and knees until your torso is standing erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.
Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Adjust the padded lever of the Gemelo Elevación Máquina to fit your height. Place your Hombros under the pads provided and position your toes facing forward (or using any of the two other positions described at the beginning of the chapter). The balls of your feet should be secured on top of the Gemelo Bloque with the heels extending off it. Push the lever up by extending your Caderas and knees until your torso is De Pie erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position. Elevación your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as Alto as possible and flexing your Gemelo. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go Espalda down. Go Espalda sBajoly to the starting position as you breathe in by Bajoering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: De Pie Mancuerna Gemelo Elevación
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides. Place the ball of the foot on a sturdy and stable wooden board (that is around 2-3 inches tall) while your heels extend off and touch the floor. This will be your starting position.
With the toes pointing either straight (to hit all parts equally), inwards (for emphasis on the outer head) or outwards (for emphasis on the inner head), raise the heels off the floor as you exhale by contracting the calves. Hold the top contraction for a second.
As you inhale, go back to the starting position by slowly lowering the heels.
Repeat for the recommended amount of times.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Stand with your torso Vertical holding two Mancuernas in your hands by your Laterals. Place the ball of the foot on a sturdy and stable wooden board (that is around 2-3 inches tall) while your heels extend off and touch the Suelo. This will be your starting position. With the toes pointing either straight (to hit all parts equally), inwards (for emphasis on the outer head) or outwards (for emphasis on the inner head), Elevación the heels off the Suelo as you exhale by contracting the calves. Hold the top contraction for a second. As you inhale, go Espalda to the starting position by sBajoly Bajoering the heels. Repeat for the recommended amount of times.

Gemelos.name: Rmn Tibial Anterior
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Begin seated on the ground with your legs bent and your feet on the floor.
Using a Muscle Roller or a rolling pin, apply pressure to the muscles on the outside of your shins. Work from just below the knee to above the ankle, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on the other leg.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Begin Sentado on the ground with your Piernas bent and your feet on the Suelo. Using a Muslo Roller or a rolling pin, apply Pressure to the Muslos on the outLateral of your shins. Work from just beBajo the knee to above the ankle, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on the other Pierna.

Gemelos.name: Knee Circles
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Stand with your legs together and hands by your waist.
Now move your knees in a circular motion as you breathe normally.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Stand with your Piernas together and hands by your waist. Now move your knees in a circular motion as you breathe normally. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Gemelos.name: Músculos Peroneos
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Lay on your side, supporting your weight on your forearm and on a foam roller placed on the outside of your lower leg. Your upper leg can either be on top of your lower leg, or you can cross it in front of you. This will be your starting position.
Raise your hips off of the ground and begin to roll from below the knee to above the ankle on the side of your leg, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on the other leg.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Lay on your Lateral, supporting your weight on your foPosteriorm and on a foam roller placed on the outLateral of your Bajoer Pierna. Your upper Pierna can either be on top of your Bajoer Pierna, or you can cross it in Frontal of you. This will be your starting position. Elevación your Caderas off of the ground and begin to roll from beBajo the knee to above the ankle on the Lateral of your Pierna, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on the other Pierna.

Gemelos.name: Peroneals Stretch
Gemelos.instructions_en:
In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. This will be your starting position.
With the leg extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is inverted, with the inside of the foot being pulled towards you. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then switch sides.
Gemelos.instructions_es: In a Sentado position, loop a belt, rope, or Banda around one foot. This will be your starting position. With the Pierna extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is inverted, with the inLateral of the foot being pulled towards you. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then switch Laterals.

Gemelos.name: Posterior Tibialis Stretch
Gemelos.instructions_en:
In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. This will be your starting position.
With the leg extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is everted, with the outside of the foot being pulled towards you. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then switch sides.
Gemelos.instructions_es: In a Sentado position, loop a belt, rope, or Banda around one foot. This will be your starting position. With the Pierna extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is everted, with the outLateral of the foot being pulled towards you. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then switch Laterals.

Gemelos.name: Seated Calf Stretch
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Sit up straight on an exercise mat.
Bend one knee and put that foot on the floor to stabilize the torso.
Straighten your other leg and flex your ankle.
Using a band, towel, or your hand if you can reach, pull the toes toward you. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch sides.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Sit up straight on an exercise mat. Bend one knee and put that foot on the Suelo to stabilize the torso. Straighten your other Pierna and flex your ankle. Using a Banda, towel, or your hand if you can reach, pull the toes toward you. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch Laterals.

Gemelos.name: Standing Gastrocnemius Calf Stretch
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Place your right heel on a step with your knee extended and lean forward to grab your right toe with your right hand. Your left knee should be slightly bent and your back should be straight.
Support your weight on your left leg and place your left hand on your left thigh.
Pull your right toes toward your knee until you feel a stretch in your calf.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Place your right heel on a step with your knee extended and lean forward to grab your right toe with your right hand. Your left knee should be slightly bent and your Espalda should be straight. Support your weight on your left Pierna and place your left hand on your left tAlto. Pull your right toes toward your knee until you feel a stretch in your Gemelo.

Gemelos.name: Ejemplos para el Sóleo
Gemelos.instructions_en:
Stand with your feet hip-distance apart, one foot slightly in front of the other.
Bend both knees, keeping your back heel on the floor. Switch sides.
Gemelos.instructions_es: Stand with your feet Cadera-distance apart, one foot slightly in Frontal of the other. Bend both knees, keeping your Espalda heel on the Suelo. Switch Laterals.

Pecho.name: Press de Suelo
Pecho.instructions_en:
Lie on the floor with two kettlebells next to your shoulders.
Position one in place on your chest and then the other, gripping the kettlebells on the handle with the palms facing forward.
Extend both arms, so that the kettlebells are being held above your chest. Lower one kettlebell, bringing it to your chest and turn the wrist in the direction of the locked out kettlebell.
Raise the kettlebell and repeat on the opposite side.
Pecho.instructions_es: Lie on the Suelo with two Pesa Rusas next to your Hombros. Position one in place on your Pecho and then the other, gripping the Pesa Rusas on the handle with the palms facing forward. Extend both arms, so that the Pesa Rusas are being held above your Pecho. Bajoer one Pesa Rusa, bringing it to your Pecho and turn the Muñeca in the direction of the locked out Pesa Rusa. Elevación the Pesa Rusa and repeat on the opposite Lateral.

Pecho.name: Around The Worlds
Pecho.instructions_en:
Lay down on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with the palms of the hands facing towards the ceiling. Tip: Your arms should be parallel to the floor and next to your thighs. To avoid injury, make sure that you keep your elbows slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
Now move the dumbbells by creating a semi-circle as you displace them from the initial position to over the head. All of the movement should happen with the arms parallel to the floor at all times. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement.
Reverse the movement to return the weight to the starting position as you exhale.
Pecho.instructions_es: Lay down on a flat bench holding a Mancuerna in each hand with the palms of the hands facing towards the ceiling. Tip: Your arms should be parallel to the Suelo and next to your tAltos. To avoid injury, make sure that you keep your elbows slightly bent. This will be your starting position. Now move the Mancuernas by creating a semi-circle as you displace them from the initial position to over the head. All of the movement should happen with the arms parallel to the Suelo at all times. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement. Inverso the movement to return the weight to the starting position as you exhale.

Pecho.name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
Pecho.instructions_en:
Lie back on a flat bench. Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
From the starting position, breathe in and begin coming down slowly until the bar touches your middle chest.
After a brief pause, push the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out. Focus on pushing the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position at the top of the motion, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again.
