Antebrazos.name: Seated Two-arm Palms-up Low-pulley Wrist Curl
Antebrazos.name_en: Seated Two-Arm Palms-Up Low-Pulley Wrist Curl
Antebrazos.instructions_en:
Put a bench in front of a low pulley machine that has a barbell or EZ Curl attachment on it.
Move the bench far enough away so that when you bring the handle to the top of your thighs tension is created on the cable due to the weight stack being moved up.
Now hold the handle with both hands, palms up, using a shoulder-width grip.
Step back and sit on the bench with your feet about shoulder width apart, firmly on the floor.
Lean forward and place the forearms on your thighs with the back of your wrists over your knees. This will be your starting position.
Lower the bar as far as possible, while inhaling and keeping a tight grip.
Now curl the bar up as high as possible while contracting the forearms. Tip: Only the wrist should move; not the forearms.
After a second contraction at the top go back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Antebrazos.instructions_es: Put a bench in Frontal of a Bajo pulley Máquina that has a Barra or EZ Curl attachment on it. Move the bench far enough away so that when you bring the handle to the top of your tAltos tension is created on the Polea due to the weight stack being moved up. Now hold the handle with both hands, palms up, using a Hombro-width grip. Step Espalda and sit on the bench with your feet about Hombro width apart, firmly on the Suelo. Lean forward and place the foPosteriorms on your tAltos with the Espalda of your Muñecas over your knees. This will be your starting position. Bajoer the bar as far as possible, while inhaling and keeping a tight grip. Now Curl the bar up as Alto as possible while contracting the foPosteriorms. Tip: Only the Muñeca should move; not the foPosteriorms. After a second contraction at the top go Espalda to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Antebrazos.name: Standing Palms-up Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl
Antebrazos.name_en: Standing Palms-Up Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl
Antebrazos.instructions_en:
Start by standing straight and holding a barbell behind your glutes at arm's length while using a pronated grip (palms will be facing back away from the glutes) and having your hands shoulder width apart from each other.
You should be looking straight forward while your feet are shoulder width apart from each other. This is the starting position.
While exhaling, slowly elevate the barbell up by curling your wrist in a semi-circular motion towards the ceiling. Note: Your wrist should be the only body part moving for this exercise.
Hold the contraction for a second and lower the barbell back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
When finished, lower the barbell down to the squat rack or the floor by bending the knees. Tip: It is easiest to either pick it up from a squat rack or have a partner hand it to you.
Antebrazos.instructions_es: Start by De Pie straight and holding a Barra behind your Glúteos at arm's length while using a pronated grip (palms will be facing Espalda away from the Glúteos) and having your hands Hombro width apart from each other. You should be looking straight forward while your feet are Hombro width apart from each other. This is the starting position. While exhaling, sBajoly elevate the Barra up by Curling your Muñeca in a semi-circular motion towards the ceiling. Note: Your Muñeca should be the only body part moving for this exercise. Hold the contraction for a second and Bajoer the Barra Espalda down to the starting position while inhaling. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. When finished, Bajoer the Barra down to the Sentadilla rack or the Suelo by bending the knees. Tip: It is easiest to either pick it up from a Sentadilla rack or have a partner hand it to you.

Antebrazos.name: Muñeca Roller
Antebrazos.instructions_en:
To begin, stand straight up grabbing a wrist roller using a pronated grip (palms facing down). Your feet should be shoulder width apart.
Slowly lift both arms until they are fully extended and parallel to the floor in front of you. Note: Make sure the rope is not wrapped around the roller. Your entire body should be stationary except for the forearms. This is the starting position.
Rotate one wrist at a time in an upward motion to bring the weight up to the bar by rolling the rope around the roller.
Once the weight has reached the bar, slowly begin to lower the weight back down by rotating the wrist in a downward motion until the weight reaches the starting position.
Repeat for the prescribed amount of repetitions in your program.
Antebrazos.instructions_es: To begin, stand straight up grabbing a Muñeca roller using a pronated grip (palms facing down). Your feet should be Hombro width apart. SBajoly lift both arms until they are fully extended and parallel to the Suelo in Frontal of you. Note: Make sure the rope is not wrapped around the roller. Your entire body should be stationary except for the foPosteriorms. This is the starting position. Rotate one Muñeca at a time in an upward motion to bring the weight up to the bar by rolling the rope around the roller. Once the weight has reached the bar, sBajoly begin to Bajoer the weight Espalda down by rotating the Muñeca in a downward motion until the weight reaches the starting position. Repeat for the prescribed amount of repetitions in your program.

Antebrazos.name: Muñeca Rotations With Straight Bar
Antebrazos.instructions_en:
Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing down; hands spaced about shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
Alternating between each of your hands, perform the movement by extending the wrist as though you were rolling up a newspaper. Continue alternating back and forth until failure.
Reverse the motion by flexing the wrist, rolling the opposite direction. Continue the alternating motion until failure.
Antebrazos.instructions_es: Hold a Barra with both hands and your palms facing down; hands spaced about Hombro width. This will be your starting position. Alternando between each of your hands, perform the movement by extending the Muñeca as though you were rolling up a newspaper. Continue Alternando Espalda and forth until failure. Inverso the motion by flexing the Muñeca, rolling the opposite direction. Continue the Alternando motion until failure.

Antebrazos.name: Kneeling Forearm Stretch
Antebrazos.instructions_en:
Start by kneeling on a mat with your palms flat and your fingers pointing back toward your knees.
Slowly lean back keeping your palms flat on the floor until you feel a stretch in your wrists and forearms. Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Antebrazos.instructions_es: Start by Arrodillado on a mat with your palms flat and your fingers pointing Espalda toward your knees. SBajoly lean Espalda keeping your palms flat on the Suelo until you feel a stretch in your Muñecas and foPosteriorms. Hold for 20-30 seconds.

Antebrazos.name: Paseo del Granjero
Antebrazos.instructions_en:
There are various implements that can be used for the farmers walk. These can also be performed with heavy dumbbells or short bars if these implements aren't available. Begin by standing between the implements.
After gripping the handles, lift them up by driving through your heels, keeping your back straight and your head up.
Walk taking short, quick steps, and don't forget to breathe. Move for a given distance, typically 50-100 feet, as fast as possible.
Antebrazos.instructions_es: There are various implements that can be used for the farmers walk. These can also be performed with heavy Mancuernas or short bars if these implements aren't available. Begin by De Pie between the implements. After gripping the handles, lift them up by driving through your heels, keeping your Espalda straight and your head up. Walk taking short, quick steps, and don't forget to breathe. Move for a given distance, typically 50-100 feet, as fast as possible.

Antebrazos.name: Rickshaw Carry
Antebrazos.instructions_en:
Position the frame at the starting point, and load with the appropriate weight. Standing in the center of the frame, begin by gripping the handles and driving through your heels to lift the frame. Ensure your chest and head are up and your back is straight.
Immediately begin walking briskly with quick, controlled steps. Keep your chest up and head forward, and make sure you continue breathing. Bring the frame to the ground after you have reached the end point.
Antebrazos.instructions_es: Position the frame at the starting point, and load with the appropriate weight. De Pie in the center of the frame, begin by gripping the handles and driving through your heels to lift the frame. Ensure your Pecho and head are up and your Espalda is straight. Immediately begin walking briskly with quick, controlled steps. Keep your Pecho up and head forward, and make sure you continue breathing. Bring the frame to the ground after you have reached the end point.

Isquiotibiales.name: Alternando Colgado Cargada
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Place two kettlebells between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.
Clean one kettlebell to your shoulder and hold on to the other kettlebell in a hanging position. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrist as you do so.
Lower the cleaned kettlebell to a hanging position and clean the alternate kettlebell. Repeat.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Place two Pesa Rusas between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt Espalda and look straight ahead. Cargada one Pesa Rusa to your Hombro and hold on to the other Pesa Rusa in a Colgadoing position. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombro by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you pull the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombros. Rotate your Muñeca as you do so. Bajoer the Cargadaed Pesa Rusa to a Colgadoing position and Cargada the alternate Pesa Rusa. Repeat.

Isquiotibiales.name: Ball Leg Curl
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Begin on the floor laying on your back with your feet on top of the ball.
Position the ball so that when your legs are extended your ankles are on top of the ball. This will be your starting position.
Raise your hips off of the ground, keeping your weight on the shoulder blades and your feet.
Flex the knees, pulling the ball as close to you as you can, contracting the hamstrings.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Begin on the Suelo laying on your Espalda with your feet on top of the ball. Position the ball so that when your Piernas are extended your ankles are on top of the ball. This will be your starting position. Elevación your Caderas off of the ground, keeping your weight on the Hombro blades and your feet. Flex the knees, pulling the ball as close to you as you can, contracting the hamstrings. After a brief pause, return to the starting position.

Isquiotibiales.name: Double Pesa Rusa Alternando Colgado Cargada
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Place two kettlebells between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.
Clean one kettlebell to your shoulder and hold on to the other kettlebell.
With a fluid motion, lower the top kettlebell while driving the bottom kettlebell up.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Place two Pesa Rusas between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt Espalda and look straight ahead. Cargada one Pesa Rusa to your Hombro and hold on to the other Pesa Rusa. With a fluid motion, Bajoer the top Pesa Rusa while driving the bottom Pesa Rusa up.

Isquiotibiales.name: Cargada de Potencia con Mancuernas
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Begin standing with a dumbbell in each hand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower the weights to the floor by flexing at the hips and knees, pushing your hips back until the dumbbells reach the floor. This will be your starting position.
To initiate the movement, violently jump upward by extending the hips, knees, and ankles to acclerate the weights upward. Maintaining a neutral grip on the dumbbells, keep the arms straight until full extension is reached.
After full extension, rebend the hips and knees to receive the weight in a squat position. Allow the arms to bend, guiding the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Upon receiving the weight in the squat position, extend the hips and knees to finish in a standing position with the weights on your shoulders.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Begin De Pie with a Mancuerna in each hand with your feet Hombro width apart. Bajoer the weights to the Suelo by flexing at the Caderas and knees, pushing your Caderas Espalda until the Mancuernas reach the Suelo. This will be your starting position. To initiate the movement, violently Salto upward by extending the Caderas, knees, and ankles to acclerate the weights upward. Maintaining a Agarre Neutro on the Mancuernas, keep the arms straight until full Extensión is reached. After full Extensión, rebend the Caderas and knees to receive the weight in a Sentadilla position. AlBajo the arms to bend, guiding the Mancuernas to your Hombros. Upon receiving the weight in the Sentadilla position, extend the Caderas and knees to finish in a De Pie position with the weights on your Hombros.

Isquiotibiales.name: Suelo Glúteo-ham Elevación
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
You can use a partner for this exercise or brace your feet under something stable.
Begin on your knees with your upper legs and torso upright. If using a partner, they will firmly hold your feet to keep you in position. This will be your starting position.
Lower yourself by extending at the knee, taking care to NOT flex the hips as you go forward.
Place your hands in front of you as you reach the floor. This movement is very difficult and you may be unable to do it unaided. Use your arms to lightly push off the floor to aid your return to the starting position.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: You can use a partner for this exercise or brace your feet under something stable. Begin on your knees with your upper Piernas and torso Vertical. If using a partner, they will firmly hold your feet to keep you in position. This will be your starting position. Bajoer yourself by extending at the knee, taking care to NOT flex the Caderas as you go forward. Place your hands in Frontal of you as you reach the Suelo. This movement is very difficult and you may be unable to do it unaided. Use your arms to lightly push off the Suelo to aid your return to the starting position.

Isquiotibiales.name: Pesa Rusa Dead Cargada
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Place kettlebell between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.
Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulder. The wrist should rotate as you do so.
Lower the kettlebell, keeping the hamstrings loaded by keeping your back straight and your butt out.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Place Pesa Rusa between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt Espalda and look straight ahead. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombro. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombros by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you Elevación the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombro. The Muñeca should rotate as you do so. Bajoer the Pesa Rusa, keeping the hamstrings loaded by keeping your Espalda straight and your butt out.

Isquiotibiales.name: Pesa Rusa Colgado Cargada
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Place kettlebell between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.
Clean kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulder. The wrist should rotate as you do so.
Lower kettlebell to a hanging position between your legs while keeping the hamstrings loaded. Keep your head up at all times.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Place Pesa Rusa between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt Espalda and look straight ahead. Cargada Pesa Rusa to your Hombro. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombros by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you Elevación the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombro. The Muñeca should rotate as you do so. Bajoer Pesa Rusa to a Colgadoing position between your Piernas while keeping the hamstrings loaded. Keep your head up at all times.

Isquiotibiales.name: Pesa Rusa One-piernaged Peso Muerto
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Hold a kettlebell by the handle in one hand. Stand on one leg, on the same side that you hold the kettlebell.
Keeping that knee slightly bent, perform a stiff legged deadlift by bending at the hip, extending your free leg behind you for balance.
Continue lowering the kettlebell until you are parallel to the ground, and then return to the upright position.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Hold a Pesa Rusa by the handle in one hand. Stand on one Pierna, on the same Lateral that you hold the Pesa Rusa. Keeping that knee slightly bent, perform a Piernas Rígidasged Peso Muerto by bending at the Cadera, extending your free Pierna behind you for balance. Continue Bajoering the Pesa Rusa until you are parallel to the ground, and then return to the Vertical position.

Isquiotibiales.name: Zancada Pass Through
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Stand with your torso upright holding a kettlebell in your right hand. This will be your starting position.
Step forward with your left foot and lower your upper body down by flexing the hip and the knee, keeping the torso upright. Lower your back knee until it nearly touches the ground.
As you lunge, pass the kettlebell under your front leg to your opposite hand.
Pressing through the heel of your foot, return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the recommended amount of repetitions, alternating legs.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Stand with your torso Vertical holding a Pesa Rusa in your right hand. This will be your starting position. Step forward with your left foot and Bajoer your upper body down by flexing the Cadera and the knee, keeping the torso Vertical. Bajoer your Espalda knee until it nearly touches the ground. As you Zancada, pass the Pesa Rusa under your Frontal Pierna to your opposite hand. Pressing through the heel of your foot, return to the starting position. Repeat the movement for the recommended amount of repetitions, Alternando Piernas.

Isquiotibiales.name: Lying Leg Curls
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad of the lever on the back of your legs (just a few inches under the calves). Tip: Preferably use a leg curl machine that is angled as opposed to flat since an angled position is more favorable for hamstrings recruitment.
Keeping the torso flat on the bench, ensure your legs are fully stretched and grab the side handles of the machine. Position your toes straight (or you can also use any of the other two stances described on the foot positioning section). This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, curl your legs up as far as possible without lifting the upper legs from the pad. Once you hit the fully contracted position, hold it for a second.
As you inhale, bring the legs back to the initial position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Adjust the Máquina lever to fit your height and lie face down on the Pierna Curl Máquina with the pad of the lever on the Espalda of your Piernas (just a few inches under the calves). Tip: Preferably use a Pierna Curl Máquina that is angled as opposed to flat since an angled position is more favorable for hamstrings recruitment. Keeping the torso flat on the bench, ensure your Piernas are fully stretched and grab the Lateral handles of the Máquina. Position your toes straight (or you can also use any of the other two stances described on the foot positioning section). This will be your starting position. As you exhale, Curl your Piernas up as far as possible without lifting the upper Piernas from the pad. Once you hit the fully contracted position, hold it for a second. As you inhale, bring the Piernas Espalda to the initial position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Isquiotibiales.name: Natural Glúteo Ham Elevación
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Using the leg pad of a lat pulldown machine or a preacher bench, position yourself so that your ankles are under the pads, knees on the seat, and you are facing away from the machine. You should be upright and maintaining good posture.
This will be your starting position. Lower yourself under control until your knees are almost completely straight.
Remaining in control, raise yourself back up to the starting position.
If you are unable to complete a rep, use a band, a partner, or push off of a box to aid in completing a repetition.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Using the Pierna pad of a Jalón al Pecho Máquina or a Predicador bench, position yourself so that your ankles are under the pads, knees on the seat, and you are facing away from the Máquina. You should be Vertical and maintaining good posture. This will be your starting position. Bajoer yourself under control until your knees are almost completely straight. Remaining in control, Elevación yourself Espalda up to the starting position. If you are unable to complete a rep, use a Banda, a partner, or push off of a Cajón to aid in completing a repetition.

Isquiotibiales.name: Un Brazo Pesa Rusa Cargada
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Place a kettlebell between your feet. As you bend down to grab the kettlebell, push your butt back and keep your eyes looking forward.
Clean the kettlebell to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulder. The wrist should rotate as you do so.
Return the weight to the starting position.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Place a Pesa Rusa between your feet. As you bend down to grab the Pesa Rusa, push your butt Espalda and keep your eyes looking forward. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombros by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you Elevación the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombro. The Muñeca should rotate as you do so. Return the weight to the starting position.

Isquiotibiales.name: Un Brazo Open Palm Pesa Rusa Cargada
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Place one kettlebell between your feet.
Grab the handle with one hand and raise the kettlebell rapidly, let it flip so that the ball of the kettlebell lands in the palm of your hand.
Throw the kettlebell out in front of you and catch the handle with one hand.
Take the kettlebell to the floor and repeat. Make sure to work both arms.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Place one Pesa Rusa between your feet. Grab the handle with one hand and Elevación the Pesa Rusa rapidly, let it flip so that the ball of the Pesa Rusa lands in the palm of your hand. ThRemo the Pesa Rusa out in Frontal of you and catch the handle with one hand. Take the Pesa Rusa to the Suelo and repeat. Make sure to work both arms.

Isquiotibiales.name: Open Palm Pesa Rusa Cargada
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Place one kettlebell between your feet. Clean the kettlebell by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulders.
Release the kettlebell as it comes up, and let it flip so that the ball of the kettlebell lands in the palms of your hands.
Release the kettlebell out in front of you and catch the handle with both hands. Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Place one Pesa Rusa between your feet. Cargada the Pesa Rusa by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you Elevación the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombros. Release the Pesa Rusa as it comes up, and let it flip so that the ball of the Pesa Rusa lands in the palms of your hands. Release the Pesa Rusa out in Frontal of you and catch the handle with both hands. Bajoer the Pesa Rusa to the starting position and repeat.

Isquiotibiales.name: Platform Hamstring Slides
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
For this movement a wooden floor or similar is needed. Lay on your back with your legs extended. Place a gym towel or a light weight underneath your heel. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing the knee, keeping your other leg straight.
Continue bringing the heel closer to you, sliding it on the floor.
At full knee flexion, reverse the movement to return to the starting position.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: For this movement a wooden Suelo or similar is needed. Lay on your Espalda with your Piernas extended. Place a gym towel or a light weight underneath your heel. This will be your starting position. Begin the movement by flexing the knee, keeping your other Pierna straight. Continue bringing the heel closer to you, sliding it on the Suelo. At full knee flexion, Inverso the movement to return to the starting position.

Isquiotibiales.name: Power Cargada
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and toes pointing out slightly.
Squat down and grasp bar with a closed, pronated grip. Your hands should be slightly wider than shoulder width apart outside knees with elbows fully extended.
Place the bar about 1 inch in front of your shins and over the balls of your feet.
Your back should be flat or slightly arched, your chest held up and out and your shoulder blades should be retracted.
Keep your head in a neutral position (in line with vertebral column and not tilted or rotated) with your eyes focused straight ahead. Inhale during this phase.
Lift the bar from the floor by forcefully extending the hips and the knees as you exhale. Tip: The upper torso should maintain the same angle. Do not bend at the waist yet and do not let the hips rise before the shoulders (this would have the effect of pushing the glutes in the air and stretching the hamstrings.
Keep elbows fully extended with the head in a neutral position and the shoulders over the bar.
As the bar raises keep it as close to the shins as possible.
As the bar passes the knees, thrust your hips forward and slightly bend the knees to avoid locking them. Tip: At this point your thighs should be against the bar.
Keep the back flat or slightly arched, elbows fully extended and your head neutral. Tip: You will hold your breath until the next phase.
Inhale and then forcefully and quickly extend your hips and knees and stand on your toes.
Keep the bar as close to your body as possible. Tip: Your back should be flat with the elbows pointed out to the sides and your head in a neutral position. Also, keep your shoulders over the bar and arms straight as long as possible.
When your lower body joints are fully extended, shrug the shoulders upward rapidly without letting the elbows flex yet. Exhale during this portion of the movement.
As the shoulders reach their highest elevation flex your elbows to begin pulling your body under the bar.
Continue to pull the arms as high and as long as possible. Tip: Due to the explosive nature of this phase, your torso will be erect or with an arched back, your head will be tilted back slightly and your feet may lose contact with the floor.
After the lower body has fully extended and the bar reaches near maximal height, pull your body under the bar and rotate the arms around and under the bar.
Simultaneously, flex the hips and knees into a quarter squat position.
Once the arms are under the bar, inhale and then lift your elbows to position the upper arms parallel to the floor. Rack the bar across the front of your collar bones and front shoulder muscles.
Catch the bar with an erect and tight torso, a neutral head position and flat feet. Exhale during this movement.
Stand up by extending the hips and knees to a fully erect position.
Lower the bar by gradually reducing the muscular tension of the arms to allow a controlled descent of the bar to the thighs. Inhale during this movement.
Simultaneously flex the hips and knees to cushion the impact of the bar on the thighs.
Squat down with the elbows fully extended until the bar touches the floor.
Start over at Phase 1 and repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Stand with your feet slightly wider than Hombro width apart and toes pointing out slightly. Sentadilla down and grasp bar with a closed, pronated grip. Your hands should be slightly wider than Hombro width apart outLateral knees with elbows fully extended. Place the bar about 1 inch in Frontal of your shins and over the balls of your feet. Your Espalda should be flat or slightly arched, your Pecho held up and out and your Hombro blades should be retracted. Keep your head in a neutral position (in line with vertebral column and not tilted or rotated) with your eyes focused straight ahead. Inhale during this phase. Lift the bar from the Suelo by forcefully extending the Caderas and the knees as you exhale. Tip: The upper torso should maintain the same angle. Do not bend at the waist yet and do not let the Caderas rise before the Hombros (this would have the effect of pushing the Glúteos in the air and stretching the hamstrings. Keep elbows fully extended with the head in a neutral position and the Hombros over the bar. As the bar Elevacións keep it as close to the shins as possible. As the bar passes the knees, thrust your Caderas forward and slightly bend the knees to avoid locking them. Tip: At this point your tAltos should be against the bar. Keep the Espalda flat or slightly arched, elbows fully extended and your head neutral. Tip: You will hold your breath until the next phase. Inhale and then forcefully and quickly extend your Caderas and knees and stand on your toes. Keep the bar as close to your body as possible. Tip: Your Espalda should be flat with the elbows pointed out to the Laterals and your head in a neutral position. Also, keep your Hombros over the bar and arms straight as long as possible. When your Bajoer body joints are fully extended, Encogimiento the Hombros upward rapidly without letting the elbows flex yet. Exhale during this portion of the movement. As the Hombros reach their Altoest elevation flex your elbows to begin pulling your body under the bar. Continue to pull the arms as Alto and as long as possible. Tip: Due to the explosive nature of this phase, your torso will be erect or with an arched Espalda, your head will be tilted Espalda slightly and your feet may lose contact with the Suelo. After the Bajoer body has fully extended and the bar reaches near maximal height, pull your body under the bar and rotate the arms around and under the bar. Simultaneously, flex the Caderas and knees into a quarter Sentadilla position. Once the arms are under the bar, inhale and then lift your elbows to position the upper arms parallel to the Suelo. Rack the bar across the Frontal of your collar bones and Frontal Hombro Muslos. Catch the bar with an erect and tight torso, a neutral head position and flat feet. Exhale during this movement. Stand up by extending the Caderas and knees to a fully erect position. Bajoer the bar by gradually reducing the muscular tension of the arms to alBajo a controlled descent of the bar to the tAltos. Inhale during this movement. Simultaneously flex the Caderas and knees to cushion the impact of the bar on the tAltos. Sentadilla down with the elbows fully extended until the bar touches the Suelo. Start over at Phase 1 and repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Isquiotibiales.name: Tumbado Prono Manual Hamstring
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
You will need a partner for this exercise. Lay face down with your legs straight. Your assistant will place their hand on your heel.
To begin, flex the knee to curl your leg up. Your partner should provide resistance, starting light and increasing the pressure as the movement is completed. Communicate with your partner to monitor appropriate resistance levels.
Pause at the top, returning the leg to the starting position as your partner provides resistance going the other direction.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: You will need a partner for this exercise. Lay face down with your Piernas straight. Your assistant will place their hand on your heel. To begin, flex the knee to Curl your Pierna up. Your partner should provide resistance, starting light and increasing the Pressure as the movement is completed. Communicate with your partner to monitor appropriate resistance levels. Pause at the top, returning the Pierna to the starting position as your partner provides resistance going the other direction.

Isquiotibiales.name: Hiperextensiones de Cadera
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Place your feet between the pads after loading an appropriate weight. Lay on the top pad, allowing your hips to hang off the back, while grasping the handles to hold your position.
To begin the movement, flex the hips, pulling the legs forward.
Reverse the motion by extending the hips, kicking the leg back. It is very important not to over-extend the hip on this movement, stopping short of your full range of motion.
Return by again flexing the hip, pulling the carriage forward as far as you can.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Place your feet between the pads after loading an appropriate weight. Lay on the top pad, alBajoing your Caderas to Colgado off the Espalda, while grasping the handles to hold your position. To begin the movement, flex the Caderas, pulling the Piernas forward. Inverso the motion by extending the Caderas, kicking the Pierna Espalda. It is very important not to over-extend the Cadera on this movement, stopping short of your full range of motion. Return by again flexing the Cadera, pulling the carriage forward as far as you can. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Isquiotibiales.name: Peso Muerto Rumano
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Put a barbell in front of you on the ground and grab it using a pronated (palms facing down) grip that a little wider than shoulder width. Tip: Depending on the weight used, you may need wrist wraps to perform the exercise and also a raised platform in order to allow for better range of motion.
Bend the knees slightly and keep the shins vertical, hips back and back straight. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your back and arms completely straight at all times, use your hips to lift the bar as you exhale. Tip: The movement should not be fast but steady and under control.
Once you are standing completely straight up, lower the bar by pushing the hips back, only slightly bending the knees, unlike when squatting. Tip: Take a deep breath at the start of the movement and keep your chest up. Hold your breath as you lower and exhale as you complete the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Put a Barra in Frontal of you on the ground and grab it using a pronated (palms facing down) grip that a little wider than Hombro width. Tip: Depending on the weight used, you may need Muñeca wraps to perform the exercise and also a Elevaciónd platform in order to alBajo for better range of motion. Bend the knees slightly and keep the shins vertical, Caderas Espalda and Espalda straight. This will be your starting position. Keeping your Espalda and arms completely straight at all times, use your Caderas to lift the bar as you exhale. Tip: The movement should not be fast but steady and under control. Once you are De Pie completely straight up, Bajoer the bar by pushing the Caderas Espalda, only slightly bending the knees, unlike when Sentadillating. Tip: Take a deep breath at the start of the movement and keep your Pecho up. Hold your breath as you Bajoer and exhale as you complete the movement. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Isquiotibiales.name: Seated Band Hamstring Curl
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Secure a band close to the ground and place a bench a couple feet away from it.
Seat yourself on the bench and secure the band behind your ankles, beginning with your legs straight. This will be your starting position.
Flex the knees, bringing your feet towards the bench. You may need to lean back slightly to keep your feet from striking the floor.
Pause at the completion of the movement, and then slowly return to the starting position.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Secure a Banda close to the ground and place a bench a couple feet away from it. Seat yourself on the bench and secure the Banda behind your ankles, beginning with your Piernas straight. This will be your starting position. Flex the knees, bringing your feet towards the bench. You may need to lean Espalda slightly to keep your feet from striking the Suelo. Pause at the completion of the movement, and then sBajoly return to the starting position.

Isquiotibiales.name: Seated Leg Curl
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and sit on the machine with your back against the back support pad.
Place the back of lower leg on top of padded lever (just a few inches under the calves) and secure the lap pad against your thighs, just above the knees. Then grasp the side handles on the machine as you point your toes straight (or you can also use any of the other two stances) and ensure that the legs are fully straight right in front of you. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, pull the machine lever as far as possible to the back of your thighs by flexing at the knees. Keep your torso stationary at all times. Hold the contracted position for a second.
Slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Adjust the Máquina lever to fit your height and sit on the Máquina with your Espalda against the Espalda support pad. Place the Espalda of Bajoer Pierna on top of padded lever (just a few inches under the calves) and secure the lap pad against your tAltos, just above the knees. Then grasp the Lateral handles on the Máquina as you point your toes straight (or you can also use any of the other two stances) and ensure that the Piernas are fully straight right in Frontal of you. This will be your starting position. As you exhale, pull the Máquina lever as far as possible to the Espalda of your tAltos by flexing at the knees. Keep your torso stationary at all times. Hold the contracted position for a second. SBajoly return to the starting position as you breathe in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Isquiotibiales.name: Multipower Colgado Power Cargada
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Position the bar at knee height and load it to an appropriate weight.
Take a pronated grip on the bar outside of shoulder width and unhook the bar from the machine. Your arms should be fully extended with your head and chest up. Your elbows should be pointed out with your shoulders back and down. Your hips should be back, loading the tension into the hamstrings. This will be your starting position.
Initate the movement by forcefully extending the hips and knees, accelerating into the bar. Ensure that you keep your arms straight during this part of the motion.
Upon full extension, rebend the hips and knees to lower your receiving position.
Allow the arms to flex at this point, rotating the elbows around the bar to receive it on your shoulders.
Extend through the hips and knees to come to a standing position with the bar racked on your shoulders to complete the movement.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Position the bar at knee height and load it to an appropriate weight. Take a pronated grip on the bar outLateral of Hombro width and unhook the bar from the Máquina. Your arms should be fully extended with your head and Pecho up. Your elbows should be pointed out with your Hombros Espalda and down. Your Caderas should be Espalda, loading the tension into the hamstrings. This will be your starting position. Initate the movement by forcefully extending the Caderas and knees, accelerating into the bar. Ensure that you keep your arms straight during this part of the motion. Upon full Extensión, rebend the Caderas and knees to Bajoer your receiving position. AlBajo the arms to flex at this point, rotating the elbows around the bar to receive it on your Hombros. Extend through the Caderas and knees to come to a De Pie position with the bar racked on your Hombros to complete the movement.

Isquiotibiales.name: Multipower Piernas Rígidasged Peso Muerto
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
To begin, set the bar on the smith machine to a height that is around the middle of your thighs. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, grasp the bar using a pronated (palms forward) grip that is shoulder width apart. You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight.
Lift the bar up by fully extending your arms while keeping your back straight. Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.
Keeping the knees stationary, lower the barbell to over the top of your feet by bending at the waist while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Exhale as you perform this movement
Start bringing your torso up straight again as soon as you feel the hamstrings stretch by extending your hips and waist until you are back at the starting position. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: To begin, set the bar on the MultiPower to a height that is around the middle of your tAltos. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, grasp the bar using a pronated (palms forward) grip that is Hombro width apart. You may need some Muñeca wraps if using a significant amount of weight. Lift the bar up by fully extending your arms while keeping your Espalda straight. Stand with your torso straight and your Piernas spaced using a Hombro width or narRemoer stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position. Keeping the knees stationary, Bajoer the Barra to over the top of your feet by bending at the waist while keeping your Espalda straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the Suelo until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Exhale as you perform this movement Start bringing your torso up straight again as soon as you feel the hamstrings stretch by extending your Caderas and waist until you are Espalda at the starting position. Inhale as you perform this movement. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Isquiotibiales.name: Arrancada Pull
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
With a barbell on the floor close to the shins, take a wide snatch grip. Lower your hips with the weight focused on the heels, back straight, head facing forward, chest up, with your shoulders just in front of the bar. This will be your starting position.
Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending your knees. Your back angle should stay the same, and your arms should remain straight. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the knees.
Next comes the second pull, the main source of acceleration for the pull. As the bar approaches the mid-thigh position, begin extending through the hips. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the hips, knees, and ankles, using speed to move the bar upward.
There should be no need to actively pull through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second pull, the body should be fully extended, leaning slightly back. Full extension should be violent and abrupt, and ensure that you do not prolong the extension for longer than necessary.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: With a Barra on the Suelo close to the shins, take a wide Arrancada grip. Bajoer your Caderas with the weight focused on the heels, Espalda straight, head facing forward, Pecho up, with your Hombros just in Frontal of the bar. This will be your starting position. Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending your knees. Your Espalda angle should stay the same, and your arms should remain straight. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the knees. Next comes the second pull, the main source of acceleration for the pull. As the bar approaches the mid-tAlto position, begin extending through the Caderas. In a Saltoing motion, accelerate by extending the Caderas, knees, and ankles, using speed to move the bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second pull, the body should be fully extended, leaning slightly Espalda. Full Extensión should be violent and abrupt, and ensure that you do not prolong the Extensión for longer than necessary.

Isquiotibiales.name: Standing Leg Curl
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and lie with your torso bent at the waist facing forward around 30-45 degrees (since an angled position is more favorable for hamstrings recruitment) with the pad of the lever on the back of your right leg (just a few inches under the calves) and the front of the right leg on top of the machine pad.
Keeping the torso bent forward, ensure your leg is fully stretched and grab the side handles of the machine. Position your toes straight. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, curl your right leg up as far as possible without lifting the upper leg from the pad. Once you hit the fully contracted position, hold it for a second.
As you inhale, bring the legs back to the initial position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Perform the same exercise now for the left leg.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Adjust the Máquina lever to fit your height and lie with your torso bent at the waist facing forward around 30-45 degrees (since an angled position is more favorable for hamstrings recruitment) with the pad of the lever on the Espalda of your right Pierna (just a few inches under the calves) and the Frontal of the right Pierna on top of the Máquina pad. Keeping the torso bent forward, ensure your Pierna is fully stretched and grab the Lateral handles of the Máquina. Position your toes straight. This will be your starting position. As you exhale, Curl your right Pierna up as far as possible without lifting the upper Pierna from the pad. Once you hit the fully contracted position, hold it for a second. As you inhale, bring the Piernas Espalda to the initial position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. Perform the same exercise now for the left Pierna.

Isquiotibiales.name: Piernas Rígidasged Barra Peso Muerto
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Grasp a bar using an overhand grip (palms facing down). You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight.
Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.
Keeping the knees stationary, lower the barbell to over the top of your feet by bending at the hips while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your hips until you are back at the starting position. Exhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Grasp a bar using an overhand grip (palms facing down). You may need some Muñeca wraps if using a significant amount of weight. Stand with your torso straight and your Piernas spaced using a Hombro width or narRemoer stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position. Keeping the knees stationary, Bajoer the Barra to over the top of your feet by bending at the Caderas while keeping your Espalda straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the Suelo until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Inhale as you perform this movement. Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your Caderas until you are Espalda at the starting position. Exhale as you perform this movement. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Isquiotibiales.name: Piernas Rígidasged Mancuerna Peso Muerto
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Grasp a couple of dumbbells holding them by your side at arm's length.
Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.
Keeping the knees stationary, lower the dumbbells to over the top of your feet by bending at the waist while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Exhale as you perform this movement
Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your hips and waist until you are back at the starting position. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Grasp a couple of Mancuernas holding them by your Lateral at arm's length. Stand with your torso straight and your Piernas spaced using a Hombro width or narRemoer stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position. Keeping the knees stationary, Bajoer the Mancuernas to over the top of your feet by bending at the waist while keeping your Espalda straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the Suelo until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Exhale as you perform this movement Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your Caderas and waist until you are Espalda at the starting position. Inhale as you perform this movement. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Isquiotibiales.name: 90/90 Hamstring
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Lie on your back, with one leg extended straight out.
With the other leg, bend the hip and knee to 90 degrees. You may brace your leg with your hands if necessary. This will be your starting position.
Extend your leg straight into the air, pausing briefly at the top. Return the leg to the starting position.
Repeat for 10-20 repetitions, and then switch to the other leg.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Lie on your Espalda, with one Pierna extended straight out. With the other Pierna, bend the Cadera and knee to 90 degrees. You may brace your Pierna with your hands if necessary. This will be your starting position. Extend your Pierna straight into the air, pausing brieAperturas at the top. Return the Pierna to the starting position. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions, and then switch to the other Pierna.

Isquiotibiales.name: Chair Leg Extended Stretch
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Sit upright in a chair and grip the seat on the sides.
Raise one leg, extending the knee, flexing the ankle as you do so.
Slowly move that leg outward as far as you can, and then back to the center and down.
Repeat for your other leg.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Sit Vertical in a chair and grip the seat on the Laterals. Elevación one Pierna, extending the knee, flexing the ankle as you do so. SBajoly move that Pierna outward as far as you can, and then Espalda to the center and down. Repeat for your other Pierna.

Isquiotibiales.name: Frontal Elevación de Piernass
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Stand next to a chair or other support, holding on with one hand.
Swing your leg forward, keeping the leg straight. Continue with a downward swing, bringing the leg as far back as your flexibility allows. Repeat 5-10 times, and then switch legs.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Stand next to a chair or other support, holding on with one hand. Swing your Pierna forward, keeping the Pierna straight. Continue with a downward swing, bringing the Pierna as far Espalda as your flexibility alBajos. Repeat 5-10 times, and then switch Piernas.

Isquiotibiales.name: Hamstring-smr
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
In a seated position, extend your legs over a foam roll so that it is position on the back of the upper legs. Place your hands to the side or behind you to help support your weight. This will be your starting position.
Using your hands, lift your hips off of the floor and shift your weight on the foam roll to one leg. Relax the hamstrings of the leg you are stretching.
Roll over the foam from below the hip to above the back of the knee, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat for the other leg.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: In a Sentado position, extend your Piernas over a foam roll so that it is position on the Espalda of the upper Piernas. Place your hands to the Lateral or behind you to help support your weight. This will be your starting position. Using your hands, lift your Caderas off of the Suelo and shift your weight on the foam roll to one Pierna. Relax the hamstrings of the Pierna you are stretching. Roll over the foam from beBajo the Cadera to above the Espalda of the knee, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat for the other Pierna.

Isquiotibiales.name: Hamstring Stretch
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Lie on your back with one leg extended above you, with the hip at ninety degrees. Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Loop a belt, band, or rope over the ball of your foot. This will be your starting position.
Pull on the belt to create tension in the calves and hamstrings. Hold this stretch for 10-30 seconds, and repeat with the other leg.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Lie on your Espalda with one Pierna extended above you, with the Cadera at ninety degrees. Keep the other Pierna flat on the Suelo. Loop a belt, Banda, or rope over the ball of your foot. This will be your starting position. Pull on the belt to create tension in the calves and hamstrings. Hold this stretch for 10-30 seconds, and repeat with the other Pierna.

Isquiotibiales.name: Inchworm
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Stand with your feet close together. Keeping your legs straight, stretch down and put your hands on the floor directly in front of you. This will be your starting position.
Begin by walking your hands forward slowly, alternating your left and your right. As you do so, bend only at the hip, keeping your legs straight.
Keep going until your body is parallel to the ground in a pushup position.
Now, keep your hands in place and slowly take short steps with your feet, moving only a few inches at a time.
Continue walking until your feet are by hour hands, keeping your legs straight as you do so.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Stand with your feet close together. Keeping your Piernas straight, stretch down and put your hands on the Suelo directly in Frontal of you. This will be your starting position. Begin by walking your hands forward sBajoly, Alternando your left and your right. As you do so, bend only at the Cadera, keeping your Piernas straight. Keep going until your body is parallel to the ground in a pushup position. Now, keep your hands in place and sBajoly take short steps with your feet, moving only a few inches at a time. Continue walking until your feet are by hour hands, keeping your Piernas straight as you do so.

Isquiotibiales.name: Intermediate Groin Stretch
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. Loop a belt, rope, or band around one of your feet, and swing that leg as far to the side as you can. This will be your starting position.
Pull gently on the belt to create tension in your groin and hamstring muscles. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and repeat on the other side.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Lie on your Espalda with your Piernas extended. Loop a belt, rope, or Banda around one of your feet, and swing that Pierna as far to the Lateral as you can. This will be your starting position. Pull gently on the belt to create tension in your groin and hamstring Muslos. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and repeat on the other Lateral.

Isquiotibiales.name: Leg-up Hamstring Stretch
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Lie flat on your back, bend one knee, and put that foot flat on the floor to stabilize your spine.
Extend the other leg in the air. If you're tight, you wont be able to straighten it. That's okay. Extend the knee so that the sole of the lifted foot faces the ceiling (or as close as you can get it).
Slowly straighten the legs as much as possible and then pull the leg toward your nose. Switch sides.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Lie flat on your Espalda, bend one knee, and put that foot flat on the Suelo to stabilize your spine. Extend the other Pierna in the air. If you're tight, you wont be able to straighten it. That's okay. Extend the knee so that the sole of the lifted foot faces the ceiling (or as close as you can get it). SBajoly straighten the Piernas as much as possible and then pull the Pierna toward your nose. Switch Laterals.

Isquiotibiales.name: Runner's Stretch
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
It's easiest to get into this stretch if you start standing up, put one leg behind you, and slowly lower your torso down to the floor.
Keep the front heel on the floor (if it lifts up, scoot your other leg further back).
Place your hands on either side of your front leg. To get more out of this stretch, push your butt up toward the ceiling, and then gradually lower it back toward the floor. You'll Stretch the hip flexor of the back leg and the hamstring and buttocks of the front.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: It's easiest to get into this stretch if you start De Pie up, put one Pierna behind you, and sBajoly Bajoer your torso down to the Suelo. Keep the Frontal heel on the Suelo (if it lifts up, scoot your other Pierna further Espalda). Place your hands on either Lateral of your Frontal Pierna. To get more out of this stretch, push your butt up toward the ceiling, and then gradually Bajoer it Espalda toward the Suelo. You'll Stretch the Cadera flexor of the Espalda Pierna and the hamstring and buttocks of the Frontal.

Isquiotibiales.name: Seated Floor Hamstring Stretch
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Sit on a mat with your right leg extended in front of you and your left leg bent with your foot against your right inner thigh.
Lean forward from your hips and reach for your ankle until you feel a stretch in your hamstring. Hold for 15 seconds, then repeat for your other side.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Sit on a mat with your right Pierna extended in Frontal of you and your left Pierna bent with your foot against your right inner tAlto. Lean forward from your Caderas and reach for your ankle until you feel a stretch in your hamstring. Hold for 15 seconds, then repeat for your other Lateral.

Isquiotibiales.name: Sentado Hamstring
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
In a seated position with your legs extended, have your partner stand behind you. Now, lean forward as your partner braces your shoulders with their hands. This will be your starting position.
Attempt to push your torso back for 10-20 seconds, as your partner prevents any actual movement of your torso.
Now relax your muscles as your partner increases the stretch by gently pushing your torso forward for 10-20 seconds.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: In a Sentado position with your Piernas extended, have your partner stand behind you. Now, lean forward as your partner braces your Hombros with their hands. This will be your starting position. Attempt to push your torso Espalda for 10-20 seconds, as your partner prevents any actual movement of your torso. Now relax your Muslos as your partner increases the stretch by gently pushing your torso forward for 10-20 seconds.

Isquiotibiales.name: Seated Hamstring And Calf Stretch
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. Sit down with both legs extended . This will be your starting position.
Leaning forward slightly, pull on the belt to draw the toes of your foot back. Hold this position for 10-20 seconds and then repeat with the other leg.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Loop a belt, rope, or Banda around one foot. Sit down with both Piernas extended . This will be your starting position. Leaning forward slightly, pull on the belt to draw the toes of your foot Espalda. Hold this position for 10-20 seconds and then repeat with the other Pierna.

Isquiotibiales.name: Sentadilla Splits
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Being in a standing position. Jump into a split leg position, with one leg forward and one leg back, flexing the knees and lowering your hips slightly as you do so.
As you descend, immediately reverse direction, standing back up and jumping, reversing the position of your legs. Repeat 5-10 times on each leg.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Being in a De Pie position. Salto into a Split Pierna position, with one Pierna forward and one Pierna Espalda, flexing the knees and Bajoering your Caderas slightly as you do so. As you descend, immediately Inverso direction, De Pie Espalda up and Saltoing, reversing the position of your Piernas. Repeat 5-10 times on each Pierna.

Isquiotibiales.name: Standing Hamstring And Calf Stretch
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Being by looping a belt, band, or rope around one foot. While standing, place that foot forward.
Bend your back leg, while keeping the front one straight. Now raise the toes of your front foot off of the ground and lean forward.
Using the belt, pull on the top of the foot to increase the stretch in the calf. Hold for 10-20 seconds and repeat with the other foot.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Being by looping a belt, Banda, or rope around one foot. While De Pie, place that foot forward. Bend your Espalda Pierna, while keeping the Frontal one straight. Now Elevación the toes of your Frontal foot off of the ground and lean forward. Using the belt, pull on the top of the foot to increase the stretch in the Gemelo. Hold for 10-20 seconds and repeat with the other foot.

Isquiotibiales.name: De Pie Toe Touches
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Stand with some space in front and behind you.
Bend at the waist, keeping your legs straight, until you can relax and let your upper body hang down in front of you. Let your arms and hands hang down naturally. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Stand with some space in Frontal and behind you. Bend at the waist, keeping your Piernas straight, until you can relax and let your upper body Colgado down in Frontal of you. Let your arms and hands Colgado down naturally. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.

Isquiotibiales.name: The Straddle
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Begin in a seated, upright position. Start by extending your legs in front of you in a V.
With your hands on the floor, lean forward as far as possible. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Begin in a Sentado, Vertical position. Start by extending your Piernas in Frontal of you in a V. With your hands on the Suelo, lean forward as far as possible. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.

Isquiotibiales.name: Upper Espalda-pierna Grab
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
While seated, bend forward to hug your thighs from underneath with both arms.
Keep your knees together and your legs extended out as you bring your chest down to your knees. You can also stretch your middle back by pulling your back away from your knees as your hugging them.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: While Sentado, bend forward to hug your tAltos from underneath with both arms. Keep your knees together and your Piernas extended out as you bring your Pecho down to your knees. You can also stretch your middle Espalda by pulling your Espalda away from your knees as your hugging them.

Isquiotibiales.name: World's Greatest Stretch
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
This is a three-part stretch. Begin by lunging forward, with your front foot flat on the ground and on the toes of your back foot. With your knees bent, squat down until your knee is almost touching the ground. Keep your torso erect, and hold this position for 10-20 seconds.
Now, place the arm on the same side as your front leg on the ground, with the elbow next to the foot. Your other hand should be placed on the ground, parallel to your lead leg, to help support you during this portion of the stretch.
After 10-20 seconds, place your hands on either side of your front foot. Raise the toes of the front foot off of the ground, and straighten your leg. You may need to reposition your rear leg to do so. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then repeat the entire sequence for the other side.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: This is a three-part stretch. Begin by lunging forward, with your Frontal foot flat on the ground and on the toes of your Espalda foot. With your knees bent, Sentadilla down until your knee is almost touching the ground. Keep your torso erect, and hold this position for 10-20 seconds. Now, place the arm on the same Lateral as your Frontal Pierna on the ground, with the elbow next to the foot. Your other hand should be placed on the ground, parallel to your lead Pierna, to help support you during this portion of the stretch. After 10-20 seconds, place your hands on either Lateral of your Frontal foot. Elevación the toes of the Frontal foot off of the ground, and straighten your Pierna. You may need to reposition your Posterior Pierna to do so. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then repeat the entire sequence for the other Lateral.

Isquiotibiales.name: Cajón Salto (Multiple Response)
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Assume a relaxed stance facing the box or platform approximately an arm's length away. Arms should be down at the sides and legs slightly bent.
Using the arms to aid in the initial burst, jump upward and forward, landing with feet simultaneously on top of the box or platform.
Immediately drop or jump back down to the original starting place; then repeat the sequence.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Assume a relaxed stance facing the Cajón or platform approximately an arm's length away. Arms should be down at the Laterals and Piernas slightly bent. Using the arms to aid in the initial burst, Salto upward and forward, landing with feet simultaneously on top of the Cajón or platform. Immediately drop or Salto Espalda down to the original starting place; then repeat the sequence.

Isquiotibiales.name: Cajón Skip
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
You will need several boxes lined up about 8 feet apart.
Begin facing the first box with one leg slightly behind the other.
Drive off the back leg, attempting to gain as much height with the hips as possible.
Immediately upon landing on the box, drive the other leg forward and upward to gain height and distance, leaping from the box. Land between the first two boxes with the same leg that landed on the first box.
Then, step to the next box and repeat.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: You will need several Cajónes lined up about 8 feet apart. Begin facing the first Cajón with one Pierna slightly behind the other. Drive off the Espalda Pierna, attempting to gain as much height with the Caderas as possible. Immediately upon landing on the Cajón, drive the other Pierna forward and upward to gain height and distance, leaping from the Cajón. Land between the first two Cajónes with the same Pierna that landed on the first Cajón. Then, step to the next Cajón and repeat.

Isquiotibiales.name: Saltos de Valla
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Set up a row of hurdles or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart.
Stand in front of the first hurdle with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Begin by jumping with both feet over the first hurdle, swinging both arms as you jump.
Absorb the impact of landing by bending the knees, rebounding out of the first leap by jumping over the next hurdle. Continue until you have jumped over all of the hurdles.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Set up a Remo of hurdles or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart. Stand in Frontal of the first hurdle with your feet Hombro width apart. This will be your starting position. Begin by Saltoing with both feet over the first hurdle, swinging both arms as you Salto. Absorb the impact of landing by bending the knees, rebounding out of the first leap by Saltoing over the next hurdle. Continue until you have Saltoed over all of the hurdles.

Isquiotibiales.name: Knee Tuck Salto
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Begin in a comfortable standing position with your knees slightly bent. Hold your hands in front of you, palms down with your fingertips together at chest height. This will be your starting position.
Rapidly dip down into a quarter squat and immediately explode upward. Drive the knees towards the chest, attempting to touch them to the palms of the hands.
Jump as high as you can, raising your knees up, and then ensure a good land be re-extending your legs, absorbing impact through be allowing the knees to rebend.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Begin in a comfortable De Pie position with your knees slightly bent. Hold your hands in Frontal of you, palms down with your fingertips together at Pecho height. This will be your starting position. Rapidly Fondo down into a quarter Sentadilla and immediately explode upward. Drive the knees towards the Pecho, attempting to touch them to the palms of the hands. Salto as Alto as you can, raising your knees up, and then ensure a good land be re-extending your Piernas, absorbing impact through be alBajoing the knees to rebend.

Isquiotibiales.name: Linear 3-part Start Technique
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
This drill helps you accelerate as quickly as possible into a sprint from a dead stop. It helps to use a line to start from. Begin with two feet on the line. Place your left foot with the toe next to your right ankle. Place your right foot 4-6 inches behind the left.
Place your right hand onto the line, and thing bring your nose close to your left knee.
Squat down as you lean foward, your head being lower than your hips and your weight loaded onto the left leg. This will be your starting position.
Take your left hand up so that it is parallel to the ground, pointing behind you, and explode out when ready.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: This drill helps you accelerate as quickly as possible into a sprint from a dead stop. It helps to use a line to start from. Begin with two feet on the line. Place your left foot with the toe next to your right ankle. Place your right foot 4-6 inches behind the left. Place your right hand onto the line, and thing bring your nose close to your left knee. Sentadilla down as you lean foward, your head being Bajoer than your Caderas and your weight loaded onto the left Pierna. This will be your starting position. Take your left hand up so that it is parallel to the ground, pointing behind you, and explode out when ready.

Isquiotibiales.name: Linear Acceleration Wall Drill
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Lean at around 45 degrees against a wall. Your feet should be together, glutes contracted.
Begin by lifting your right knee quickly, pausing, and then driving it straight down into the ground.
Switch legs, raising the opposite knee, and then attacking the ground straight down.
Repeat once more with your right leg, and as soon as the right foot strikes the ground hammer them out rapidly, alternating left and right as fast as you can.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Lean at around 45 degrees against a wall. Your feet should be together, Glúteos contracted. Begin by lifting your right knee quickly, pausing, and then driving it straight down into the ground. Switch Piernas, raising the opposite knee, and then attacking the ground straight down. Repeat once more with your right Pierna, and as soon as the right foot strikes the ground Martillo them out rapidly, Alternando left and right as fast as you can.

Isquiotibiales.name: Moving Claw Series
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
This move helps prepare your running form to help you excel at sprinting. As you run, be sure to flex the knee, aiming to kick your glutes as the hip extends.
Reload the quad as the leg moves back forward, attacking the ground on the next step.
Ensure that as you run, you block with the arms, punching through in a rapid 1-2 motion.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: This move helps prepare your running form to help you excel at sprinting. As you run, be sure to flex the knee, aiming to kick your Glúteos as the Cadera extends. Reload the quad as the Pierna moves Espalda forward, attacking the ground on the next step. Ensure that as you run, you Bloque with the arms, punching through in a rapid 1-2 motion.

Isquiotibiales.name: Vertical Swing
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Allow the dumbbell to hang at arms length between your legs, holding it with both hands. Keep your back straight and your head up.
Swing the dumbbell between your legs, flexing at the hips and bending the knees slightly.
Powerfully reverse the motion by extending at the hips, knees, and ankles to propel yourself upward, swinging the dumbell over your head.
As you land, absorb the impact through your legs and draw the dumbbell to your torso before the next repetition.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: AlBajo the Mancuerna to Colgado at arms length between your Piernas, holding it with both hands. Keep your Espalda straight and your head up. Swing the Mancuerna between your Piernas, flexing at the Caderas and bending the knees slightly. Powerfully Inverso the motion by extending at the Caderas, knees, and ankles to propel yourself upward, swinging the dumbell over your head. As you land, absorb the impact through your Piernas and draw the Mancuerna to your torso before the next repetition.

Isquiotibiales.name: Curl Nórdico Invertido
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Start by standing straight with a weighted plate held by both hands and arms fully extended. Use a pronated grip (palms facing down) and make sure your fingers grab the rough side of the plate while your thumb grabs the smooth side. Note: For the best results, grab the weighted plate at an 11:00 and 1:00 o'clock position.
Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other and the weighted plate should be near the groin area. This is the starting position.
Slowly lift the plate up while keeping the elbows in and the upper arms stationary until your biceps and forearms touch while exhaling. The plate should be evenly aligned with your torso at this point.
Feel the contraction for a second and begin to lower the weight back down to the starting position while inhaling
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Start by De Pie straight with a weighted Disco held by both hands and arms fully extended. Use a pronated grip (palms facing down) and make sure your fingers grab the rough Lateral of the Disco while your thumb grabs the smooth Lateral. Note: For the best results, grab the weighted Disco at an 11:00 and 1:00 o'clock position. Your feet should be Hombro width apart from each other and the weighted Disco should be near the groin area. This is the starting position. SBajoly lift the Disco up while keeping the elbows in and the upper arms stationary until your Bíceps and foPosteriorms touch while exhaling. The Disco should be evenly aligned with your torso at this point. Feel the contraction for a second and begin to Bajoer the weight Espalda down to the starting position while inhaling Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Isquiotibiales.name: Banda Buenos Días
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Using a 41 inch band, stand on one end, spreading your feet a small amount. Bend at the hips to loop the end of the band behind your neck. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your legs straight, extend through the hips to come to a near vertical position.
Ensure that you do not round your back as you go down back to the starting position.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Using a 41 inch Banda, stand on one end, spreading your feet a small amount. Bend at the Caderas to loop the end of the Banda behind your neck. This will be your starting position. Keeping your Piernas straight, extend through the Caderas to come to a near vertical position. Ensure that you do not round your Espalda as you go down Espalda to the starting position.

Isquiotibiales.name: Banda Buenos Días (Pull Through)
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Loop the band around a post. Standing a little ways away, loop the opposite end around the neck. Your hands can help hold the band in position.
Begin by bending at the hips, getting your butt back as far as possible. Keep your back flat and bend forward to about 90 degrees. Your knees should be only slightly bent.
Return to the starting position be driving through with the hips to come back to a standing position.
Isquiotibiales.instructions_es: Loop the Banda around a post. De Pie a little ways away, loop the opposite end around the neck. Your hands can help hold the Banda in position. Begin by bending at the Caderas, getting your butt Espalda as far as possible. Keep your Espalda flat and bend forward to about 90 degrees. Your knees should be only slightly bent. Return to the starting position be driving through with the Caderas to come Espalda to a De Pie position.

Isquiotibiales.name: Glúteo Ham Elevación
Isquiotibiales.instructions_en:
Begin by adjusting the equipment to fit your body. Place your feet against the footplate in between the rollers as you lie facedown. Your knees should be just behind the pad.
Start from the bottom of the movement. Keep your back arched as you begin the movement by flexing the knees. Drive your toes into the foot plate as you do so. Keep your upper body straight, and continue until your body is upright.
Return to the starting position, keeping your descent under control.
