Lumbares.name: Hiperextensiones de Cadera
Lumbares.instructions_en:
To begin, lie down on an exercise ball with your torso pressing against the ball and parallel to the floor. The ball of your feet should be pressed against the floor to help keep you balanced. Place a weighted plate under your chin or behind your neck. This is the starting position.
Slowly raise your torso up by bending at the waist and lower back. Remember to exhale during this movement.
Hold the contraction on your lower back for a second and lower your torso back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions prescribed in your program.
Lumbares.instructions_es: To begin, lie down on an exercise ball with your torso Pressing against the ball and parallel to the Suelo. The ball of your feet should be Pressed against the Suelo to help keep you balanced. Place a weighted Disco under your chin or behind your neck. This is the starting position. SBajoly Elevación your torso up by bending at the waist and Bajoer Espalda. Remember to exhale during this movement. Hold the contraction on your Bajoer Espalda for a second and Bajoer your torso Espalda down to the starting position while inhaling. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions prescribed in your program.

Lumbares.name: Cat Stretch
Lumbares.instructions_en:
Position yourself on the floor on your hands and knees.
Pull your belly in and round your spine, lower back, shoulders, and neck, letting your head drop.
Hold for 15 seconds.
Lumbares.instructions_es: Position yourself on the Suelo on your hands and knees. Pull your belly in and round your spine, Bajoer Espalda, Hombros, and neck, letting your head drop. Hold for 15 seconds.

Lumbares.name: Zancada Inversa
Lumbares.instructions_en:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Perform a rear lunge by stepping back with one foot and flexing the hips and front knee. As you do so, rotate your torso across the front leg.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position and repeat on the other side, continuing in an alternating fashion.
Lumbares.instructions_es: Stand with your feet Hombro width apart. This will be your starting position. Perform a Posterior Zancada by stepping Espalda with one foot and flexing the Caderas and Frontal knee. As you do so, rotate your torso across the Frontal Pierna. After a brief pause, return to the starting position and repeat on the other Lateral, continuing in an Alternando fashion.

Lumbares.name: Dancer's Stretch
Lumbares.instructions_en:
Sit up on the floor.
Cross your right leg over your left, keeping the knee bent. Your left leg is straight and down on the floor.
Place your left arm on your right leg and your right hand on the floor.
Rotate your upper body to the right, and hold for 10-20 seconds. Switch sides.
Lumbares.instructions_es: Sit up on the Suelo. Cross your right Pierna over your left, keeping the knee bent. Your left Pierna is straight and down on the Suelo. Place your left arm on your right Pierna and your right hand on the Suelo. Rotate your upper body to the right, and hold for 10-20 seconds. Switch Laterals.

Lumbares.name: Hug a Ball
Lumbares.instructions_en:
Seat yourself on the floor.
Straddle an exercise ball between both legs and lower your hips down toward the floor.
Hug your arms around the ball to support your body. Adjust your legs so that your feet are flat on the floor and your knees line up over your ankles. Keep a good grip on the ball so it doesn't roll away from you and send you back onto your buttocks.
Lumbares.instructions_es: Seat yourself on the Suelo. Straddle an exercise ball between both Piernas and Bajoer your Caderas down toward the Suelo. Hug your arms around the ball to support your body. Adjust your Piernas so that your feet are flat on the Suelo and your knees line up over your ankles. Keep a good grip on the ball so it doesn't roll away from you and send you Espalda onto your buttocks.

Lumbares.name: Báscula Pélvica
Lumbares.instructions_en:
Lie down with your feet on the floor, heels directly under your knees.
Lift only your tailbone to the ceiling to stretch your lower back. (Don't lift the entire spine yet.) Pull in your stomach.
To go into a bridge, lift the entire spine except the neck.
Lumbares.instructions_es: Lie down with your feet on the Suelo, heels directly under your knees. Lift only your tailbone to the ceiling to stretch your Bajoer Espalda. (Don't lift the entire spine yet.) Pull in your stomach. To go into a bridge, lift the entire spine except the neck.

Lumbares.name: Báscula Pélvica
Lumbares.instructions_en:
Start off with your feet hip-distance apart.
Bend your knees slightly to keep them soft and springy.
You may want to move your pelvis forward and backward and back few times before holding the tailbone forward in this stretch.

Lumbares.name: Superman
Lumbares.instructions_en:
To begin, lie straight and face down on the floor or exercise mat. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you. This is the starting position.
Simultaneously raise your arms, legs, and chest off of the floor and hold this contraction for 2 seconds. Tip: Squeeze your lower back to get the best results from this exercise. Remember to exhale during this movement. Note: When holding the contracted position, you should look like superman when he is flying.
Slowly begin to lower your arms, legs and chest back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions prescribed in your program.
Lumbares.instructions_es: To begin, lie straight and face down on the Suelo or exercise mat. Your arms should be fully extended in Frontal of you. This is the starting position. Simultaneously Elevación your arms, Piernas, and Pecho off of the Suelo and hold this contraction for 2 seconds. Tip: Squeeze your Bajoer Espalda to get the best results from this exercise. Lumbares.name: Peso muerto con bandas
Lumbares.instructions_en:
To deadlift with short bands, simply loop them over the bar before you start, and step into them to set up. For long bands, they will need to be anchored to a secure base, such as heavy dumbbells or a rack.
With your feet, and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and bend the knees until your shins contact the bar. Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward. After the bar passes the knees, aggressively pull the bar back, pulling your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward into the bar.
Lower the bar by bending at the hips and guiding it to the floor.
Lumbares.instructions_es: To Peso Muerto with short Bandas, simply loop them over the bar before you start, and step into them to set up. Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet. You feet should be about hip width apart. Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing your shoulder blades to protract. Typically, you would use an overhand grip or an over/under grip on heavier sets. Lower the bar by bending at the hips and guiding it to the floor.

Lumbares.name: Rack Pull With Bandas
Lumbares.instructions_en:
Set up in a power rack with the bar on the pins. The pins should be set to the desired point; just below the knees, just above, or in the mid thigh position. Attach bands to the base of the rack, or secure them with dumbbells. Attach the other end to the bar. You may need to choke the bands to provide tension.
Position yourself against the bar in proper deadlifting position. Your feet should be under your hips, your grip shoulder width, back arched, and hips back to engage the hamstrings. Since the weight is typically heavy, you may use a mixed grip, a hook grip, or use straps to aid in holding the weight.
With your head looking forward, extend through the hips and knees, pulling the weight up and back until lockout. Be sure to pull your shoulders back as you complete the movement. Return the weight to the pins and repeat.

Lumbares.name: Inverso Banda Peso Muerto

Lumbares.name: Buenos Días Sentado
Lumbares.instructions_en:
Set up a box in a power rack. The pins should be set at an appropriate height. Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders, not on top of your traps. Squeeze your shoulder blades together and rotate your elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across your shoulders.
Remove the bar from the rack, creating a tight arch in your lower back. Keep your head facing forward. With your back, shoulders, and core tight, push your knees and butt out and you begin your descent. Sit back with your hips until you are seated on the box. This will be your starting position.
Keeping the bar tight, bend forward at the hips as much as possible. If you set the pins to what would be parallel, you not only have a safety if you fail, but know when to stop.
Pause just above the pins and reverse the motion until your torso it upright.
Lumbares.instructions_es: Set up a Cajón in a Power rack. The pins should be set at an appropriate height. Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the Espalda of the Hombros, not on top of your traps. Squeeze your Hombro blades together and rotate your elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across your Hombros. Remove the bar from the rack, creating a tight arch in your Bajoer Espalda. Keep your head facing forward. With your Espalda, Hombros, and core tight, push your knees and butt out and you begin your descent. Sit Espalda with your Caderas until you are Sentado on the Cajón. If you set the pins to what would be parallel, you not only have a safety if you fail, but know when to stop. Pause just above the pins and Inverso the motion until your torso it Vertical.

Lumbares.name: Atlas Stone Trainer
Lumbares.instructions_en:
This trainer is effective for developing Atlas Stone strength for those who don't have access to stones, and are typically made from bar ends or heavy pipe.
Begin by loading the desired weight onto the bar. Straddle the weight, wrapping your arms around the implement, bending at the hips.
Begin by pulling the weight up past the knees, extending through the hips. As the weight clears the knees, it can be lapped by resting it on your thighs and sitting back, hugging it tightly to your chest.
Finish the movement by extending through your hips and knees to raise the weight as high as possible. The weight can be returned to the lap or to the ground for successive repetitions.

Begin by pulling the weight up past the knees, extending through the Caderas. As the weight clears the knees, it can be lapped by resting it on your tAltos and sitting Espalda, hugging it tightly to your Pecho. Finish the movement by extending through your Caderas and knees to Elevación the weight as Alto as possible. The weight can be returned to the lap or to the ground for successive repetitions.

Lumbares.name: Atlas Stones
Lumbares.instructions_en:
Begin with the atlas stone between your feet. Bend at the hips to wrap your arms vertically around the Atlas Stone, attempting to get your fingers underneath the stone. Many stones will have a small flat portion on the bottom, which will make the stone easier to hold.
Pulling the stone into your torso, drive through the back half of your feet to pull the stone from the ground.
As the stone passes the knees, lap it by sitting backward, pulling the stone on top of your thighs.
Sit low, getting the stone high onto your chest as you change your grip to reach over the stone. Stand, driving through with your hips. Close distance to the loading platform, and lean back, extending the hips to get the stone as high as possible.
Lumbares.instructions_es: Begin with the atlas stone between your feet. Bend at the Caderas to wrap your arms vertically around the Atlas Stone, attempting to get your fingers underneath the stone. Many stones will have a small flat portion on the bottom, which will make the stone easier to hold. Pulling the stone into your torso, drive through the Espalda half of your feet to pull the stone from the ground. As the stone passes the knees, lap it by sitting Espaldaward, pulling the stone on top of your tAltos. Sit Bajo, getting the stone Alto onto your Pecho as you cColgadoe your grip to reach over the stone. Stand, driving through with your Caderas. Close distance to the loading platform, and lean Espalda, extending the Caderas to get the stone as Alto as possible.

Lumbares.name: Axle Peso Muerto
Lumbares.instructions_en:
Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet. You feet should be about hip width apart. Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing your shoulder blades to protract. Typically, you would use an over/under grip.
With your feet and your grip set, take a big breath and then lower your hips and flex the knees until your shins contact the bar. Look forward with your head, keep your chest up and your back arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward.
After the bar passes the knees, aggressively pull the bar back, pulling your shoulder blades together as you drive your hips forward into the bar.
Lower the bar by bending at the hips and guiding it to the floor.
Lumbares.instructions_es: Approach the bar so that it is centered over your feet. You feet should be about Cadera width apart. Bend at the Cadera to grip the bar at Hombro width, alBajoing your Hombro blades to protract. Typically, you would use an over/under grip. With your feet and your grip set, take a big breath and then Bajoer your Caderas and flex the knees until your shins contact the bar. Look forward with your head, keep your Pecho up and your Espalda arched, and begin driving through the heels to move the weight upward. After the bar passes the knees, aggressively pull the bar Espalda, pulling your Hombro blades together as you drive your Caderas forward into the bar. Bajoer the bar by bending at the Caderas and guiding it to the Suelo.

Lumbares.name: Keg Load
Lumbares.instructions_en:
To load kegs, place the desired number a distance from the loading platform, typically 30-50 feet.
Begin by grabbing the close handle of the first keg, tilting it onto its side to grab the opposite edge of the bottom of the keg. Lift the keg up to your chest.
The higher you can place the keg, the faster you should be able to move to the platform. Shouldering is usually not allowed. Be sure to keep a firm hold on the keg. Move as quickly as possible to the platform, and load it, extending through your hips, knees, and ankles to get it as high as possible.
Return to the starting position to retrieve the next keg, and repeat until the event is completed.
Lumbares.instructions_es: To load kegs, place the desired number a distance from the loading platform, typically 30-50 feet. Begin by grabbing the close handle of the first keg, tilting it onto its Lateral to grab the opposite edge of the bottom of the keg. Lift the keg up to your Pecho. The Altoer you can place the keg, the faster you should be able to move to the platform. Hombroing is usually not alBajoed. Be sure to keep a firm hold on the keg. Move as quickly as possible to the platform, and load it, extending through your Caderas, knees, and ankles to get it as Alto as possible. Return to the starting position to retrieve the next keg, and repeat until the event is completed.

Espalda.name: Alternando Pesa Rusa Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Place two kettlebells in front of your feet. Bend your knees slightly and push your butt out as much as possible. As you bend over to get into the starting position grab both kettlebells by the handles.
Pull one kettlebell off of the floor while holding on to the other kettlebell. Retract the shoulder blade of the working side, as you flex the elbow, drawing the kettlebell towards your stomach or rib cage.
Lower the kettlebell in the working arm and repeat with your other arm.
Espalda.instructions_es: Place two Pesa Rusas in Frontal of your feet. Bend your knees slightly and push your butt out as much as possible. As you bend over to get into the starting position grab both Pesa Rusas by the handles. Pull one Pesa Rusa off of the Suelo while holding on to the other Pesa Rusa. Retract the Hombro blade of the working Lateral, as you flex the elbow, drawing the Pesa Rusa towards your stomach or rib cage. Bajoer the Pesa Rusa in the working arm and repeat with your other arm.

Espalda.name: Alternando Renegade Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Place two kettlebells on the floor about shoulder width apart. Position yourself on your toes and your hands as though you were doing a pushup, with the body straight and extended. Use the handles of the kettlebells to support your upper body. You may need to position your feet wide for support.
Push one kettlebell into the floor and row the other kettlebell, retracting the shoulder blade of the working side as you flex the elbow, pulling it to your side.
Then lower the kettlebell to the floor and begin the kettlebell in the opposite hand. Repeat for several reps.
Espalda.instructions_es: Place two Pesa Rusas on the Suelo about Hombro width apart. Position yourself on your toes and your hands as though you were doing a pushup, with the body straight and extended. Use the handles of the Pesa Rusas to support your upper body. You may need to position your feet wide for support. Push one Pesa Rusa into the Suelo and Remo the other Pesa Rusa, retracting the Hombro blade of the working Lateral as you flex the elbow, pulling it to your Lateral. Then Bajoer the Pesa Rusa to the Suelo and begin the Pesa Rusa in the opposite hand. Repeat for several reps.

Espalda.name: Inclinado Barra Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Holding a barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing down), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The barbell should hang directly in front of you as your arms hang perpendicular to the floor and your torso. This is your starting position.
Now, while keeping the torso stationary, breathe out and lift the barbell to you. Keep the elbows close to the body and only use the forearms to hold the weight. At the top contracted position, squeeze the back muscles and hold for a brief pause.
Then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: Holding a Barra with a pronated grip (palms facing down), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the Espalda straight until it is almost parallel to the Suelo. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The Barra should Colgado directly in Frontal of you as your arms Colgado perpendicular to the Suelo and your torso. This is your starting position. Now, while keeping the torso stationary, breathe out and lift the Barra to you. Keep the elbows close to the body and only use the foPosteriorms to hold the weight. At the top contracted position, squeeze the Espalda Muslos and hold for a brief pause. Then inhale and sBajoly Bajoer the Barra Espalda to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Inclinado Un Brazo Long Bar Remo
Espalda.name_en: Bent Over One-Arm Long Bar Row
Espalda.instructions_en:
Put weight on one of the ends of an Olympic barbell. Make sure that you either place the other end of the barbell in the corner of two walls; or put a heavy object on the ground so the barbell cannot slide backward.
Bend forward until your torso is as close to parallel with the floor as you can and keep your knees slightly bent.
Now grab the bar with one arm just behind the plates on the side where the weight was placed and put your other hand on your knee. This will be your starting position.
Pull the bar straight up with your elbow in (to maximize back stimulation) until the plates touch your lower chest. Squeeze the back muscles as you lift the weight up and hold for a second at the top of the movement. Breathe out as you lift the weight. Tip: Do not allow for any swinging of the torso. Only the arm should move.
Slowly lower the bar to the starting position getting a nice stretch on the lats. Tip: Do not let the plates touch the floor. To ensure the best range of motion, I recommend using small plates (25-lb ones) as opposed to larger plates (like 35-45lb ones).
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and switch arms.
Espalda.instructions_es: Put weight on one of the ends of an Olympic Barra. Make sure that you either place the other end of the Barra in the corner of two walls; or put a heavy object on the ground so the Barra cannot slide Espaldaward. Bend forward until your torso is as close to parallel with the Suelo as you can and keep your knees slightly bent. Now grab the bar with Un Brazo just behind the Discos on the Lateral where the weight was placed and put your other hand on your knee. This will be your starting position. Pull the bar straight up with your elbow in (to maximize Espalda stimulation) until the Discos touch your Bajoer Pecho. Squeeze the Espalda Muslos as you lift the weight up and hold for a second at the top of the movement. Breathe out as you lift the weight. Tip: Do not alBajo for any swinging of the torso. Only the arm should move. SBajoly Bajoer the bar to the starting position getting a nice stretch on the lats. Tip: Do not let the Discos touch the Suelo. To ensure the best range of motion, I recommend using small Discos (25-lb ones) as opposed to larger Discos (like 35-45lb ones). Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and switch arms.

Espalda.name: Inclinado Two-arm Long Bar Remo
Espalda.name_en: Bent Over Two-Arm Long Bar Row
Espalda.instructions_en:
Put weight on one of the ends of an Olympic barbell. Make sure that you either place the other end of the barbell in the corner of two walls; or put a heavy object on the ground so the barbell cannot slide backward.
Bend forward until your torso is as close to parallel with the floor as you can and keep your knees slightly bent.
Now grab the bar with both arms just behind the plates on the side where the weight was placed and put your other hand on your knee. This will be your starting position.
Pull the bar straight up with your elbows in (to maximize back stimulation) until the plates touch your lower chest. Squeeze the back muscles as you lift the weight up and hold for a second at the top of the movement. Breathe out as you lift the weight. Tip: Use a stirrup or double handle cable attachment by hooking it under the end of the bar.
Slowly lower the bar to the starting position getting a nice stretch on the lats. Tip: Do not let the plates touch the floor. To ensure the best range of motion, I recommend using small plates (25-lb ones) as opposed to larger plates (like 35-45lb ones).
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Squeeze the Espalda Muslos as you lift the weight up and hold for a second at the top of the movement. Breathe out as you lift the weight. Tip: Use a stirrup or double handle Polea attachment by hooking it under the end of the bar. SBajoly Bajoer the bar to the starting position getting a nice stretch on the lats. Tip: Do not let the Discos touch the Suelo. To ensure the best range of motion, I recommend using small Discos (25-lb ones) as opposed to larger Discos (like 35-45lb ones). Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Inclinado Two-mancuerna Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
With a dumbbell in each hand (palms facing your torso), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward by bending at the waist; as you bend make sure to keep your back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The weights should hang directly in front of you as your arms hang perpendicular to the floor and your torso. This is your starting position.
While keeping the torso stationary, lift the dumbbells to your side (as you breathe out), keeping the elbows close to the body (do not exert any force with the forearm other than holding the weights). On the top contracted position, squeeze the back muscles and hold for a second.
Slowly lower the weight again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: With a Mancuerna in each hand (palms facing your torso), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward by bending at the waist; as you bend make sure to keep your Espalda straight until it is almost parallel to the Suelo. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The weights should Colgado directly in Frontal of you as your arms Colgado perpendicular to the Suelo and your torso. This is your starting position. While keeping the torso stationary, lift the Mancuernas to your Lateral (as you breathe out), keeping the elbows close to the body (do not exert any force with the foPosteriorm other than holding the weights). On the top contracted position, squeeze the Espalda Muslos and hold for a second. SBajoly Bajoer the weight again to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Inclinado Two-mancuerna Remo With Palms In
Espalda.name_en: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row With Palms In
Espalda.instructions_en:
With a dumbbell in each hand (palms facing each other), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The weights should hang directly in front of you as your arms hang perpendicular to the floor and your torso. This is your starting position.
While keeping the torso stationary, lift the dumbbells to your side as you breathe out, squeezing your shoulder blades together. On the top contracted position, squeeze the back muscles and hold for a second.
Slowly lower the weight again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: With a Mancuerna in each hand (palms facing each other), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the Espalda straight until it is almost parallel to the Suelo. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The weights should Colgado directly in Frontal of you as your arms Colgado perpendicular to the Suelo and your torso. This is your starting position. While keeping the torso stationary, lift the Mancuernas to your Lateral as you breathe out, squeezing your Hombro blades together. On the top contracted position, squeeze the Espalda Muslos and hold for a second. SBajoly Bajoer the weight again to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Peso Corporal Mid Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Begin by taking a medium to wide grip on a pull-up apparatus with your palms facing away from you. From a hanging position, tuck your knees to your chest, leaning back and getting your legs over your side of the pull-up apparatus. This will be your starting position.
Beginning with your arms straight, flex the elbows and retract the shoulder blades to raise your body up until your legs contact the pull-up apparatus.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
Espalda.instructions_es: Begin by taking a medium to Agarre Ancho on a pull-up apparatus with your palms facing away from you. From a Colgadoing position, tuck your knees to your Pecho, leaning Espalda and getting your Piernas over your Lateral of the pull-up apparatus. This will be your starting position. Beginning with your arms straight, flex the elbows and retract the Hombro blades to Elevación your body up until your Piernas contact the pull-up apparatus. After a brief pause, return to the starting position.

Espalda.name: Mancuerna Inclinado Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Using a neutral grip, lean into an incline bench.
Take a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, beginning with the arms straight. This will be your starting position.
Retract the shoulder blades and flex the elbows to row the dumbbells to your side.
Pause at the top of the motion, and then return to the starting position.
Espalda.instructions_es: Using a Agarre Neutro, lean into an Banca Inclinada. Take a Mancuerna in each hand with a Agarre Neutro, beginning with the arms straight. This will be your starting position. Retract the Hombro blades and flex the elbows to Remo the Mancuernas to your Lateral. Pause at the top of the motion, and then return to the starting position.

Espalda.name: Banca Inclinada Pull
Espalda.instructions_en:
Grab a dumbbell in each hand and lie face down on an incline bench that is set to an incline that is approximately 30 degrees.
Let the arms hang to your sides fully extended as they point to the floor.
Turn the wrists until your hands have a pronated (palms down) grip.
Now flare the elbows out. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe out, start to pull the dumbbells up as if you are doing a reverse bench press. You will do this by bending at the elbows and bringing the upper arms up as you let the forearms hang. Continue this motion until the upper arms are at the same level as your back. Tip: The elbows will come out to the side and your upper arms and torso should make the letter "T" at the top of the movement. Hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Slowly go back down to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: Grab a Mancuerna in each hand and lie face down on an Banca Inclinada that is set to an Inclinado that is approximately 30 degrees. Let the arms Colgado to your Laterals fully extended as they point to the Suelo. Turn the Muñecas until your hands have a pronated (palms down) grip. Now flare the elbows out. This will be your starting position. As you breathe out, start to pull the Mancuernas up as if you are doing a Inverso Press de Banca. You will do this by bending at the elbows and bringing the upper arms up as you let the foPosteriorms Colgado. Continue this motion until the upper arms are at the same level as your Espalda. Tip: The elbows will come out to the Lateral and your upper arms and torso should make the letter "T" at the top of the movement. Hold the contraction at the top for a second. SBajoly go Espalda down to the starting position as you breathe in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Inverted Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Position a bar in a rack to about waist height. You can also use a smith machine.
Take a wider than shoulder width grip on the bar and position yourself hanging underneath the bar. Your body should be straight with your heels on the ground with your arms fully extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by flexing the elbow, pulling your chest towards the bar. Retract your shoulder blades as you perform the movement.
Pause at the top of the motion, and return yourself to the start position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: Position a bar in a rack to about waist height. You can also use a MultiPower. Take a wider than Hombro width grip on the bar and position yourself Colgadoing underneath the bar. Your body should be straight with your heels on the ground with your arms fully extended. This will be your starting position. Begin by flexing the elbow, pulling your Pecho towards the bar. Retract your Hombro blades as you perform the movement. Pause at the top of the motion, and return yourself to the start position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Inverted Remo With Straps
Espalda.instructions_en:
Hang a rope or suspension straps from a rack or other stable object. Grasp the ends and position yourself in a supine position hanging from the ropes. Your body should be straight with your heels on the ground with your arms fully extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by flexing the elbow, pulling your chest to your hands. Retract your shoulder blades as you perform the movement.
Pause at the top of the motion, and return yourself to the start position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: Colgado a rope or suspension straps from a rack or other stable object. Grasp the ends and position yourself in a Tumbado Supino position Colgadoing from the ropes. Your body should be straight with your heels on the ground with your arms fully extended. This will be your starting position. Begin by flexing the elbow, pulling your Pecho to your hands. Retract your Hombro blades as you perform the movement. Pause at the top of the motion, and return yourself to the start position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Leverage Alto Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that you can just reach the handles above you. Adjust the knee pad to help keep you down. Grasp the handles with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
Pull the handles towards your torso, retracting your shoulder blades as you flex the elbow.
Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then slowly return the handles to the starting position.
For multiple repetitions, avoid completely returning the weight to the stops to keep tension on the muscles being worked.
Espalda.instructions_es: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that you can just reach the handles above you. Adjust the knee pad to help keep you down. Grasp the handles with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position. Pull the handles towards your torso, retracting your Hombro blades as you flex the elbow. Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then sBajoly return the handles to the starting position. For multiple repetitions, avoid completely returning the weight to the stops to keep tension on the Muslos being worked.

Espalda.name: Recostado Cambered Barra Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Place a cambered bar underneath an exercise bench.
Lie face down on the exercise bench and grab the bar using a palms down (pronated grip) that is wider than shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale row the bar up as you keep the elbows close to your body to either your chest, in order to target the upper mid back, or to your stomach if targeting the lats is your goal.
After a second hold at the top, lower back down to the starting position slowly as you inhale.
Espalda.instructions_es: Place a cambered bar underneath an exercise bench. Lie face down on the exercise bench and grab the bar using a palms down (pronated grip) that is wider than Hombro width. This will be your starting position. As you exhale Remo the bar up as you keep the elbows close to your body to either your Pecho, in order to target the upper mid Espalda, or to your stomach if targeting the lats is your goal. After a second hold at the top, Bajoer Espalda down to the starting position sBajoly as you inhale.

Espalda.name: Recostado Remo Barra T
Espalda.instructions_en:
Load up the T-bar Row Machine with the desired weight and adjust the leg height so that your upper chest is at the top of the pad. Tip: In some machines all you can do is stand on the appropriate step that allows you to be at a height that has the upper chest at the top of the pad.
Lay face down on the pad and grab the handles. You can either use a palms down, palms up, or palms in position depending on what part of your back you want to emphasize.
Lift the bar off the rack and extend your arms in front of you. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale slowly pull the weight up and squeeze your back at the top of the movement. Tip: Keep the upper arms as close to the torso as possible throughout the movement in order to better engage the back muscles. Also, do not lift your body off of the pad at any time and refrain from using the biceps to lift the weight.
After a second contraction at the top of the movement, as you inhale, slowly go back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: Load up the Remo Barra T Máquina with the desired weight and adjust the Pierna height so that your upper Pecho is at the top of the pad. Tip: In some Máquinas all you can do is stand on the appropriate step that alBajos you to be at a height that has the upper Pecho at the top of the pad. Lay face down on the pad and grab the handles. You can either use a palms down, palms up, or palms in position depending on what part of your Espalda you want to emphasize. Lift the bar off the rack and extend your arms in Frontal of you. This will be your starting position. As you exhale sBajoly pull the weight up and squeeze your Espalda at the top of the movement. Tip: Keep the upper arms as close to the torso as possible throughout the movement in order to better engage the Espalda Muslos. Also, do not lift your body off of the pad at any time and refrain from using the Bíceps to lift the weight. After a second contraction at the top of the movement, as you inhale, sBajoly go Espalda down to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Middle Espalda Encogimiento
Espalda.instructions_en:
Lie facedown on an incline bench while holding a dumbbell in each hand. Your arms should be fully extended hanging down and pointing towards the floor. The palms of your hands should be facing each other. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, squeeze your shoulder blades together and hold the contraction for a full second. Tip: This movement is just like the reverse action of a hug, or trying to perform rear laterals as if you had no arms.
As you inhale go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: Lie facedown on an Banca Inclinada while holding a Mancuerna in each hand. Your arms should be fully extended Colgadoing down and pointing towards the Suelo. The palms of your hands should be facing each other. This will be your starting position. As you exhale, squeeze your Hombro blades together and hold the contraction for a full second. Tip: This movement is just like the Inverso action of a hug, or trying to perform Posterior Laterals as if you had no arms. As you inhale go Espalda to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Mixed Grip Chin
Espalda.instructions_en:
Using a spacing that is just about 1 inch wider than shoulder width, grab a pull-up bar with the palms of one hand facing forward and the palms of the other hand facing towards you. This will be your starting position.
Now start to pull yourself up as you exhale. Tip: With the arm that has the palms facing up concentrate on using the back muscles in order to perform the movement. The elbow of that arm should remain close to the torso. With the other arm that has the palms facing forward, the elbows will be away but in line with the torso. You will concentrate on using the lats to pull your body up.
After a second contraction at the top, start to slowly come down as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
On the following set, switch grips; so if you had the right hand with the palms facing you and the left one with the palms facing forward, on the next set you will have the palms facing forward for the right hand and facing you for the left.
Espalda.instructions_es: Using a spacing that is just about 1 inch wider than Hombro width, grab a pull-up bar with the palms of one hand facing forward and the palms of the other hand facing towards you. This will be your starting position. Now start to pull yourself up as you exhale. Tip: With the arm that has the palms facing up concentrate on using the Espalda Muslos in order to perform the movement. The elbow of that arm should remain close to the torso. With the other arm that has the palms facing forward, the elbows will be away but in line with the torso. You will concentrate on using the lats to pull your body up. After a second contraction at the top, start to sBajoly come down as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. On the folBajoing set, switch grips; so if you had the right hand with the palms facing you and the left one with the palms facing forward, on the next set you will have the palms facing forward for the right hand and facing you for the left.

Espalda.name: Un Brazo Mancuerna Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Choose a flat bench and place a dumbbell on each side of it.
Place the right leg on top of the end of the bench, bend your torso forward from the waist until your upper body is parallel to the floor, and place your right hand on the other end of the bench for support.
Use the left hand to pick up the dumbbell on the floor and hold the weight while keeping your lower back straight. The palm of the hand should be facing your torso. This will be your starting position.
Pull the resistance straight up to the side of your chest, keeping your upper arm close to your side and keeping the torso stationary. Breathe out as you perform this step. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. Also, make sure that the force is performed with the back muscles and not the arms. Finally, the upper torso should remain stationary and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work except for holding the dumbbell; therefore do not try to pull the dumbbell up using the forearms.
Lower the resistance straight down to the starting position. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Repeat the movement for the specified amount of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat again with the other arm.
Espalda.instructions_es: Choose a flat bench and place a Mancuerna on each Lateral of it. Place the right Pierna on top of the end of the bench, bend your torso forward from the waist until your upper body is parallel to the Suelo, and place your right hand on the other end of the bench for support. Use the left hand to pick up the Mancuerna on the Suelo and hold the weight while keeping your Bajoer Espalda straight. The palm of the hand should be facing your torso. This will be your starting position. Pull the resistance straight up to the Lateral of your Pecho, keeping your upper arm close to your Lateral and keeping the torso stationary. Breathe out as you perform this step. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the Espalda Muslos once you reach the full contracted position. Also, make sure that the force is performed with the Espalda Muslos and not the arms. Finally, the upper torso should remain stationary and only the arms should move. The foPosteriorms should do no other work except for holding the Mancuerna; therefore do not try to pull the Mancuerna up using the foPosteriorms. Bajoer the resistance straight down to the starting position. Breathe in as you perform this step. Repeat the movement for the specified amount of repetitions. Switch Laterals and repeat again with the other arm.

Espalda.name: Un Brazo Pesa Rusa Remo
Espalda.instructions_en: Place a kettlebell in front of your feet. Bend your knees slightly and then push your butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in the starting position. Grab the kettlebell and pull it to your stomach, retracting your shoulder blade and flexing the elbow. Keep your back straight. Lower and repeat.
Espalda.instructions_es: Place a Pesa Rusa in Frontal of your feet. Bend your knees slightly and then push your butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in the starting position. Grab the Pesa Rusa and pull it to your stomach, retracting your Hombro blade and flexing the elbow. Keep your Espalda straight. Bajoer and repeat.

Espalda.name: Un Brazo Long Bar Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Position a bar into a landmine or in a corner to keep it from moving. Load an appropriate weight onto your end.
Stand next to the bar, and take a grip with one hand close to the collar. Using your hips and legs, rise to a standing position.
Assume a bent-knee stance with your hips back and your chest up. Your arm should be extended. This will be your starting position.
Pull the weight to your side by retracting the shoulder and flexing the elbow. Do not jerk the weight or cheat during the movement.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
Espalda.instructions_es: Position a bar into a Landmine or in a corner to keep it from moving. Load an appropriate weight onto your end. Stand next to the bar, and take a grip with one hand close to the collar. Using your Caderas and Piernas, rise to a De Pie position. Assume a bent-knee stance with your Caderas Espalda and your Pecho up. Your arm should be extended. This will be your starting position. Pull the weight to your Lateral by retracting the Hombro and flexing the elbow. Do not Envión the weight or cheat during the movement. After a brief pause, return to the starting position.

Espalda.name: Un Brazo Dominada Supina
Espalda.instructions_en:
For this exercise, start out by placing a towel around a chin up bar.
Grab the chin-up bar with your palm facing you. One hand will be grabbing the chin-up bar and the other will be grabbing the towel.
Bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.v
Pull your torso up until the bar touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the movement.
Espalda.instructions_es: For this exercise, start out by placing a towel around a chin up bar. Grab the Dominada Supina bar with your palm facing you. One hand will be grabbing the Dominada Supina bar and the other will be grabbing the towel. Bring your torso Espalda around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your Bajoer Espalda and sticking your Pecho out. This is your starting position.v Pull your torso up until the bar touches your upper Pecho by drawing the Hombros and the upper arms down and Espalda. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the Espalda Muslos once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The foPosteriorms should do no other work other than hold the bar. After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and sBajoly Bajoer your torso Espalda to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched. Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions. Switch arms and repeat the movement.

Espalda.name: Agarre Inverso Inclinado Remos
Espalda.instructions_en:
Stand erect while holding a barbell with a supinated grip (palms facing up).
Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The barbell should hang directly in front of you as your arms hang perpendicular to the floor and your torso. This is your starting position.
While keeping the torso stationary, lift the barbell as you breathe out, keeping the elbows close to the body and not doing any force with the forearm other than holding the weights. On the top contracted position, squeeze the back muscles and hold for a second.
Slowly lower the weight again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: Stand erect while holding a Barra with a supinated grip (palms facing up). Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the Espalda straight until it is almost parallel to the Suelo. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The Barra should Colgado directly in Frontal of you as your arms Colgado perpendicular to the Suelo and your torso. This is your starting position. While keeping the torso stationary, lift the Barra as you breathe out, keeping the elbows close to the body and not doing any force with the foPosteriorm other than holding the weights. On the top contracted position, squeeze the Espalda Muslos and hold for a second. SBajoly Bajoer the weight again to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Sentado Polea Remos
Espalda.instructions_en:
For this exercise you will need access to a low pulley row machine with a V-bar. Note: The V-bar will enable you to have a neutral grip where the palms of your hands face each other. To get into the starting position, first sit down on the machine and place your feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked.
Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your back and grab the V-bar handles.
With your arms extended pull back until your torso is at a 90-degree angle from your legs. Your back should be slightly arched and your chest should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on your lats as you hold the bar in front of you. This is the starting position of the exercise.
Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles back towards your torso while keeping the arms close to it until you touch the abdominals. Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing your back muscles hard. Hold that contraction for a second and slowly go back to the original position while breathing in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: For this exercise you will need access to a Bajo pulley Remo Máquina with a V-bar. Note: The V-bar will enable you to have a Agarre Neutro where the palms of your hands face each other. To get into the starting position, first sit down on the Máquina and place your feet on the Frontal platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked. Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your Espalda and grab the V-bar handles. With your arms extended pull Espalda until your torso is at a 90-degree angle from your Piernas. Your Espalda should be slightly arched and your Pecho should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on your lats as you hold the bar in Frontal of you. This is the starting position of the exercise. Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles Espalda towards your torso while keeping the arms close to it until you touch the Abdominals. Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing your Espalda Muslos hard. Hold that contraction for a second and sBajoly go Espalda to the original position while breathing in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Sentado Un Brazo Polea Pulley Remos
Espalda.instructions_en:
To get into the starting position, first sit down on the machine and place your feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked.
Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your back and grab the single handle attachment with your left arm using a palms-down grip.
With your arm extended pull back until your torso is at a 90-degree angle from your legs. Your back should be slightly arched and your chest should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on your lat as you hold the bar in front of you. The right arm can be kept by the waist. This is the starting position of the exercise.
Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles back towards your torso while keeping the arms close to it as you rotate the wrist, so that by the time your hand is by your abdominals it is in a neutral position (palms facing the torso). Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing your back muscles hard.
Hold that contraction for a second and slowly go back to the original position while breathing in. Tip: Remember to rotate the wrist as you go back to the starting position so that the palms are facing down again.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform the same movement with the right hand.
Espalda.instructions_es: To get into the starting position, first sit down on the Máquina and place your feet on the Frontal platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked. Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your Espalda and grab the single handle attachment with your left arm using a palms-down grip. With your arm extended pull Espalda until your torso is at a 90-degree angle from your Piernas. Your Espalda should be slightly arched and your Pecho should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on your lat as you hold the bar in Frontal of you. The right arm can be kept by the waist. This is the starting position of the exercise. Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles Espalda towards your torso while keeping the arms close to it as you rotate the Muñeca, so that by the time your hand is by your Abdominals it is in a neutral position (palms facing the torso). Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing your Espalda Muslos hard. Hold that contraction for a second and sBajoly go Espalda to the original position while breathing in. Tip: Remember to rotate the Muñeca as you go Espalda to the starting position so that the palms are facing down again. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform the same movement with the right hand.

Espalda.name: Trineo Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Attach dual handles to a sled connected by a rope or chain. Load the sled to an appropriate weight. Face the sled, backing up until there is some tension in the line.
With a handle in each hand, bend the knees slightly, keep your head and chest up, and begin with your arms extended.
To initiate the movement, flex the elbow as you retract your shoulder blades, pulling the sled towards you.
Take a step or two back to get tension in the line and repeat.
Espalda.instructions_es: Attach dual handles to a Trineo connected by a rope or chain. Load the Trineo to an appropriate weight. Face the Trineo, Espaldaing up until there is some tension in the line. With a handle in each hand, bend the knees slightly, keep your head and Pecho up, and begin with your arms extended. To initiate the movement, flex the elbow as you retract your Hombro blades, pulling the Trineo towards you. Take a step or two Espalda to get tension in the line and repeat.

Espalda.name: Multipower Remo con Barra
Espalda.instructions_en:
Set the barbell attached to the smith machine to a height that is about 2 inches below your knees.
Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up.
Now grasp the barbell using an overhand (pronated) grip and unlock it from the smith machine rack. Then let it hang directly in front of you as your arms hang extended perpendicular to the floor and your torso. This is your starting position.
While keeping the torso stationary, lift the barbell as you breathe out, keeping the elbows close to the body and not doing any force with the forearm other than holding the weights. On the top contracted position, squeeze the back muscles and hold for a second.
Slowly lower the weight again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Espalda.instructions_es: Set the Barra attached to the MultiPower to a height that is about 2 inches beBajo your knees. Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the Espalda straight until it is almost parallel to the Suelo. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. Now grasp the Barra using an overhand (pronated) grip and unlock it from the MultiPower rack. Then let it Colgado directly in Frontal of you as your arms Colgado extended perpendicular to the Suelo and your torso. This is your starting position. While keeping the torso stationary, lift the Barra as you breathe out, keeping the elbows close to the body and not doing any force with the foPosteriorm other than holding the weights. On the top contracted position, squeeze the Espalda Muslos and hold for a second. SBajoly Bajoer the weight again to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Espalda.name: Straight Bar Bench Mid Remos
Espalda.instructions_en:
Place a loaded barbell on the end of a bench. Standing on the bench behind the bar, take a medium, pronated grip. Stand with your hips back and chest up, maintaining a neutral spine. This will be your starting position.
Row the bar to your torso by retracting the shoulder blades and flexing the elbows. Use a controlled movement with no jerking.
After a brief pause, slowly return the bar to the starting position, ensuring to go all the way down.
Espalda.instructions_es: Place a loaded Barra on the end of a bench. De Pie on the bench behind the bar, take a medium, pronated grip. Stand with your Caderas Espalda and Pecho up, maintaining a neutral spine. This will be your starting position. Remo the bar to your torso by retracting the Hombro blades and flexing the elbows. Use a controlled movement with no Envióning. After a brief pause, sBajoly return the bar to the starting position, ensuring to go all the way down.

Espalda.name: Suspended Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Suspend your straps at around chest height. Take a handle in each hand and lean back. Keep your body erect and your head and chest up. Your arms should be fully extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by flexing the elbow to initiate the movement. Protract your shoulder blades as you do so.
At the completion of the motion pause, and then return to the starting position.
Espalda.instructions_es: Suspend your straps at around Pecho height. Take a handle in each hand and lean Espalda. Keep your body erect and your head and Pecho up. Your arms should be fully extended. This will be your starting position. Begin by flexing the elbow to initiate the movement. Protract your Hombro blades as you do so. At the completion of the motion pause, and then return to the starting position.

Espalda.name: Remo Barra T With Handle
Espalda.instructions_en:
Position a bar into a landmine or in a corner to keep it from moving. Load an appropriate weight onto your end.
Stand over the bar, and position a Double D row handle around the bar next to the collar. Using your hips and legs, rise to a standing position.
Assume a wide stance with your hips back and your chest up. Your arms should be extended. This will be your starting position.
Pull the weight to your upper abdomen by retracting the shoulder blades and flexing the elbows. Do not jerk the weight or cheat during the movement.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
Espalda.instructions_es: Position a bar into a Landmine or in a corner to keep it from moving. Load an appropriate weight onto your end. Stand over the bar, and position a Double D Remo handle around the bar next to the collar. Using your Caderas and Piernas, rise to a De Pie position. Assume a wide stance with your Caderas Espalda and your Pecho up. Your arms should be extended. This will be your starting position. Pull the weight to your upper abdomen by retracting the Hombro blades and flexing the elbows. Do not Envión the weight or cheat during the movement. After a brief pause, return to the starting position.

Espalda.name: Two-arm Pesa Rusa Remo
Espalda.instructions_en:
Place two kettlebells in front of your feet. Bend your knees slightly and then push your butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in the starting position.
Grab both kettlebells and pull them to your stomach, retracting your shoulder blades and flexing the elbows. Keep your back straight. Lower and repeat.
Espalda.instructions_es: Place two Pesa Rusas in Frontal of your feet. Bend your knees slightly and then push your butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in the starting position. Grab both Pesa Rusas and pull them to your stomach, retracting your Hombro blades and flexing the elbows. Keep your Espalda straight. Bajoer and repeat.

Espalda.name: Middle Back Stretch
Espalda.instructions_en:
Stand so your feet are shoulder width apart and your hands are on your hips.
Twist at your waist until you feel a stretch. Hold for 10 to 15 seconds, then twist to the other side.
Espalda.instructions_es: Stand so your feet are Hombro width apart and your hands are on your Caderas. Twist at your waist until you feel a stretch. Hold for 10 to 15 seconds, then twist to the other Lateral.

Espalda.name: Rhomboids-smr
Espalda.instructions_en:
Lay down with your back on the floor. Place a foam roll underneath your upper back, and cross your arms in front of you, protracting your shoulders. This will be your starting position.
Raise your hips off of the ground, placing your weight onto the foam roll. Shift your weight to one side at a time, rolling over your middle and upper back. Pause at points of tension for 10-30 seconds.
Espalda.instructions_es: Lay down with your Espalda on the Suelo. Place a foam roll underneath your upper Espalda, and cross your arms in Frontal of you, protracting your Hombros. This will be your starting position. Elevación your Caderas off of the ground, placing your weight onto the foam roll. Shift your weight to one Lateral at a time, rolling over your middle and upper Espalda. Pause at points of tension for 10-30 seconds.

Espalda.name: Spinal Stretch
Espalda.instructions_en:
Sit in a chair so your back is straight and your feet planted on the floor.
Interlace your fingers behind your head, elbows out and your chin down.
Twist your upper body to one side about 3 times as far as you can. Then lean forward and twist your torso to reach your elbow to the floor on the inside of your knee.
Return to upright position and then repeat for your other side.
Espalda.instructions_es: Sit in a chair so your Espalda is straight and your feet planted on the Suelo. Interlace your fingers behind your head, elbows out and your chin down. Twist your upper body to one Lateral about 3 times as far as you can. Then lean forward and twist your torso to reach your elbow to the Suelo on the inLateral of your knee. Return to Vertical position and then repeat for your other Lateral.

Espalda.name: Upper Back Stretch
Espalda.instructions_en: Clasp fingers together with your thumbs pointing down, round your shoulders as you reach your hands forward.
Espalda.instructions_es: Clasp fingers together with your thumbs pointing down, round your Hombros as you reach your hands forward.

Espalda.name: Remo a Un Brazo con Mancuerna

Hombros.name: Alternating Cable Shoulder Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Move the cables to the bottom of the tower and select an appropriate weight.
Grasp the cables and hold them at shoulder height, palms facing forward. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your head and chest up, extend through the elbow to press one side directly over head.
After pausing at the top, return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
Hombros.instructions_es: Move the Poleas to the bottom of the tower and select an appropriate weight. Grasp the Poleas and hold them at Hombro height, palms facing forward. This will be your starting position. Keeping your head and Pecho up, extend through the elbow to Press one Lateral directly over head. After pausing at the top, return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite Lateral.

Hombros.name: Alternando Deltoid Elevación
Hombros.instructions_en:
In a standing position, hold a pair of dumbbells at your side.
Keeping your elbows slightly bent, raise the weights directly in front of you to shoulder height, avoiding any swinging or cheating.
Return the weights to your side.
On the next repetition, raise the weights laterally, raising them out to your side to about shoulder height.
Return the weights to the starting position and continue alternating to the front and side.
Hombros.instructions_es: In a De Pie position, hold a pair of Mancuernas at your Lateral. Keeping your elbows slightly bent, Elevación the weights directly in Frontal of you to Hombro height, avoiding any swinging or cheating. Return the weights to your Lateral. On the next repetition, Elevación the weights Laterally, raising them out to your Lateral to about Hombro height. Return the weights to the starting position and continue Alternando to the Frontal and Lateral.

Hombros.name: Alternating Kettlebell Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so.
Press one directly overhead by extending through the elbow, turning it so the palm faces forward while holding the other kettlebell stationary .
Lower the pressed kettlebell to the starting position and immediately press with your other arm.
Hombros.instructions_es: Cargada two Pesa Rusas to your Hombros. Cargada the Pesa Rusas to your Hombros by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you pull the Pesa Rusas towards your Hombros. Rotate your Muñecas as you do so. Press one directly Sobre la Cabeza by extending through the elbow, turning it so the palm faces forward while holding the other Pesa Rusa stationary . Bajoer the Pressed Pesa Rusa to the starting position and immediately Press with your other arm.

Hombros.name: Anti-gravity Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench.
Lay on the bench face down. With a pronated grip, pick the barbell up from the floor. Flex the elbows, performing a reverse curl to bring the bar near your chest. This will be your starting position.
To begin, press the barbell out in front of your head by extending your elbows. Keep your arms parallel to the ground throughout the movement.
Return to the starting position and repeat to complete the set.
Hombros.instructions_es: Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an Banca Inclinada. Lay on the bench face down. With a pronated grip, pick the Barra up from the Suelo. Flex the elbows, performing a Curl Inverso to bring the bar near your Pecho. This will be your starting position. To begin, Press the Barra out in Frontal of your head by extending your elbows. Keep your arms parallel to the ground throughout the movement. Return to the starting position and repeat to complete the set.

Hombros.name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Sit on an exercise bench with back support and hold two dumbbells in front of you at about upper chest level with your palms facing your body and your elbows bent. Tip: Your arms should be next to your torso. The starting position should look like the contracted portion of a dumbbell curl.
Now to perform the movement, raise the dumbbells as you rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
Continue lifting the dumbbells until your arms are extended above you in straight arm position. Breathe out as you perform this portion of the movement.
After a second pause at the top, begin to lower the dumbbells to the original position by rotating the palms of your hands towards you. Tip: The left arm will be rotated in a counter clockwise manner while the right one will be rotated clockwise. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Sit on an exercise bench with Espalda support and hold two Mancuernas in Frontal of you at about upper Pecho level with your palms facing your body and your elbows bent. Tip: Your arms should be next to your torso. The starting position should look like the contracted portion of a Mancuerna Curl. Now to perform the movement, Elevación the Mancuernas as you rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward. Continue lifting the Mancuernas until your arms are extended above you in straight arm position. Breathe out as you perform this portion of the movement. After a second pause at the top, begin to Bajoer the Mancuernas to the original position by rotating the palms of your hands towards you. Tip: The left arm will be rotated in a counter clockwise manner while the right one will be rotated clockwise. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Espalda Aperturases - With Bandas
Hombros.instructions_en:
Run a band around a stationary post like that of a squat rack.
Grab the band by the handles and stand back so that the tension in the band rises.
Extend and lift the arms straight in front of you. Tip: Your arms should be straight and parallel to the floor while perpendicular to your torso. Your feet should be firmly planted on the floor spread at shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, move your arms to the sides and back. Keep your arms extended and parallel to the floor. Continue the movement until the arms are extended to your sides.
After a pause, go back to the original position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Run a Banda around a stationary post like that of a Sentadilla rack. Grab the Banda by the handles and stand Espalda so that the tension in the Banda rises. Extend and lift the arms straight in Frontal of you. Tip: Your arms should be straight and parallel to the Suelo while perpendicular to your torso. Your feet should be firmly planted on the Suelo spread at Hombro width. This will be your starting position. As you exhale, move your arms to the Laterals and Espalda. Keep your arms extended and parallel to the Suelo. Continue the movement until the arms are extended to your Laterals. After a pause, go Espalda to the original position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Banda Pull Apart
Hombros.instructions_en:
Begin with your arms extended straight out in front of you, holding the band with both hands.
Initiate the movement by performing a reverse fly motion, moving your hands out laterally to your sides.
Keep your elbows extended as you perform the movement, bringing the band to your chest. Ensure that you keep your shoulders back during the exercise.
Pause as you complete the movement, returning to the starting position under control.
Hombros.instructions_es: Begin with your arms extended straight out in Frontal of you, holding the Banda with both hands. Initiate the movement by performing a Inverso Aperturas motion, moving your hands out Laterally to your Laterals. Keep your elbows extended as you perform the movement, bringing the Banda to your Pecho. Ensure that you keep your Hombros Espalda during the exercise. Pause as you complete the movement, returning to the starting position under control.

Hombros.name: Barra Inclinado Hombro Elevación
Hombros.instructions_en:
Lie back on an Incline Bench. Using a medium width grip (a grip that is slightly wider than shoulder width), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms straight. This will be your starting position.
While keeping the arms straight, lift the bar by protracting your shoulder blades, raising the shoulders from the bench as you breathe out.
Bring back the bar to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Lie Espalda on an Banca Inclinada. Using a medium width grip (a grip that is slightly wider than Hombro width), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms straight. This will be your starting position. While keeping the arms straight, lift the bar by protracting your Hombro blades, raising the Hombros from the bench as you breathe out. Bring Espalda the bar to the starting position as you breathe in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Barra Deltoides Posterior Remo
Hombros.instructions_en:
Stand up straight while holding a barbell using a wide (higher than shoulder width) and overhand (palms facing your body) grip.
Bend knees slightly and bend over as you keep the natural arch of your back. Let the arms hang in front of you as they hold the bar. Once your torso is parallel to the floor, flare the elbows out and away from your body. Tip: Your torso and your arms should resemble the letter "T". Now you are ready to begin the exercise.
While keeping the upper arms perpendicular to the torso, pull the barbell up towards your upper chest as you squeeze the rear delts and you breathe out. Tip: When performed correctly, this exercise should resemble a bench press in reverse. Also, refrain from using your biceps to do the work. Focus on targeting the rear delts; the arms should only act as hooks.
Slowly go back to the initial position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Stand up straight while holding a Barra using a wide (Altoer than Hombro width) and overhand (palms facing your body) grip. Bend knees slightly and bend over as you keep the natural arch of your Espalda. Let the arms Colgado in Frontal of you as they hold the bar. Once your torso is parallel to the Suelo, flare the elbows out and away from your body. Tip: Your torso and your arms should resemble the letter "T". Now you are ready to begin the exercise. While keeping the upper arms perpendicular to the torso, pull the Barra up towards your upper Pecho as you squeeze the Deltoides Posteriors and you breathe out. Tip: When performed correctly, this exercise should resemble a Press de Banca in Inverso. Also, refrain from using your Bíceps to do the work. Focus on targeting the Deltoides Posteriors; the arms should only act as hooks. SBajoly go Espalda to the initial position as you breathe in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Barbell Shoulder Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Sit on a bench with back support in a squat rack. Position a barbell at a height that is just above your head. Grab the barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing forward).
Once you pick up the barbell with the correct grip width, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms. Hold at about shoulder level and slightly in front of your head. This is your starting position.
Lower the bar down to the shoulders slowly as you inhale.
Lift the bar back up to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Sit on a bench with Espalda support in a Sentadilla rack. Position a Barra at a height that is just above your head. Grab the Barra with a pronated grip (palms facing forward). Once you pick up the Barra with the correct grip width, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms. Hold at about Hombro level and slightly in Frontal of your head. This is your starting position. Bajoer the bar down to the Hombros sBajoly as you inhale. Lift the bar Espalda up to the starting position as you exhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Battling Ropes
Hombros.instructions_en:
For this exercise you will need a heavy rope anchored at its center 15-20 feet away. Standing in front of the rope, take an end in each hand with your arms extended at your side. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by rapidly raising one arm to shoulder level as quickly as you can.
As you let that arm drop to the starting position, raise the opposite side.
Continue alternating your left and right arms, whipping the ropes up and down as fast as you can.
Hombros.instructions_es: For this exercise you will need a heavy rope anchored at its center 15-20 feet away. De Pie in Frontal of the rope, take an end in each hand with your arms extended at your Lateral. This will be your starting position. Initiate the movement by rapidly raising Un Brazo to Hombro level as quickly as you can. As you let that arm drop to the starting position, Elevación the opposite Lateral. Continue Alternando your left and right arms, wCaderaping the ropes up and down as fast as you can.

Hombros.name: Inclinado Mancuerna Deltoides Posterior Elevación With Head On Bench
Hombros.name_en: Bent Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise With Head On Bench
Hombros.instructions_en:
Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell in each hand and with an incline bench in front of you.
While keeping your back straight and maintaining the natural arch of your back, lean forward until your forehead touches the bench in front of you. Let the arms hang in front of you perpendicular to the ground. The palms of your hands should be facing each other and your torso should be parallel to the floor. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your torso forward and stationary, and the arms straight with a slight bend at the elbows, lift the dumbbells straight to the side until both arms are parallel to the floor. Exhale as you lift the weights. Caution: avoid swinging the torso or bringing the arms back as opposed to the side.
After a one second contraction at the top, slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Stand up straight while holding a Mancuerna in each hand and with an Banca Inclinada in Frontal of you. While keeping your Espalda straight and maintaining the natural arch of your Espalda, lean forward until your forehead touches the bench in Frontal of you. Let the arms Colgado in Frontal of you perpendicular to the ground. The palms of your hands should be facing each other and your torso should be parallel to the Suelo. This will be your starting position. Keeping your torso forward and stationary, and the arms straight with a slight bend at the elbows, lift the Mancuernas straight to the Lateral until both arms are parallel to the Suelo. Exhale as you lift the weights. Caution: avoid swinging the torso or bringing the arms Espalda as opposed to the Lateral. After a one second contraction at the top, sBajoly Bajoer the Mancuernas Espalda to the starting position. Repeat the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Inclinado Bajo-pulley Lateral Lateral
Hombros.instructions_en:
Select a weight and hold the handle of the low pulley with your right hand.
Bend at the waist until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor. Your legs should be slightly bent with your left hand placed on your lower left thigh. Your right arm should be hanging from your shoulder in front of you and with a slight bend at the elbow. This will be your starting position.
Raise your right arm, elbow slightly bent, to the side until the arm is parallel to the floor and in line with your right ear. Breathe out as you perform this step.
