Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and repeat the movement with the other arm.
Hombros.instructions_es: Select a weight and hold the handle of the Bajo pulley with your right hand. Bend at the waist until your torso is nearly parallel to the Suelo. Your Piernas should be slightly bent with your left hand placed on your Bajoer left tAlto. Your right arm should be Colgadoing from your Hombro in Frontal of you and with a slight bend at the elbow. This will be your starting position. Elevación your right arm, elbow slightly bent, to the Lateral until the arm is parallel to the Suelo and in line with your right ear. Breathe out as you perform this step. SBajoly Bajoer the weight Espalda to the starting position as you breathe in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and repeat the movement with the other arm.

Hombros.name: Bradford/rocky Presses
Hombros.instructions_en:
Sit on a Military Press Bench with a bar at shoulder level with a pronated grip (palms facing forward). Tip: Your grip should be wider than shoulder width and it should create a 90-degree angle between the forearm and the upper arm as the barbell goes down. This is your starting position.
Once you pick up the barbell with the correct grip, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms.
Now lower the bar down to the back of the head slowly as you inhale.
Lift the bar back up to the starting position as you exhale.
Lower the bar down to the starting position slowly as you inhale. This is one repetition.
Alternate in this manner until you complete the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Sit on a Press Militar Bench with a bar at Hombro level with a pronated grip (palms facing forward). Tip: Your grip should be wider than Hombro width and it should create a 90-degree angle between the foPosteriorm and the upper arm as the Barra goes down. This is your starting position. Once you pick up the Barra with the correct grip, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms. Now Bajoer the bar down to the Espalda of the head sBajoly as you inhale. Lift the bar Espalda up to the starting position as you exhale. Bajoer the bar down to the starting position sBajoly as you inhale. This is one repetition. Alternate in this manner until you complete the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Polea Internal Rotation
Hombros.instructions_en:
Sit next to a low pulley sideways (with legs stretched in front of you or crossed) and grasp the single hand cable attachment with the arm nearest to the cable. Tip: If you can adjust the pulley's height, you can use a flat bench to sit on instead.
Position the elbow against your side with the elbow bent at 90° and the arm pointing towards the pulley. This will be your starting position.
Pull the single hand cable attachment toward your body by internally rotating your shoulder until your forearm is across your abs. You will be creating an imaginary semi-circle. Tip: The forearm should be perpendicular to your torso at all times.
Slowly go back to the initial position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then repeat the movement with the next arm.
Hombros.instructions_es: Sit next to a Bajo pulley Lateralways (with Piernas stretched in Frontal of you or crossed) and grasp the single hand Polea attachment with the arm nearest to the Polea. Tip: If you can adjust the pulley's height, you can use a flat bench to sit on instead. Position the elbow against your Lateral with the elbow bent at 90° and the arm pointing towards the pulley. This will be your starting position. Pull the single hand Polea attachment toward your body by internally rotating your Hombro until your foPosteriorm is across your abs. You will be creating an imaginary semi-circle. Tip: The foPosteriorm should be perpendicular to your torso at all times. SBajoly go Espalda to the initial position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then repeat the movement with the next arm.

Hombros.name: Polea Pájaros
Hombros.instructions_en:
Adjust the pulleys to the appropriate height and adjust the weight. The pulleys should be above your head.
Grab the left pulley with your right hand and the right pulley with your left hand, crossing them in front of you. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by moving your arms back and outward, keeping your arms straight as you execute the movement.
Pause at the end of the motion before returning the handles to the start position.
Hombros.instructions_es: Adjust the pulleys to the appropriate height and adjust the weight. The pulleys should be above your head. Grab the left pulley with your right hand and the right pulley with your left hand, crossing them in Frontal of you. This will be your starting position. Initiate the movement by moving your arms Espalda and outward, keeping your arms straight as you execute the movement. Pause at the end of the motion before returning the handles to the start position.

Hombros.name: Polea Rope Posterior-delt Remos
Hombros.instructions_en:
Sit in the same position on a low pulley row station as you would if you were doing seated cable rows for the back.
Attach a rope to the pulley and grasp it with an overhand grip. Your arms should be extended and parallel to the floor with the elbows flared out.
Keep your lower back upright and slide your hips back so that your knees are slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
Pull the cable attachment towards your upper chest, just below the neck, as you keep your elbows up and out to the sides. Continue this motion as you exhale until the elbows travel slightly behind the back. Tip: Keep your upper arms horizontal, perpendicular to the torso and parallel to the floor throughout the motion.
Go back to the initial position where the arms are extended and the shoulders are stretched forward. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Sit in the same position on a Bajo pulley Remo station as you would if you were doing Sentado Polea Remos for the Espalda. Attach a rope to the pulley and grasp it with an overhand grip. Your arms should be extended and parallel to the Suelo with the elbows flared out. Keep your Bajoer Espalda Vertical and slide your Caderas Espalda so that your knees are slightly bent. This will be your starting position. Pull the Polea attachment towards your upper Pecho, just beBajo the neck, as you keep your elbows up and out to the Laterals. Continue this motion as you exhale until the elbows travel slightly behind the Espalda. Tip: Keep your upper arms horizontal, perpendicular to the torso and parallel to the Suelo throughout the motion. Go Espalda to the initial position where the arms are extended and the Hombros are stretched forward. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Polea Sentado Elevación Lateral
Hombros.instructions_en:
Stand in the middle of two low pulleys that are opposite to each other and place a flat bench right behind you (in perpendicular fashion to you; the narrow edge of the bench should be the one behind you). Select the weight to be used on each pulley.
Now sit at the edge of the flat bench behind you with your feet placed in front of your knees.
Bend forward while keeping your back flat and rest your torso on the thighs.
Have someone give you the single handles attached to the pulleys. Grasp the left pulley with the right hand and the right pulley with the left after you select your weight. The pulleys should run under your knees and your arms will be extended with palms facing each other and a slight bend at the elbows. This will be the starting position.
While keeping the arms stationary, raise the upper arms to the sides until they are parallel to the floor and at shoulder height. Exhale during the execution of this movement and hold the contraction for a second.
Slowly lower your arms to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. Tip: Maintain upper arms perpendicular to torso and a fixed elbow position (10 degree to 30 degree angle) throughout exercise.
Hombros.instructions_es: Stand in the middle of two Bajo pulleys that are opposite to each other and place a flat bench right behind you (in perpendicular fashion to you; the narRemo edge of the bench should be the one behind you). Select the weight to be used on each pulley. Now sit at the edge of the flat bench behind you with your feet placed in Frontal of your knees. Bend forward while keeping your Espalda flat and rest your torso on the tAltos. Have someone give you the single handles attached to the pulleys. Grasp the left pulley with the right hand and the right pulley with the left after you select your weight. The pulleys should run under your knees and your arms will be extended with palms facing each other and a slight bend at the elbows. This will be the starting position. While keeping the arms stationary, Elevación the upper arms to the Laterals until they are parallel to the Suelo and at Hombro height. Exhale during the execution of this movement and hold the contraction for a second. SBajoly Bajoer your arms to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. Tip: Maintain upper arms perpendicular to torso and a fixed elbow position (10 degree to 30 degree angle) throughout exercise.

Hombros.name: Cable Shoulder Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Move the cables to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight.
Stand directly in between the uprights. Grasp the cables and hold them at shoulder height, palms facing forward. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your head and chest up, extend through the elbow to press the handles directly over head.
After pausing at the top, return to the starting position and repeat.
Hombros.instructions_es: Move the Poleas to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight. Stand directly in between the Verticals. Grasp the Poleas and hold them at Hombro height, palms facing forward. This will be your starting position. Keeping your head and Pecho up, extend through the elbow to Press the handles directly over head. After pausing at the top, return to the starting position and repeat.

Hombros.name: Clean And Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Assume a shoulder-width stance, with knees inside the arms. Now while keeping the back flat, bend at the knees and hips so that you can grab the bar with the arms fully extended and a pronated grip that is slightly wider than shoulder width. Point the elbows out to sides. The bar should be close to the shins. Position the shoulders over or slightly ahead of the bar. Establish a flat back posture. This will be your starting position.
Begin to pull the bar by extending the knees. Move your hips forward and raise the shoulders at the same rate while keeping the angle of the back constant; continue to lift the bar straight up while keeping it close to your body.
As the bar passes the knee, extend at the ankles, knees, and hips forcefully, similar to a jumping motion. As you do so, continue to guide the bar with your hands, shrugging your shoulders and using the momentum from your movement to pull the bar as high as possible. The bar should travel close to your body, and you should keep your elbows out.
At maximum elevation, your feet should clear the floor and you should start to pull yourself under the bar. The mechanics of this could change slightly, depending on the weight used. You should descend into a squatting position as you pull yourself under the bar.
As the bar hits terminal height, rotate your elbows around and under the bar. Rack the bar across the front of the shoulders while keeping the torso erect and flexing the hips and knees to absorb the weight of the bar.
Stand to full height, holding the bar in the clean position.
Without moving your feet, press the bar overhead as you exhale. Lower the bar under control .
Hombros.instructions_es: Assume a Hombro-width stance, with knees inLateral the arms. Now while keeping the Espalda flat, bend at the knees and Caderas so that you can grab the bar with the arms fully extended and a pronated grip that is slightly wider than Hombro width. Point the elbows out to Laterals. The bar should be close to the shins. Position the Hombros over or slightly ahead of the bar. Establish a flat Espalda posture. This will be your starting position. Begin to pull the bar by extending the knees. Move your Caderas forward and Elevación the Hombros at the same rate while keeping the angle of the Espalda constant; continue to lift the bar straight up while keeping it close to your body. As the bar passes the knee, extend at the ankles, knees, and Caderas forcefully, similar to a Saltoing motion. As you do so, continue to guide the bar with your hands, Encogimientoging your Hombros and using the momentum from your movement to pull the bar as Alto as possible. The bar should travel close to your body, and you should keep your elbows out. At maximum elevation, your feet should clear the Suelo and you should start to pull yourself under the bar. The mechanics of this could cColgadoe slightly, depending on the weight used. You should descend into a Sentadillating position as you pull yourself under the bar. As the bar hits terminal height, rotate your elbows around and under the bar. Rack the bar across the Frontal of the Hombros while keeping the torso erect and flexing the Caderas and knees to absorb the weight of the bar. Stand to full height, holding the bar in the Cargada position. Without moving your feet, Press the bar Sobre la Cabeza as you exhale. Bajoer the bar under control .

Hombros.name: Cuban Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Take a dumbbell in each hand with a pronated grip in a standing position. Raise your upper arms so that they are parallel to the floor, allowing your lower arms to hang in the "scarecrow" position. This will be your starting position.
To initiate the movement, externally rotate the shoulders to move the upper arm 180 degrees. Keep the upper arms in place, rotating the upper arms until the wrists are directly above the elbows, the forearms perpendicular to the floor.
Now press the dumbbells by extending at the elbows, straightening your arms overhead.
Return to the starting position as you breathe in by reversing the steps.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Take a Mancuerna in each hand with a pronated grip in a De Pie position. Elevación your upper arms so that they are parallel to the Suelo, alBajoing your Bajoer arms to Colgado in the "scarecRemo" position. This will be your starting position. To initiate the movement, externally rotate the Hombros to move the upper arm 180 degrees. Keep the upper arms in place, rotating the upper arms until the Muñecas are directly above the elbows, the foPosteriorms perpendicular to the Suelo. Now Press the Mancuernas by extending at the elbows, straightening your arms Sobre la Cabeza. Return to the starting position as you breathe in by reversing the steps. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Double Pesa Rusa Envión
Hombros.instructions_en:
Hold a kettlebell by the handle in each hand.
Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so, so that the palms face forward. This will be your starting position.
Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright.
Immediately reverse direction, driving through the heels, in essence jumping to create momentum.
As you do so, press the kettlebells overhead to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weights.
Return your feet to the ground in a split fashion, with one foot forward and one foot back.
Keeping the weights overhead, return to a standing position, bringing your feet together. Lower the weights to perform the next repetition.
Hombros.instructions_es: Hold a Pesa Rusa by the handle in each hand. Cargada the Pesa Rusas to your Hombros by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you pull the Pesa Rusas towards your Hombros. Rotate your Muñecas as you do so, so that the palms face forward. This will be your starting position. Fondo your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso Vertical. Immediately Inverso direction, driving through the heels, in essence Saltoing to create momentum. As you do so, Press the Pesa Rusas Sobre la Cabeza to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weights. Return your feet to the ground in a Split fashion, with one foot forward and one foot Espalda. Keeping the weights Sobre la Cabeza, return to a De Pie position, bringing your feet together. Bajoer the weights to perform the next repetition.

Hombros.name: Double Kettlebell Push Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders.
Squat down a few inches and reverse the motion rapidly. Use the momentum from the legs to drive the kettlebells overhead.
Once the kettlebells are locked out, lower the kettlebells to your shoulders and repeat.
Hombros.instructions_es: Cargada two Pesa Rusas to your Hombros. Sentadilla down a few inches and Inverso the motion rapidly. Use the momentum from the Piernas to drive the Pesa Rusas Sobre la Cabeza. Once the Pesa Rusas are locked out, Bajoer the Pesa Rusas to your Hombros and repeat.

Hombros.name: Double Pesa Rusa Arrancada
Hombros.instructions_en:
Place two kettlebells behind your feet. Bend your knees and sit back to pick up the kettlebells.
Swing the kettlebells between your legs forcefully and reverse the direction.
Drive through with your hips and lock the ketttlebells overhead in one uninterrupted motion.
Hombros.instructions_es: Place two Pesa Rusas behind your feet. Bend your knees and sit Espalda to pick up the Pesa Rusas. Swing the Pesa Rusas between your Piernas forcefully and Inverso the direction. Drive through with your Caderas and lock the ketttlebells Sobre la Cabeza in one uninterrupted motion.

Hombros.name: Mancuerna Inclinado Hombro Elevación
Hombros.instructions_en:
Sit on an Incline Bench while holding a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs.
Lift your legs up to kick the weights to your shoulders and lean back. Position the dumbbells above your shoulders with your arms extended. The arms should be perpendicular to the floor with your palms facing forward and knuckles pointing towards the ceiling. This will be your starting position.
While keeping the arms straight and locked, lift the dumbbells by raising the shoulders from the bench as you breathe out.
Bring back the dumbbells to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Sit on an Banca Inclinada while holding a Mancuerna on each hand on top of your tAltos. Lift your Piernas up to kick the weights to your Hombros and lean Espalda. Position the Mancuernas above your Hombros with your arms extended. The arms should be perpendicular to the Suelo with your palms facing forward and knuckles pointing towards the ceiling. This will be your starting position. While keeping the arms straight and locked, lift the Mancuernas by raising the Hombros from the bench as you breathe out. Bring Espalda the Mancuernas to the starting position as you breathe in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Mancuerna Recostado Un Brazo Posterior Elevación Lateral
Hombros.name_en: Dumbbell Lying One-Arm Rear Lateral Raise
Hombros.instructions_en:
While holding a dumbbell in one hand, lay with your chest down on a slightly inclined (around 15 degrees when measured from the floor) adjustable bench. The other hand can be used to hold to the leg of the bench for stability.
Position the palm of the hand that is holding the dumbbell in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arm extended with the elbow slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
Now raise the arm with the dumbbell to the side until your elbow is at shoulder height and your arm is roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arm perpendicular to the torso while keeping your arm extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second.
Slowly lower the dumbbell to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: While holding a Mancuerna in one hand, lay with your Pecho down on a slightly Inclinadod (around 15 degrees when measured from the Suelo) adjustable bench. The other hand can be used to hold to the Pierna of the bench for stability. Position the palm of the hand that is holding the Mancuerna in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arm extended with the elbow slightly bent. This will be your starting position. Now Elevación the arm with the Mancuerna to the Lateral until your elbow is at Hombro height and your arm is roughly parallel to the Suelo as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arm perpendicular to the torso while keeping your arm extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second. SBajoly Bajoer the Mancuerna to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Mancuerna Recostado Posterior Elevación Lateral
Hombros.instructions_en:
While holding a dumbbell in each hand, lay with your chest down on a slightly inclined (around 15 degrees when measured from the floor) adjustable bench.
Position the palms of the hands in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arms extended with the elbows slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
Now raise the arms to the side until your elbows are at shoulder height and your arms are roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arms perpendicular to the torso while keeping them extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.
Hombros.instructions_es: While holding a Mancuerna in each hand, lay with your Pecho down on a slightly Inclinadod (around 15 degrees when measured from the Suelo) adjustable bench. Position the palms of the hands in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arms extended with the elbows slightly bent. This will be your starting position. Now Elevación the arms to the Lateral until your elbows are at Hombro height and your arms are roughly parallel to the Suelo as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arms perpendicular to the torso while keeping them extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second. SBajoly Bajoer the Mancuernas to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.

Hombros.name: Dumbbell One-arm Shoulder Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Grab a dumbbell and either sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs or stand up straight.
Clean the dumbbell up to bring it to shoulder height. The other hand can be kept fully extended to the side, by the waist or grabbing a fixed surface.
Rotate the wrist so that the palm of your hand is facing forward. This is your starting position.
As you exhale, push the dumbbell up until your arm is fully extended.
After a second pause, slowly come down back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch arms.
Hombros.instructions_es: Grab a Mancuerna and either sit on a Press Militar bench or a utility bench that has a Espalda support on it as you place the Mancuernas Vertical on top of your tAltos or stand up straight. Cargada the Mancuerna up to bring it to Hombro height. The other hand can be kept fully extended to the Lateral, by the waist or grabbing a fixed surface. Rotate the Muñeca so that the palm of your hand is facing forward. This is your starting position. As you exhale, push the Mancuerna up until your arm is fully extended. After a second pause, sBajoly come down Espalda to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch arms.

Hombros.name: Mancuerna Un Brazo Remo al Mentón
Hombros.instructions_en:
Grab a dumbbell and stand up straight with your arm extended in front of you with a slight bend at the elbows and your back straight. This will be your starting position. Tip: The dumbbell should be resting on top of your thigh with the palm of your hands facing your thighs.
Keep the other hand can be kept fully extended to the side, by the waist or grabbing a fixed surface. This will be your starting position.
Use your side shoulders to lift the dumbbell as you exhale. The dumbbell should be close to the body as you move it up. Continue to lift it until the dumbbell is nearly in line with your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the dumbbell, your elbow should always be higher than your forearm. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and switch arms.
Hombros.instructions_es: Grab a Mancuerna and stand up straight with your arm extended in Frontal of you with a slight bend at the elbows and your Espalda straight. This will be your starting position. Tip: The Mancuerna should be resting on top of your tAlto with the palm of your hands facing your tAltos. Keep the other hand can be kept fully extended to the Lateral, by the waist or grabbing a fixed surface. This will be your starting position. Use your Lateral Hombros to lift the Mancuerna as you exhale. The Mancuerna should be close to the body as you move it up. Continue to lift it until the Mancuerna is nearly in line with your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the Mancuerna, your elbow should always be Altoer than your foPosteriorm. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement. Bajoer the Mancuerna Espalda down sBajoly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and switch arms.

Hombros.name: Mancuerna Elevación
Hombros.instructions_en:
Grab a dumbbell in each arm and stand up straight with your arms extended by your sides with a slight bend at the elbows and your back straight. This will be your starting position. Tip: The dumbbell should be next to your thighs with the palm of your hands facing back.
Use your side shoulders to lift the dumbbells as you exhale. The dumbbells should be to the side of the body as you move them up. Continue to lift it until the dumbbells are nearly in line with your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the dumbbell, your elbow should always be higher than your forearm. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Grab a Mancuerna in each arm and stand up straight with your arms extended by your Laterals with a slight bend at the elbows and your Espalda straight. This will be your starting position. Tip: The Mancuerna should be next to your tAltos with the palm of your hands facing Espalda. Use your Lateral Hombros to lift the Mancuernas as you exhale. The Mancuernas should be to the Lateral of the body as you move them up. Continue to lift it until the Mancuernas are nearly in line with your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the Mancuerna, your elbow should always be Altoer than your foPosteriorm. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement. Bajoer the Mancuernas Espalda down sBajoly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Mancuerna Scaption
Hombros.instructions_en:
This corrective exercise strengthens the muscles that stabilize your shoulder blade. Hold a light weight in each hand, hanging at your sides. Your thumbs should pointing up.
Begin the movement raising your arms out in front of you, about 30 degrees off center. Your arms should be fully extended as you perform the movement.
Continue until your arms are parallel to the ground, and then return to the starting position.
Hombros.instructions_es: This corrective exercise strengthens the Muslos that stabilize your Hombro blade. Hold a light weight in each hand, Colgadoing at your Laterals. Your thumbs should pointing up. Begin the movement raising your arms out in Frontal of you, about 30 degrees off center. Your arms should be fully extended as you perform the movement. Continue until your arms are parallel to the ground, and then return to the starting position.

Hombros.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
While holding a dumbbell in each hand, sit on a military press bench or utility bench that has back support. Place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs.
Now raise the dumbbells to shoulder height one at a time using your thighs to help propel them up into position.
Make sure to rotate your wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. This is your starting position.
Now, exhale and push the dumbbells upward until they touch at the top.
Then, after a brief pause at the top contracted position, slowly lower the weights back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: While holding a Mancuerna in each hand, sit on a Press Militar bench or utility bench that has Espalda support. Place the Mancuernas Vertical on top of your tAltos. Now Elevación the Mancuernas to Hombro height one at a time using your tAltos to help propel them up into position. Make sure to rotate your Muñecas so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. This is your starting position. Now, exhale and push the Mancuernas upward until they touch at the top. Then, after a brief pause at the top contracted position, sBajoly Bajoer the weights Espalda down to the starting position while inhaling. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: External Rotation
Hombros.instructions_en:
Lie sideways on a flat bench with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it.
Bend the elbows of the arm holding the dumbbell so that it creates a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the arm parallel to your torso.
Now bend the elbow while keeping the upper arm stationary. In this manner, the forearm will be parallel to the floor and perpendicular to your torso (Tip: So the forearm will be directly in front of you). The upper arm will be stationary by your torso and should be parallel to the floor (aligned with your torso at all times). This will be your starting position.
As you breathe out, externally rotate your forearm so that the dumbbell is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the forearm. You will continue this external rotation until the forearm is perpendicular to the floor and the torso pointing towards the ceiling. At this point you will hold the contraction for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.
Hombros.instructions_es: Lie Lateralways on a flat bench with Un Brazo holding a Mancuerna and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it. Bend the elbows of the arm holding the Mancuerna so that it creates a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the foPosteriorm. Tip: Keep the arm parallel to your torso. Now bend the elbow while keeping the upper arm stationary. In this manner, the foPosteriorm will be parallel to the Suelo and perpendicular to your torso (Tip: So the foPosteriorm will be directly in Frontal of you). The upper arm will be stationary by your torso and should be parallel to the Suelo (aligned with your torso at all times). This will be your starting position. As you breathe out, externally rotate your foPosteriorm so that the Mancuerna is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the foPosteriorm. You will continue this external rotation until the foPosteriorm is perpendicular to the Suelo and the torso pointing towards the ceiling. At this point you will hold the contraction for a second. As you breathe in, sBajoly go Espalda to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.

Hombros.name: External Rotation With Banda
Hombros.instructions_en:
Choke the band around a post. The band should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your left side to the band a couple of feet away.
Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching across the front of your torso. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a backhand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.
Hombros.instructions_es: Choke the Banda around a post. The Banda should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your left Lateral to the Banda a couple of feet away. Grasp the end of the Banda with your right hand, and keep your elbow Pressed firmly to your Lateral. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position. With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching across the Frontal of your torso. This will be your starting position. Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a Espaldahand motion, keeping your elbow in place. Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.

Hombros.name: External Rotation With Polea
Hombros.instructions_en:
Adjust the cable to the same height as your elbow. Stand with your left side to the band a couple of feet away.
Grasp the handle with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching across the front of your torso. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a backhand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
Hombros.instructions_es: Adjust the Polea to the same height as your elbow. Stand with your left Lateral to the Banda a couple of feet away. Grasp the handle with your right hand, and keep your elbow Pressed firmly to your Lateral. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position. With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching across the Frontal of your torso. This will be your starting position. Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a Espaldahand motion, keeping your elbow in place.

Hombros.name: Jalón a la Cara
Hombros.instructions_en: Facing a high pulley with a rope or dual handles attached, pull the weight directly towards your face, separating your hands as you do so. Keep your upper arms parallel to the ground.
Hombros.instructions_es: Facing a Alto pulley with a rope or dual handles attached, pull the weight directly towards your face, separating your hands as you do so. Keep your upper arms parallel to the ground.

Hombros.name: Frontal Polea Elevación
Hombros.instructions_en:
Select the weight on a low pulley machine and grasp the single hand cable attachment that is attached to the low pulley with your left hand.
Face away from the pulley and put your arm straight down with the hand cable attachment in front of your thighs at arms' length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs. This will be your starting position.
While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the left arm to the front with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hand always faces down. Continue to go up until you arm is slightly above parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top.
Now as you inhale lower the arm back down slowly to the starting position.
Once all of the recommended amount of repetitions have been performed for this arm, switch arms and perform the exercise with the right one.
Hombros.instructions_es: Select the weight on a Bajo pulley Máquina and grasp the single hand Polea attachment that is attached to the Bajo pulley with your left hand. Face away from the pulley and put your arm straight down with the hand Polea attachment in Frontal of your tAltos at arms' length with the palms of the hand facing your tAltos. This will be your starting position. While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the left arm to the Frontal with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hand always faces down. Continue to go up until you arm is slightly above parallel to the Suelo. Exhale as you execute this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top. Now as you inhale Bajoer the arm Espalda down sBajoly to the starting position. Once all of the recommended amount of repetitions have been performed for this arm, switch arms and perform the exercise with the right one.

Hombros.name: Frontal Mancuerna Elevación
Hombros.instructions_en:
Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells on front of your thighs at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs. This will be your starting position.
While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the left dumbbell to the front with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hands always facing down. Continue to go up until you arm is slightly above parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top. Inhale after the second pause.
Now lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the starting position as you simultaneously lift the right dumbbell.
Continue alternating in this fashion until all of the recommended amount of repetitions have been performed for each arm.
Hombros.instructions_es: Pick a couple of Mancuernas and stand with a straight torso and the Mancuernas on Frontal of your tAltos at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your tAltos. This will be your starting position. While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the left Mancuerna to the Frontal with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hands always facing down. Continue to go up until you arm is slightly above parallel to the Suelo. Exhale as you execute this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top. Inhale after the second pause. Now Bajoer the Mancuerna Espalda down sBajoly to the starting position as you simultaneously lift the right Mancuerna. Continue Alternando in this fashion until all of the recommended amount of repetitions have been performed for each arm.

Hombros.name: Frontal Disco Elevación
Hombros.instructions_en:
While standing straight, hold a barbell plate in both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions. Your palms should be facing each other and your arms should be extended and locked with a slight bend at the elbows and the plate should be down near your waist in front of you as far as you can go. Tip: The arms will remain in this position throughout the exercise. This will be your starting position.
Slowly raise the plate as you exhale until it is a little above shoulder level. Hold the contraction for a second. Tip: make sure that you do not swing the weight or bend at the elbows. Your torso should remain stationary throughout the movement as well.
As you inhale, slowly lower the plate back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: While De Pie straight, hold a Barra Disco in both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions. Your palms should be facing each other and your arms should be extended and locked with a slight bend at the elbows and the Disco should be down near your waist in Frontal of you as far as you can go. Tip: The arms will remain in this position throughout the exercise. This will be your starting position. SBajoly Elevación the Disco as you exhale until it is a little above Hombro level. Hold the contraction for a second. Tip: make sure that you do not swing the weight or bend at the elbows. Your torso should remain stationary throughout the movement as well. As you inhale, sBajoly Bajoer the Disco Espalda down to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Frontal Two-mancuerna Elevación
Hombros.instructions_en:
Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells on front of your thighs at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs. This will be your starting position.
While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the dumbbells to the front with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hands always facing down. Continue to go up until you arms are slightly above parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top.
As you inhale, lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Pick a couple of Mancuernas and stand with a straight torso and the Mancuernas on Frontal of your tAltos at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your tAltos. This will be your starting position. While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the Mancuernas to the Frontal with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hands always facing down. Continue to go up until you arms are slightly above parallel to the Suelo. Exhale as you execute this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top. As you inhale, Bajoer the Mancuernas Espalda down sBajoly to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Handstand Push-ups
Hombros.instructions_en:
With your back to the wall bend at the waist and place both hands on the floor at shoulder width.
Kick yourself up against the wall with your arms straight. Your body should be upside down with the arms and legs fully extended. Keep your whole body as straight as possible. Tip: If doing this for the first time, have a spotter help you. Also, make sure that you keep facing the wall with your head, rather than looking down.
Slowly lower yourself to the ground as you inhale until your head almost touches the floor. Tip: It is of utmost importance that you come down slow in order to avoid head injury.
Push yourself back up slowly as you exhale until your elbows are nearly locked.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: With your Espalda to the wall bend at the waist and place both hands on the Suelo at Hombro width. Kick yourself up against the wall with your arms straight. Your body should be upLateral down with the arms and Piernas fully extended. Keep your whole body as straight as possible. Tip: If doing this for the first time, have a spotter help you. Also, make sure that you keep facing the wall with your head, rather than looking down. SBajoly Bajoer yourself to the ground as you inhale until your head almost touches the Suelo. Tip: It is of utmost importance that you come down sBajo in order to avoid head injury. Push yourself Espalda up sBajoly as you exhale until your elbows are nearly locked. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Internal Rotation With Banda
Hombros.instructions_en:
Choke the band around a post. The band should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your right side to the band a couple of feet away.
Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching away from your torso. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a forehand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.
Hombros.instructions_es: Choke the Banda around a post. The Banda should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your right Lateral to the Banda a couple of feet away. Grasp the end of the Banda with your right hand, and keep your elbow Pressed firmly to your Lateral. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position. With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching away from your torso. This will be your starting position. Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a forehand motion, keeping your elbow in place. Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.

Hombros.name: Kettlebell Arnold Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulder. The palm should be facing inward.
Looking straight ahead, press the kettlebell out and overhead, rotating your wrist so that your palm faces forward at the top of the motion.
Return the kettlebell to the starting position, with the palm facing in.
Hombros.instructions_es: Cargada a Pesa Rusa to your Hombro. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombro by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you Elevación the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombro. The palm should be facing inward. Looking straight ahead, Press the Pesa Rusa out and Sobre la Cabeza, rotating your Muñeca so that your palm faces forward at the top of the motion. Return the Pesa Rusa to the starting position, with the palm facing in.

Hombros.name: Pesa Rusa Pirate Scaderas
Hombros.instructions_en:
With a wide stance, hold a kettlebell with both hands. Allow it to hang at waist level with your arms extended. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by turning to one side, swinging the kettlebell to head height. Briefly pause at the top of the motion.
Allow the bell to drop as you rotate to the opposite side, again raising the kettlebell to head height.
Repeat for the desired amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: With a wide stance, hold a Pesa Rusa with both hands. AlBajo it to Colgado at waist level with your arms extended. This will be your starting position. Initiate the movement by turning to one Lateral, swinging the Pesa Rusa to head height. BrieAperturas pause at the top of the motion. AlBajo the bell to drop as you rotate to the opposite Lateral, again raising the Pesa Rusa to head height. Repeat for the desired amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Kettlebell Seated Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Sit on the floor and spread your legs out comfortably.
Clean one kettlebell to your shoulder.
Press the kettlebell up and out until it is locked out overhead. Return to the starting position.
Hombros.instructions_es: Sit on the Suelo and spread your Piernas out comfortably. Cargada one Pesa Rusa to your Hombro. Press the Pesa Rusa up and out until it is locked out Sobre la Cabeza. Return to the starting position.

Hombros.name: Kettlebell Seesaw Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Clean two kettlebells two your shoulders.
Press one kettlebell.
Lower the kettlebell and immediately press the other kettlebell. Make sure to do the same amount of reps on both sides.
Hombros.instructions_es: Cargada two Pesa Rusas two your Hombros. Press one Pesa Rusa. Bajoer the Pesa Rusa and immediately Press the other Pesa Rusa. Make sure to do the same amount of reps on both Laterals.

Hombros.name: Pesa Rusa Thruster
Hombros.instructions_en:
Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so. This will be your starting position.
Begin to squat by flexing your hips and knees, lowering your hips between your legs. Maintain an upright, straight back as you descend as low as you can.
At the bottom, reverse direction and squat by extending your knees and hips, driving through your heels. As you do so, press both kettlebells overhead by extending your arms straight up, using the momentum from the squat to help drive the weights upward.
As you begin the next repetition, return the weights to the shoulders.
Hombros.instructions_es: Cargada two Pesa Rusas to your Hombros. Cargada the Pesa Rusas to your Hombros by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you pull the Pesa Rusas towards your Hombros. Rotate your Muñecas as you do so. This will be your starting position. Begin to Sentadilla by flexing your Caderas and knees, Bajoering your Caderas between your Piernas. Maintain an Vertical, straight Espalda as you descend as Bajo as you can. At the bottom, Inverso direction and Sentadilla by extending your knees and Caderas, driving through your heels. As you do so, Press both Pesa Rusas Sobre la Cabeza by extending your arms straight up, using the momentum from the Sentadilla to help drive the weights upward. As you begin the next repetition, return the weights to the Hombros.

Hombros.name: Pesa Rusa Turkish Get-up (Zancada Style)
Hombros.instructions_en:
Lie on your back on the floor and press a kettlebell to the top position by extending the elbow. Bend the knee on the same side as the kettlebell.
Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, pivot to the opposite side and use your non- working arm to assist you in driving forward to the lunge position. Using your free hand, push yourself to a seated position, then progressing to one knee.
While looking up at the kettlebell, slowly stand up. Reverse the motion back to the starting position and repeat.
Hombros.instructions_es: Lie on your Espalda on the Suelo and Press a Pesa Rusa to the top position by extending the elbow. Bend the knee on the same Lateral as the Pesa Rusa. Keeping the Pesa Rusa locked out at all times, pivot to the opposite Lateral and use your non- working arm to assist you in driving forward to the Zancada position. Using your free hand, push yourself to a Sentado position, then progressing to one knee. While looking up at the Pesa Rusa, sBajoly stand up. Inverso the motion Espalda to the starting position and repeat.

Hombros.name: Pesa Rusa Turkish Get-up (Sentadilla Style)
Hombros.instructions_en:
Lie on your back on the floor and press a kettlebell to the top position by extending the elbow. Bend the knee on the same side as the kettlebell.
Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, pivot to the opposite side and use your non- working arm to assist you in driving forward to the lunge position.
Using your free hand, push yourself to a seated position, then progressing to your feet. While looking up at the kettlebell, slowly stand up. Reverse the motion back to the starting position and repeat.
Hombros.instructions_es: Lie on your Espalda on the Suelo and Press a Pesa Rusa to the top position by extending the elbow. Bend the knee on the same Lateral as the Pesa Rusa. Keeping the Pesa Rusa locked out at all times, pivot to the opposite Lateral and use your non- working arm to assist you in driving forward to the Zancada position. Using your free hand, push yourself to a Sentado position, then progressing to your feet. While looking up at the Pesa Rusa, sBajoly stand up. Inverso the motion Espalda to the starting position and repeat.

Hombros.name: Landmine Linear Jammer
Hombros.instructions_en:
Position a bar into landmine or, lacking one, securely anchor it in a corner. Load the bar to an appropriate weight and position the handle attachment on the bar.
Raise the bar from the floor, taking the handles to your shoulders. This will be your starting position.
In an athletic stance, squat by flexing your hips and setting your hips back, keeping your arms flexed.
Reverse the motion by powerfully extending through the hips, knees, and ankles, while also extending the elbows to straighten the arms. This movement should be done explosively, coming out of the squat to full extension as powerfully as possible.
Return to the starting position.
Hombros.instructions_es: Position a bar into Landmine or, lacking one, securely anchor it in a corner. Load the bar to an appropriate weight and position the handle attachment on the bar. Elevación the bar from the Suelo, taking the handles to your Hombros. This will be your starting position. In an athletic stance, Sentadilla by flexing your Caderas and setting your Caderas Espalda, keeping your arms flexed. Inverso the motion by Powerfully extending through the Caderas, knees, and ankles, while also extending the elbows to straighten the arms. This movement should be done explosively, coming out of the Sentadilla to full Extensión as Powerfully as possible. Return to the starting position.

Hombros.name: Elevación Lateral - With Bandas
Hombros.instructions_en:
To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Grasp the handles using a pronated (palms facing your thighs) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The handles should be resting on the sides of your thighs. Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your back should be straight. This will be your starting position.
Use your side shoulders to lift the handles to the sides as you exhale. Continue to lift the handles until they are slightly above parallel. Tip: As you lift the handles, slightly tilt the hand as if you were pouring water and keep your arms extended. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the handles back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: To begin, stand on an exercise Banda so that tension begins at arm's length. Grasp the handles using a pronated (palms facing your tAltos) grip that is slightly less than Hombro width. The handles should be resting on the Laterals of your tAltos. Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your Espalda should be straight. This will be your starting position. Use your Lateral Hombros to lift the handles to the Laterals as you exhale. Continue to lift the handles until they are slightly above parallel. Tip: As you lift the handles, slightly tilt the hand as if you were pouring water and keep your arms extended. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement. Bajoer the handles Espalda down sBajoly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Leverage Shoulder Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the top of the shoulders at the beginning of the motion. Your chest and head should be up and handles held with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
Press the handles upward by extending through the elbow.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight to just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.
Hombros.instructions_es: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the top of the Hombros at the beginning of the motion. Your Pecho and head should be up and handles held with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position. Press the handles upward by extending through the elbow. After a brief pause at the top, return the weight to just above the start position, keeping tension on the Muslos by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.

Hombros.name: Bajo Pulley Remo To Neck
Hombros.instructions_en:
Sit on a low pulley row machine with a rope attachment.
Grab the ends of the rope using a palms-down grip and sit with your back straight and your knees slightly bent. Tip: Keep your back almost completely vertical and your arms fully extended in front of you. This will be your starting position.
While keeping your torso stationary, lift your elbows and start bending them as you pull the rope towards your neck while exhaling. Throughout the movement your upper arms should remain parallel to the floor. Tip: Continue this motion until your hands are almost next to your ears (the forearms will not be parallel to the floor at the end of the movement as they will be angled a bit upwards) and your elbows are out away from your sides.
After holding for a second or so at the contracted position, come back slowly to the starting position as you inhale. Tip: Again, during no part of the movement should the torso move.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Sit on a Bajo pulley Remo Máquina with a rope attachment. Grab the ends of the rope using a palms-down grip and sit with your Espalda straight and your knees slightly bent. Tip: Keep your Espalda almost completely vertical and your arms fully extended in Frontal of you. This will be your starting position. While keeping your torso stationary, lift your elbows and start bending them as you pull the rope towards your neck while exhaling. Throughout the movement your upper arms should remain parallel to the Suelo. Tip: Continue this motion until your hands are almost next to your ears (the foPosteriorms will not be parallel to the Suelo at the end of the movement as they will be angled a bit upwards) and your elbows are out away from your Laterals. After holding for a second or so at the contracted position, come Espalda sBajoly to the starting position as you inhale. Tip: Again, during no part of the movement should the torso move. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Recostado Un Brazo Elevación Lateral
Hombros.instructions_en:
While holding a dumbbell in one hand, lay with your chest down on a flat bench. The other hand can be used to hold to the leg of the bench for stability.
Position the palm of the hand that is holding the dumbbell in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arm extended with the elbow slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
Now raise the arm with the dumbbell to the side until your elbow is at shoulder height and your arm is roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arm perpendicular to the torso while keeping your arm extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second.
Slowly lower the dumbbell to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: While holding a Mancuerna in one hand, lay with your Pecho down on a flat bench. The other hand can be used to hold to the Pierna of the bench for stability. Position the palm of the hand that is holding the Mancuerna in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arm extended with the elbow slightly bent. This will be your starting position. Now Elevación the arm with the Mancuerna to the Lateral until your elbow is at Hombro height and your arm is roughly parallel to the Suelo as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arm perpendicular to the torso while keeping your arm extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second. SBajoly Bajoer the Mancuerna to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Recostado Deltoides Posterior Elevación
Hombros.instructions_en:
While holding a dumbbell in each hand, lay with your chest down on a flat bench.
Position the palms of the hands in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arms extended with the elbows slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
Now raise the arms to the side until your elbows are at shoulder height and your arms are roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arms perpendicular to the torso while keeping them extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.
Hombros.instructions_es: While holding a Mancuerna in each hand, lay with your Pecho down on a flat bench. Position the palms of the hands in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arms extended with the elbows slightly bent. This will be your starting position. Now Elevación the arms to the Lateral until your elbows are at Hombro height and your arms are roughly parallel to the Suelo as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arms perpendicular to the torso while keeping them extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second. SBajoly Bajoer the Mancuernas to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.

Hombros.name: Machine Shoulder (Military) Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Sit down on the Shoulder Press Machine and select the weight.
Grab the handles to your sides as you keep the elbows bent and in line with your torso. This will be your starting position.
Now lift the handles as you exhale and you extend the arms fully. At the top of the position make sure that you hold the contraction for a second.
Lower the handles slowly back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Sit down on the Press de Hombros Máquina and select the weight. Grab the handles to your Laterals as you keep the elbows bent and in line with your torso. This will be your starting position. Now lift the handles as you exhale and you extend the arms fully. At the top of the position make sure that you hold the contraction for a second. Bajoer the handles sBajoly Espalda to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Un Brazo Inclinado Elevación Lateral
Hombros.instructions_en:
Lie down sideways on an incline bench press with a dumbbell in the hand. Make sure the shoulder is pressing against the incline bench and the arm is lying across your body with the palm around your navel.
Hold a dumbbell in your uppermost arm while keeping it extended in front of you parallel to the floor. This is your starting position.
While keeping the dumbbell parallel to the floor at all times, perform a lateral raise. Your arm should travel straight up until it is pointing at the ceiling. Tip: Exhale as you perform this movement. Hold the dumbbell in the position and feel the contraction in the shoulders for a second.
While inhaling lower the weight across your body back into the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the movement.
Hombros.instructions_es: Lie down Lateralways on an Banca Inclinada Press with a Mancuerna in the hand. Make sure the Hombro is Pressing against the Banca Inclinada and the arm is Recostado across your body with the palm around your navel. Hold a Mancuerna in your uppermost arm while keeping it extended in Frontal of you parallel to the Suelo. This is your starting position. While keeping the Mancuerna parallel to the Suelo at all times, perform a Elevación Lateral. Your arm should travel straight up until it is pointing at the ceiling. Tip: Exhale as you perform this movement. Hold the Mancuerna in the position and feel the contraction in the Hombros for a second. While inhaling Bajoer the weight across your body Espalda into the starting position. Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions. Switch arms and repeat the movement.

Hombros.name: Un Brazo Pesa Rusa Cargada And Envión
Hombros.instructions_en:
Hold a kettlebell by the handle.
Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward.
Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright.
Immediately reverse direction, driving through the heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press the kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight.
Receive the weight overhead by returning to a squat position underneath the weight.
Keeping the weight overhead, return to a standing position. Lower the weight to the floor to perform the next repetition.
Hombros.instructions_es: Hold a Pesa Rusa by the handle. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombro by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you pull the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombro. Rotate your Muñeca as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. Fondo your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso Vertical. Immediately Inverso direction, driving through the heels, in essence Saltoing to create momentum. As you do so, Press the Pesa Rusa Sobre la Cabeza to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight. Receive the weight Sobre la Cabeza by returning to a Sentadilla position underneath the weight. Keeping the weight Sobre la Cabeza, return to a De Pie position. Bajoer the weight to the Suelo to perform the next repetition.

Hombros.name: Un Brazo Pesa Rusa Envión
Hombros.instructions_en:
Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position.
Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright.
Immediately reverse direction, driving through the heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press the kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight. Receive the weight overhead by returning to a squat position underneath the weight. Keeping the weight overhead, return to a standing position.
Lower the weight to perform the next repetition.
Hombros.instructions_es: Hold a Pesa Rusa by the handle. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombro by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you pull the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombro. Rotate your Muñeca as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position. Fondo your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso Vertical. Immediately Inverso direction, driving through the heels, in essence Saltoing to create momentum. As you do so, Press the Pesa Rusa Sobre la Cabeza to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight. Receive the weight Sobre la Cabeza by returning to a Sentadilla position underneath the weight. Keeping the weight Sobre la Cabeza, return to a De Pie position. Bajoer the weight to perform the next repetition.

Hombros.name: One-arm Kettlebell Military Press To The Side
Hombros.name_en: One-Arm Kettlebell Military Press To The Side
Hombros.instructions_en:
Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces inward. This will be your starting position.
Look at the kettlebell and press it up and out until it is locked out overhead.
Lower the kettlebell back to your shoulder under control and repeat. Make sure to contract your lat, butt, and stomach forcefully for added stability and strength.
Hombros.instructions_es: Cargada a Pesa Rusa to your Hombro. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombro by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you pull the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombro. Rotate your Muñeca as you do so, so that the palm faces inward. This will be your starting position. Look at the Pesa Rusa and Press it up and out until it is locked out Sobre la Cabeza. Bajoer the Pesa Rusa Espalda to your Hombro under control and repeat. Make sure to contract your lat, butt, and stomach forcefully for added stability and strength.

Hombros.name: One-arm Kettlebell para Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position.
Hold the kettlebell with the elbow out to the side, and press it up and out until it is locked out overhead.
Lower the kettlebell back to your shoulder under control and repeat. Make sure to contract your lat, butt, and stomach forcefully for added stability and strength.
Hombros.instructions_es: Cargada a Pesa Rusa to your Hombro. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombro by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you pull the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombro. Rotate your Muñeca as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position. Hold the Pesa Rusa with the elbow out to the Lateral, and Press it up and out until it is locked out Sobre la Cabeza. Bajoer the Pesa Rusa Espalda to your Hombro under control and repeat. Make sure to contract your lat, butt, and stomach forcefully for added stability and strength.

Hombros.name: One-arm Kettlebell Push Press
Hombros.instructions_en:
Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position.
Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright.
Immediately reverse direction, driving through the heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press the kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight. Lower the weight to perform the next repetition.
Hombros.instructions_es: Hold a Pesa Rusa by the handle. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombro by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you pull the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombro. Rotate your Muñeca as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position. Fondo your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso Vertical. Immediately Inverso direction, driving through the heels, in essence Saltoing to create momentum. As you do so, Press the Pesa Rusa Sobre la Cabeza to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight. Bajoer the weight to perform the next repetition.

Hombros.name: Un Brazo Pesa Rusa Arrancada
Hombros.instructions_en:
Place a kettlebell between your feet. Bend your knees and push your butt back to get in the proper starting position.
Look straight ahead and swing the kettlebell back between your legs.
Immediately reverse the direction and drive through with your hips and knees, accelerating the kettlebell upward. As the kettlebell rises to your shoulder rotate your hand and punch straight up, using momentum to receive the weight locked out overhead.
Hombros.instructions_es: Place a Pesa Rusa between your feet. Bend your knees and push your butt Espalda to get in the proper starting position. Look straight ahead and swing the Pesa Rusa Espalda between your Piernas. Immediately Inverso the direction and drive through with your Caderas and knees, accelerating the Pesa Rusa upward. As the Pesa Rusa rises to your Hombro rotate your hand and punch straight up, using momentum to receive the weight locked out Sobre la Cabeza.

Hombros.name: Un Brazo Pesa Rusa Split Envión
Hombros.instructions_en:
Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position.
Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright.
Immediately reverse direction, driving through the heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press the kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight.
Receive the weight overhead by returning to a squat position underneath the weight, positioning one leg in front of you and one leg behind you.
Keeping the weight overhead, return to a standing position and bring your feet together. Lower the weight to perform the next repetition.
Hombros.instructions_es: Hold a Pesa Rusa by the handle. Cargada the Pesa Rusa to your Hombro by extending through the Piernas and Caderas as you pull the Pesa Rusa towards your Hombro. Rotate your Muñeca as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position. Fondo your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso Vertical. Immediately Inverso direction, driving through the heels, in essence Saltoing to create momentum. As you do so, Press the Pesa Rusa Sobre la Cabeza to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight. Receive the weight Sobre la Cabeza by returning to a Sentadilla position underneath the weight, positioning one Pierna in Frontal of you and one Pierna behind you. Keeping the weight Sobre la Cabeza, return to a De Pie position and bring your feet together. Bajoer the weight to perform the next repetition.

Hombros.name: Un Brazo Pesa Rusa Split Arrancada
Hombros.instructions_en:
Hold a kettlebell in one hand by the handle.
Squat towards the floor, and then reverse the motion, extending the hips, knees, and finally the ankles, to raise the kettlebell overhead.
After fully extending the body, descend into a lunge position to receive the weights overhead, one leg forward and one leg back. Ensure you drive through with your hips and lock the ketttlebells overhead in one uninterrupted motion.
Return to a standing position, holding the weight overhead, and bring the feet together. Lower the weight to return to the starting position.
Hombros.instructions_es: Hold a Pesa Rusa in one hand by the handle. Sentadilla towards the Suelo, and then Inverso the motion, extending the Caderas, knees, and finally the ankles, to Elevación the Pesa Rusa Sobre la Cabeza. After fully extending the body, descend into a Zancada position to receive the weights Sobre la Cabeza, one Pierna forward and one Pierna Espalda. Ensure you drive through with your Caderas and lock the ketttlebells Sobre la Cabeza in one uninterrupted motion. Return to a De Pie position, holding the weight Sobre la Cabeza, and bring the feet together. Bajoer the weight to return to the starting position.

Hombros.name: Un Brazo Lateral Laterals
Hombros.instructions_en:
Pick a dumbbell and place it in one of your hands. Your non lifting hand should be used to grab something steady such as an incline bench press. Lean towards your lifting arm and away from the hand that is gripping the incline bench as this will allow you to keep your balance.
Stand with a straight torso and have the dumbbell by your side at arm's length with the palm of the hand facing you. This will be your starting position.
While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the dumbbell to your side with a slight bend on the elbow and your hand slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up until you arm is parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this movement and pause for a second at the top.
Lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
Hombros.instructions_es: Pick a Mancuerna and place it in one of your hands. Your non lifting hand should be used to grab something steady such as an Banca Inclinada Press. Lean towards your lifting arm and away from the hand that is gripping the Banca Inclinada as this will alBajo you to keep your balance. Stand with a straight torso and have the Mancuerna by your Lateral at arm's length with the palm of the hand facing you. This will be your starting position. While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the Mancuerna to your Lateral with a slight bend on the elbow and your hand slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up until you arm is parallel to the Suelo. Exhale as you execute this movement and pause for a second at the top. Bajoer the Mancuerna Espalda down sBajoly to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. Switch arms and repeat the exercise.

Hombros.name: Power Partials
Hombros.instructions_en:
Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell on each hand being held at arms length. The elbows should be close to the torso.
The palms of the hands should be facing your torso. Your feet should be about shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your arms straight and the torso stationary, lift the weights out to your sides until they are about shoulder level height while exhaling.
Feel the contraction for a second and begin to lower the weights back down to the starting position while inhaling. Tip: Keep the palms facing down with the little finger slightly higher while lifting and lowering the weights as it will concentrate the stress on your shoulders mainly.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Hombros.instructions_es: Stand up with your torso Vertical and a Mancuerna on each hand being held at arms length. The elbows should be close to the torso. The palms of the hands should be facing your torso. Your feet should be about Hombro width apart. This will be your starting position. Keeping your arms straight and the torso stationary, lift the weights out to your Laterals until they are about Hombro level height while exhaling. Feel the contraction for a second and begin to Bajoer the weights Espalda down to the starting position while inhaling. Tip: Keep the palms facing down with the little finger slightly Altoer while lifting and Bajoering the weights as it will concentrate the stress on your Hombros mainly. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Hombros.name: Inverso Aperturases
Hombros.instructions_en:
To begin, lie down on an incline bench with the chest and stomach pressing against the incline. Have the dumbbells in each hand with the palms facing each other (neutral grip).
